chapters.title: Chapter 51 - Blockbuster
paragraphs: “Why?!” Ding Chengzhi was stunned when he heard what Hong Dali said. The classmates were all shocked as well.
Tang Muxin tugged at Hong Dali’s sleeve and said, “Dali, it’s 200,000 yuan. And it is just for them to use the song. Why not?”

Two hundred thousand as the licensing fee was not a small amount. This was not just a monetary transaction. This meant that a well-known company like Penghui Films acknowledged Caiwei Entertainment. This meant that with just one song, Li Nianwei could shoot to stardom and no longer be an unknown singer bullied by others.
But Hong Dali disagreed. It was no wonder these people were so shocked.

All of that meant nothing to the superprodigal Hong Dali. He rubbed his nose and said naturally, “Who knows what kind of standardWind Pursuerhas. I don’t want Sister Nianwei’s first famous song to be destroyed by a lousy movie. I’m not short of money anyway.”

Normally, even if Ding Chengzhi was not able to obtain the song to use as the theme song for the movie, he wouldn’t be concerned about saving face. “Lightning Pursuit” might be a good song, but he could always find another song, even though the new song might not be as suitable. As the saying went, one could hit his head and bleed, but one couldn’t lose face. This prodigal young master had actually said that his film was a lousy film. He could not tolerate this any longer.

Ding Chengzhi exasperatedly said, “OurWind Pursueris a blockbuster with more than 10 million invested. It is in no way a lousy film. Within the country, the number of films of such a caliber is lower than five!”
In this world, a film with a production budget of more than 10 million was really a blockbuster.
When the surrounding classmates heard the production budget, they all drew in a cold breath at the same time.

What kind of person was Hong Dali? He had died on Earth and been reborn to this world. Ten million yuan in this world was only equivalent to 50 million yuan on Earth. That was peanuts in the film industry. There was no way this number could scare him. Hong Dali continued to appear listless. “It is just 10 million yuan...Wind Pursuer, just the name sounds like it will be a lousy film...”

Ding Chengzhi was fuming with rage. This person in front of him was the young master of the Hong family, the only son and descendant. He could not afford to offend this young master. Hence, he could only try his best to calm down and use his gentlest tone to ask Hong Dali, “What would be considered a blockbuster in Young Young Master Dali’s opinion? Ten million is the most we can gather for the production budget.”

Hong Dali sniffed. “It seems your company is just average. Show me the movie first. If it is good, I will invest another three million yuan. As for the name of the movie, Wind Pursuerdoes not sound impressive at all. How aboutThe Gale Flash? That sounds good.”
An additional three million yuan investment in the end?

Ding Chengzhi felt like his heart could almost not take it. Previously, he had heard that the Hong family’s young master Hong Dali was a prodigal. But he could finally see it for himself today. Not only was Hong Dali a prodigal, but he was also a superprodigal.
To invest three million yuan just like that? The only condition was that they change the title of the movie?

This was like money dropping from the sky. There was no way he would miss it. Ding Chengzhi hurriedly replied, “Okay. I will report to my boss now. On my return, I will bring what has been filmed to show to you, Young Master Dali. The percentage of profits from the box office will be according to the usual rules, in proportion to whatever Young Master Dali has invested.”

Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders. “It is no use saying all this. Show me the movie before I decide if it is worth investing in. I may be a prodigal, but I will not throw my money away. Um, when can I see the movie?”

As the music producer for Penghui Films, Ding Chengzhi had some special privileges. This was a good time to gain a greater investment for the movie. He had to do it even if it was beyond his level. He fished out a USB from his pocket and said, “Young Master Dali, do you have a computer here? I have some scenes here. Please take a look.”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “Do we have a computer? Bring it over.”
Everyone around shook their head. “No.”
Hong Dali: “Go buy one, then. Who is that?” Hong Dali pointed at a lackey. “You, come over! Go get 10,000 yuan and bring back a computer. It must be a good one. You can keep the change.”

“Yes, Young Master!” The lackey had gotten lucky. Just running an errand would earn him seven to eight thousand dollars as pocket money. Who could meet with such a good opportunity! He disappeared in an instant.
Ling Yi took the chance and asked Hong Dali, “Brother Dali, give me an errand too!”
Hong Dali: “There will be a chance for everyone!”
After half an hour.
Hong Dali stared open-mouthed at the computer screen, almost drooling. “I can tell at one glance that this is a fake background. Is this what you said was a blockbuster?!”

“Yes, that’s right. Is there anything wrong?” Ding Chengzhi wiped the sweat from his forehead. “Our 3D creation team spent more than half a month creating the background for this scene. This is the most advanced technology within the country. It might look a bit fake, but not to the extent that one can tell at a glance, right?”

Hong Dali had seen all sorts of intriguing CGI on Earth. Although the animation looked real, it did not match the surrounding environment at all. Hong Dali gloomily said, “This is just a scene that has mountains and rivers. You even had to do CGI? Are you kidding me?”

Ding Chengzhi helplessly said, “I didn’t wish for this either. But where can we find a suitable background for this scene? This was the last resort. Young Master Dali, do you know? Just this short section of CGI cost us 500,000 yuan! How many 500,000 yuans do we have?”

Hong Dali ignored him and continued with his criticism. “The scene is bad, even the storyline is bad. Where are the ups and downs? Where are the exciting parts? The storyline is like the flow of a river, slow and steady. Were you intending to make this a cradle movie?”
“The storyline is bad?” Ding Chengzhi tried his best to defend the show, saying, “This is the best storyline we have. Those who have seen it have said it is good!”
I forgot the standard of the entertainment industry in this world. What a bother.

Hong Dali continued to mumble, “I had such high hopes. This is bad. the storyline should be good in order to make a movie. The CGI animations have to be flawless and up to standard. The actors have to be beautiful! Look at this, is this really a movie?”
Ding Chengzhi stubbornly replied, “Yes, of course, it is! This will definitely be one of the best films this year.”
Hong Dali decisively said, “I’ll invest five million yuan! Do it according to my instructions. Change whatever can be changed!”

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - This Pillow Is Comfortable
paragraphs: Ding Chengzhi grabbed his chest. “My heart...” There was too much information, he needed more time to digest it. “Young Master Dali, do you mean you wish to invest five million yuan? But we have to amend the script according to your liking?” His tone was low and serious, and he emphasized the words “amend the script.”
Five million yuan was not a small amount, but it was definitely not enough to reshoot the entire movie based on a new script.
Hong Dali understood what Ding Chengzhi was trying to hint at. “Um, something like that.” He had tasks that he needed to complete. Money was not an issue. “Five million yuan. But I have conditions.”
Ding Chengzhi nodded his head. “Please continue.”

“First, change the name of the movie toThe Gale Flash! Second, use Sister Nianwei’s song as the theme song. Um, consider this permission to use the song. Third, the script needs to be amended according to my wishes. Fourth!” Hong Dali rubbed his chin. “I have not decided yet. I will let you know then!”

How could Ding Chengzhi miss such a good opportunity? Ding Chengzhi started running to the door. “O... okay! I will go back and let my boss know! Tomorrow, we will send someone down to sign the contract and bring the script for you to go through!”

“Go.” Hong Dali waved his hand at Ding Chengzhi before suddenly calling him back, “Oh, yes, I remember now. Remember to spread the news. Say a mysterious person invested in the movie, and that the perfect theme song has been found. Create some hype. You should understand. I don’t need to teach you, right?”
“Yes! Of course!” Ding Chengzhi left faster than he had come, and he soon disappeared down the corridor.

When Hong Dali started to get up, Tang Muxin, who had been observing, suddenly shouted, “Dali, you’re not serious about investing five million yuan, are you? What exactly are you thinking? You push away when money it’s coming your way and instead choose to spend five million yuan investing. Even if you like to squander, this is not the way to do it.”

Lang Hao, who had always been at odds with Hong Dali, was gloating. “That’s right. Hehe. To invest five million yuan in a movie, if the box office hits 15 million, which should be the highest it could go, after deducting the expenses and everything else, there will only be about one or two million worth of profit. This is provided there are good reviews for the movie. Investing 15 million yuan would just be putting the money in jeopardy.”

Hearing Lang Hao being sarcastic, Tang Muxin could not take it anymore. She stomped on Lang Hao’s foot and said, “Why should you care what Dali does? If you continue to be sarcastic, wait and see whether I’ll beat you up!”
Lang Hao felt the death stares from the classmates around him and quickly gave in. “Okay, okay, okay. I’ll stop talking. I just have a foul mouth.”
After lecturing Lang Hao, Tang Muxin shook Hong Dali’s arm. “Dali, do you really intend to invest five million yuan in the movie? Five million is not a small amount!”
Hong Dali curiously replied, “I’m serious. How could I miss such a good opportunity to squander?”
Dead silence.

Li Nianwei’s concert was about to come to an end. The audience was all shouting the word “goddess.” The cheers could be heard through the glass of the VIP room. Hong Dali and the others turned to look at the crowd at the same time. The situation in the audience area was almost akin to a riot. If not for the security officers, the audience would have all rushed up the stage.

Hong Dali mumbled, “What are they so excited about? Haven’t they seen a beautiful lady before...? Okay, it’s getting boring. Let’s head to the nightclub for supper. We can stay at the hotel after supper too.”
Everyone cheered at the same time when they heard Hong Dali’s suggestion. “Yes, yes!”
Hong Dali did not forget about Li Nianwei. He continued to give instructions. “Remember to bring Sister Nianwei along. Tonight will be her celebration feast. She has become a celebrity now. Hahaha.”

The concert ended at 10 PM. The excited audience could not bear to leave the concert venue. They blocked the entrance to the stadium just to see Li Nianwei again. The policemen were called in to control the situation. The police cleared the path and the crowd finally dispersed at 11:40 PM.
The next day, Li Nianwei’s concert was the headline of the Tianjing Morning Paper. A huge banner and photos of the concert took up one-third of the first page.
At noon, the country’s biggest video website, Henku, uploaded Li Nianwei’s full concert in high definition. The licensing fee cost 600,000 yuan.

In the afternoon, the most searched keyword on the internet was “Goddess Li Nianwei.” There was a total of 652,785 searches, and the number was quickly increasing. The download count for the high-definition concert was 1,254,742. Hong Dali received 630,000 yuan for the downloads.

This might not be a huge amount, but for a newcomer with no fame to have achieved these numbers, it was enough to impress the people in the industry. The most important thing was that these numbers were inclining sharply. Many people had watched the video two, three, or even four times.

In the evening, the original disc for “Goddess Li Nianwei” was under production. From the opening of the concert with 40 luxury cars to Li Nianwei leaving the stage, every scene was digitally and artistically processed. Many people ran into disc shops, asking, “Do you have the Goddess’ disc?” If the answer was no, some people immediately turned around to leave. Some people pounded the table and scolded: “Why bother keeping your shop open if you don’t even have the Goddess’ disc!” The bosses perplexedly replied, “Production for the disc has just begun. Our stock has not arrived yet!”

On the third day, on the 1st of May, Labor Day, the words “Goddess Li Nianwei” were first on the Sangle search engine. The number of searches was twice that of the second item on the list. Li Nianwei was known to every household within a night. Nobody could be compared to her.

On the fourth day, Caiwei Entertainment officially opened for business. At the press conference, when the reporters heard that Li Nianwei was one of the bosses, the crowd screamed. When the news was announced, the cheers could be heard throughout all of Tianjing city. The sales for all the major magazines and newspapers increased by more than fifty percent.

On the seventh day, a goddess alliance was formed on the internet. Members of the alliance went up to the millions. If one person posted a message requesting Li Nianwei hold a concert in their city, countless people would respond to it. Some netizens even claimed that they would fly to whichever city she held her concert in. The brands that she endorsed were reserved for her fans. If any of the fans did not use them, the men’s legs would be broken, and the women... what happened to them would not be further elaborated. It would not be a pretty sight.
And the person who had started this, Hong Dali, was lying comfortably on Li Nianwei’s legs, drooling as he slept and mumbling nonstop. “This pillow is so comfortable and warm...”

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - You Just Want Me to Genuflect? I’ll Do It!”
paragraphs: While Hong Dali was enjoying himself without a care in the world, the hype of Li Nianwei’s concert had yet to come to an end.

There were no stupid people in the entertainment industry—especially the manager, Zhang Cai. She had mentioned that Li Nianwei would hold another concert in the near future. Although the details had not been set in stone, the entire entertainment industry was hyped up. Subsequently, as Li Nianwei’s manager, Zhang Cai was voted to be the cutest person of the year online.
Xinhai Weipo, the biggest Weipo in Heavenly State, had gathered more than 500 million registered users. All the young men and women who were well versed in Weipo gathered here.
In this information era, almost every artist had an account on Weipo. Hence, the biggest fans gathered here as well. First-hand news was often leaked from Weipo to other sources.
There was usually much going on on Weipo, but it was exceptionally bustling on this day.

Kuge Official Sheng Wenshi: “Unable to explain my shock. That comfortable feeling that shot through my body, from the soles of my feet to my head. If God grants me another chance, I am willing to give everything so that Miss Nianwei’s vocals may stay young forever. This is not love, this is idolization. If I have to set a time limit for this idolization, I hope it will be ten thousand years.”

Penghui Films Music Director: “In order to obtain the license for using Miss Li Nianwei’s song, I risked my old bones. I am now covered in bruises and injuries. But it was all worth it. I do not regret it. I would also like to announce thatWind Pursuerhas been renamed toThe Gale Flash. The theme song will be Miss Nianwei’s ‘Lightning Pursuit.’ I hope everyone likes it.”

Veteran musician Wang Bo: “Having been in the music industry for so many years, this is the first time I have been shocked by a newcomer. That feeling, yes, there are no other words to describe it other than ‘shocking.’”
All these messages were just the tip of the iceberg.

Other than music producers and film companies, many other singers and actors were discussing on Weipo too. Those who had seen the video of the concert praised it highly. Countless netizens were particularly fond of this phrase: “You just want me to genuflect? I’ll do it!”
While the internet was busy, Li Nianwei’s manager, Zhang Cai was just as busy.
“Hello, how are you? I am Zhang Cai. Um, the endorsement for the shampoo, endorsement fee... 600,000 yuan. Okay. I will discuss this with management and get back to you. Thank you.”

“Hello, how are you? I am Zhang Cai. The advertisement for Princess Clothings? Um, okay. The endorsement fee is 550,000 yuan. Okay, I understand. I will discuss this with management and get back to you. Thank you.”

“Hello, how are you? This is Caiwei Entertainment. I am Zhang Cai. The endorsement for Jia Ning Electronics? Endorsement fee is 750,000 yuan. Okay. I understand. I will discuss with management and get back to you. Thank you.”
Her responses were basically the same. Every time, she said she would discuss with management, but the actual situation was—

“Young Master, twelve companies have called us within the last two hours to request that Nianwei endorse their products. These products range from livelihood to technology. And the endorsement fees add up to... 5.45 million. Should we have Nianwei accept these endorsement deals? After all, setting up this company has cost Young Master quite the sum of money.” Looking at the records in her hands, Zhang Cai could feel her heart pounding.

The author had collected information about the little details that no one else had noticed. He summed up everything from when Li Nianwei sang at Ye Lai Xiang nightclub to the construction of the stage to how the news had spread. He also analyzed the significance of the 40 luxury sports cars that had appeared. This post was forwarded and sought out by countless people.

Within a few hours, the post had caught the attention of veteran economic planners. They had come to the same conclusion after their own analysis. How was Miss Li Nianwei able to shoot to fame overnight? Everyone must be curious. Undeniably, Miss Li Nianwei can sing very well. But without the meticulous planning of the concert, the news would not have spread so quickly. We have with us veteran economics expert Professor Tian Hongqing to analyze this with us.”
Tian Hongqing: “Hello, host. Hello, everyone.”
Host: “Professor Tian, I’m sure you have heard of the goddess phenomenon. Could you tell our viewers who are watching us on TV about the planning for this concert?”

Tian Hongqing: “Sure. Everyone knows that an artist’s fame relates to their ability. This should be basic. The hype created by the team backing up the artist plays a part too. In my opinion, Miss Li Nianwei’s capability is beyond doubt. What was really powerful was the planning capability and how carefully it was executed by the team.”

Host: “Let us invite Professor Tian to elaborate further on the meticulous planning of the high-end concert, so as to unravel the mystery of the concert and the mystery of how Miss Li Nianwei was able to shoot to fame overnight. Welcome, everyone!”

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - God-level Plan
paragraphs: Tian Hongqing: “Regarding the planning of the concert, I asked around and gathered information. The following are my findings. Don’t be anxious and let me go through them one by one.”
Host: “Yes, I believe our viewers will be very interested.”
Tian Hongqing: “First, according to the rumors that first started, it seemed like Miss Li Nianwei first appeared at Tianjing City’s West Four Loop’s Ye Lai Xiang nightclub and sang two songs.”
Host: “Um, this was made known on the internet. But Professor Tian, as you mentioned—’seemed like.’ Do you mean that there is other insider information that our viewers are not aware of?”
Tian Hongqing: “Yes, through my analysis and findings, even I am shocked by the conclusion. The planning team behind Li Nianwei started long before she sang at Ye Lai Xiang nightclub.”
Host: “Really?”

Tian Hongqing: “Yes, this god-level planning team had first made Ye Lai Xiang free for a week. Everything was free of charge. This aroused the curiosity of countless people. As everyone knows, people are often curious about free things. This is a psychological phenomenon. And this god-level planning team took advantage of this phenomenon. I’m sure you understand this.”
Host: “I understand. Where there are free things, there will be people. What happened after?”

Tian Hongqing: “After having fun at the nightclub for free for two days, as everyone can imagine, the nightclub was bustling with popularity. There was hardly any space for more people to stand in the nightclub. What does this mean? It means that the first step of gathering the crowd had been achieved. From my findings, I’m able to conclude this part of the plan cost about 500,000 yuan.”
Host: “Five hundred thousand yuan is able to gather such a level of popularity?”

Tian Hongqing: “Which is why they deserve to be called a god-level planning team. Five hundred thousand yuan to lay the foundation. Right at this moment, the show started. The day when Miss Li Nianwei made her appearance, there were as many as forty luxury sports cars just to provide lighting for the concert. What does it mean to have luxury cars? It means that it will attract people’s attention. Normally, when a luxury car appears, people will take a second glance at it. Not to mention forty luxury cars appearing all at once.”
Host: “Yes, yes. That’s inevitable. Even if it were me, if I saw so many luxury cars, I would be curious about what’s going on.”

Tian Hongqing: “That’s right. Think about this. With so many luxury cars at the entrance, plus everything in the nightclub being free, any normal person would want to go in and find out what’s going on. Even if they couldn’t go in, they would try and find out from the crowd about the situation inside. Am I right?”
Host: “Um, indeed. People in the Heavenly State love lively scenes. The planning team was able to use that to their advantage.”

Tian Hongqing: “Yes. The foundation of popularity has been gained. But don’t underestimate this popularity. As we all know, Miss Li Nianwei is very good at singing. To sing at a venue like this would gather countless fans. Then comes the main and most important point of the plan.”
Host: “Um, please continue.”

Tian Hongqing: “With the basic popularity, the planning team announced Li Nianwei’s free concert almost immediately. What does this imply? It means that those people who experienced Miss Li Nianwei sing at Ye Lai Xiang nightclub would promote for her. Think about it—free of charge, good songs—it’s very attractive in itself. Then there is the concert. It would have been boring if no one attended it. All the people who were at Ye Lai Xiang invited everyone they knew. There should be around two thousand people at Ye Lai Xiang at that moment. For each one of them to bring three or four people to the concert, that shouldn’t be a problem. How many people would there be?”
Host: “I’m suddenly enlightened by your words. That would make almost ten thousand people!”

Tian Hongqing: “That’s right. You see, that’s a guaranteed crowd of at least ten thousand people. As the saying goes, three people spreading reports of a tiger would make you believe there is one around. In addition to the leaflets that the planning team gave out, the news spread from mouth to mouth. There was no need to worry about popularity. There was another benefit to this. Without these people spreading the news, who would believe the concert was free?”
Host: “That’s true. It’s a big deal that the concert is free of charge. The average person would not believe it.”

Tian Hongqing: “Which is why, with these people around, there would be no problem gathering the crowd. One more thing that the planning team did right was focusing the promotion of the publicity on the people in Tianjing City, West Four Loops. The stadium where Miss Li Nianwei held her concert was in the West Four Loops. A free concert where popularity was guaranteed. The result was obvious.”

Host: “Oh yes, that’s right! People may like free things, but if the publicity is too far, people who are not aware of Miss Li Nianwei’s popularity might not come all the way to listen to her. But the locals are different. It is free, after all; there’s nothing to lose.”

Tian Hongqing: “Yes. This god-level planning team is good at capturing people’s mind. Before the concert had even started, there was a guaranteed turn-up of tens of thousands. With the scale of the concert, it was only right for it to catch people’s attention. That’s not the most impressive thing about the planning team, however. It’s the lighting that struck me the most.”

Host: “Oh yes, yes. The creativity behind those lights was simply amazing. Using the headlights of sports cars worth more than 30 million as stage lighting. This must be the most creative and extravagant idea in history.”

At this moment, the host suddenly took out a card from his pocket. “We have especially gotten the phone number belonging to the leader of the planning team for this live broadcast. Now, let us give this leader a call and find out how they came out with such a fabulous idea.”
While the host spoke, he picked up a telephone and pressed the speaker button before dialing the number on the card.
A gentle female voice spoke from the end of the line: “Hello, may I know who is this...?”
Host: “Hello, this is Tianjing Variety Channel. I’m the host, and my name is Wang Yong. Can I speak to Mr. Hong please?”
The female voice answered: “May I know what this is regarding?”
Host: “It’s like this, we would like to ask Mr. Hong a few questions. How did he come up with the idea of using the headlights of sports cars for the stage lighting for Miss Li Nianwei’s concert?”
The female voice answered: “Oh, okay. Please hold on for a moment.” “Young Master, someone called from the TV station. They wish to ask about the concert lighting.”
The host and Tian Hongqing held their breath as they waited for the response.
An impatient voice sounded over the phone: “Quit playing. I’m busy walking the dogs.”Klurp.The line was cut!

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - Producing Clouds With One Turn of the Hand and Rain with Another
paragraphs: Silence.
Sweat. Cold sweat. Buckets of sweat.

The sweat on the host’s face was enough to reflect the spotlights on him. The awkward silence continued for five to six seconds before the host quickly changed the topic. “Um, as this is a live broadcast, we didn’t manage to contact the planning team in advance. It seems the god-level planning team is held up in another project, possibly something related to dogs. We must have called at the wrong time.”
The host turned to Tian Hongqing. “Professor Tian, let us continue the topic we were discussing.”

Tian Hongqing: “Okay. The idea of using the headlights of the sports cars for the stage lighting was more than creative. Think about it. When the concert begins, a newcomer with no significant popularity stands on the stage. What is the most important thing at this moment?”
Host: “What is it? I can’t think of anything.”

Tian Hongqing: “The most important thing is a ‘shocking debut’! A newcomer who came from nowhere, standing on the stage. The most important thing is to make a shocking debut. In that way, she will get the audience’s undivided attention. The sports cars worth 30 million were able to fulfill this perfectly!”
Host: “Aye, now that you have mentioned, it’s indeed so! This planning team is amazing!”

Tian Hongqing: “Yes. In the beginning, there were only ten cranes in the stadium and a stage with no lighting at all. Didn’t it seem strange for a concert? In an instant, it caught the attention of the audience. The audience must have wondered what was going on. Curiosity leads to expectation. Right at this moment, forty sports cars worth 30 million appeared and caused a commotion. The audience was shocked, hearts thumping and screaming. The atmosphere changed at once. What is the most important thing in a concert? The atmosphere of course!”
Host: “Yes, that’s right. With such a lively atmosphere, everyone naturally looked forward to the concert.”

Tian Hongqing: “At this moment, there is popularity—thirty to forty thousand people, there is atmosphere—the screams that came with forty sports cars. The audience would definitely start to wonder, who could have thought of such an idea, right? With a stroke of genius, the god-level planning arranged for Miss Li Nianwei to appear on the stage alone!”
Host: “Oh. I’ve watched this part of the video many times, but I just could not tell where the “god-level” part is.

Tian Hongqing: “Think about it, the surroundings were lit, the sports cars had driven in, right? But there was only darkness on the stage. And a person had emerged from the dark. This black and white contrast produced a strong visual shock. The audience was completely drawn to Miss Li Nianwei but at the same time curious about the purpose of those sports cars.”
Host: “Yes, that’s exactly how it is. When I saw the video for the first time, I was beyond curious at that point.”

Tian Hongqing: “That’s right! The forty sports cars were in their positions, and turned on their headlights all at once, shining upon Miss Li Nianwei. Think about how shocked everyone would be. I’m not sure about others, but I almost slumped on the floor when I saw this scene. It was simply too amazing! From that moment on, I had become a loyal supporter of the god-level planning team!”
Host: “Yes, yes. I’m still deeply shocked by that scene. It was unbelievable.”

Tian Hongqing: “Two Soaring Angels as the lead, with Prayer Angels as the supporting lights. The scene of the sports cars being suspended in the air by the cranes was jaw-dropping. It was definitely an unforgettable scene to the audience at the stadium.”
Host: “Not just the audience at the stadium. I could still remember the scene clearly.”
Tian Hongqing: “There is another advantage, and I’m certain you have not thought of it.”
Host: “Oh, what advantage? Do continue.”

Tian Hongqing: “Such lightings would be quite cost-saving. The forty sports cards must have been borrowed from friends of the planning team. The team did not have to spend a cent on the concert lightings.”
Host: “Now that you have mentioned, I’m truly enlightened!”

Tian Hongqing: “Yes, I’m full of admiration for the god-level planning team. From then on, there was no doubt about Miss Li Nianwei’s popularity. Within days, Miss Li Nianwei’s worth rocketed up. From what I know, at least twenty companies were wishing to work with Miss Li Nianwei. And the endorsement fees would not be less than five million yuan. But it seems Miss Li Nianwei has no time to accept these endorsement deals. I estimate her current worth to be about 20 million yuan.”
Host: “Twenty million yuan! Oh my god, that should be the same as the net worth of a top star, right?”
Tian Hongqing: “Yes. Definitely at the top. And still rising. How much do you think this almost-perfect, textbook-material planning cost?”
Host: “How much?”

Tian Hongqing: “The free-spending at Ye Lai Xiang, 500 thousand yuan. The stage building, 500 thousand yuan. Acoustics, 500 thousand yuan. Promotion fee, 500 thousand yuan. Lighting, free. With two million yuan, the planning team made a superstar overnight, whose net worth continues to rise as we speak. To be able to produce clouds with one turn of the hand and rain with another, this style of planning is definitely textbook-material. This concert is sure to appear in the history of concert planning. This god-level planning is sure to be a hit.”
Host: “Yes, yes. It must be so! Okay, now, let us contact the leader of the planning team again to ask him how he came up with such a fabulous idea.”
The phone got through almost instantly. Host: “Hello, I’m the host for Tianjing Variety Channel, Wang Yong. May I know if Mr. Hong’s latest planning has ended?”
This time, Hong Dali did not end the call. “I’m done with the dogs. What is it?”
Host: “We would like to ask Mr. Hong, with regards to Miss Li Nianwei’s concert, where did you get your inspiration from?”
Hong Dali: “Oh, you’re asking about the concert. There was no plan.”
Host: “How could there be no planning for such a perfect concert? Um, in that case, may I know your initial reason for holding this concert?”
Hong Dali replied naturally, “No reason, I just wanted to squander.”

The most important thing is to make a shocking debut.
In that way, she will get the audience’s undivided attention.
The sports cars worth 30 million were able to fulfill this perfectly!”
Host: “Aye, now that you have mentioned, it’s indeed so!
This planning team is amazing!”
Tian Hongqing: “Yes.
In the beginning, there were only ten cranes in the stadium and a stage with no lighting at all.
Didn’t it seem strange for a concert?
In an instant, it caught the attention of the audience.
The audience must have wondered what was going on.
Curiosity leads to expectation.
Right at this moment, forty sports cars worth 30 million appeared and caused a commotion.
The audience was shocked, hearts thumping and screaming.
The atmosphere changed at once.
What is the most important thing in a concert?
The atmosphere of course!”
Host: “Yes, that’s right.
With such a lively atmosphere, everyone naturally looked forward to the concert.”
Tian Hongqing: “At this moment, there is popularity—thirty to forty thousand people, there is atmosphere—the screams that came with forty sports cars.
The audience would definitely start to wonder, who could have thought of such an idea, right?
With a stroke of genius, the god-level planning arranged for Miss Li Nianwei to appear on the stage alone!”
Host: “Oh.
I’ve watched this part of the video many times, but I just could not tell where the “god-level” part is.
Tian Hongqing: “Think about it, the surroundings were lit, the sports cars had driven in, right?
But there was only darkness on the stage.
And a person had emerged from the dark.
This black and white contrast produced a strong visual shock.
The audience was completely drawn to Miss Li Nianwei but at the same time curious about the purpose of those sports cars.”
Host: “Yes, that’s exactly how it is.
When I saw the video for the first time, I was beyond curious at that point.”
Tian Hongqing: “That’s right!
The forty sports cars were in their positions, and turned on their headlights all at once, shining upon Miss Li Nianwei.
Think about how shocked everyone would be.
I’m not sure about others, but I almost slumped on the floor when I saw this scene.
It was simply too amazing!
From that moment on, I had become a loyal supporter of the god-level planning team!”
Host: “Yes, yes.
I’m still deeply shocked by that scene.
It was unbelievable.”
Tian Hongqing: “Two Soaring Angels as the lead, with Prayer Angels as the supporting lights.
The scene of the sports cars being suspended in the air by the cranes was jaw-dropping.
It was definitely an unforgettable scene to the audience at the stadium.”
Host: “Not just the audience at the stadium.
I could still remember the scene clearly.”
Tian Hongqing: “There is another advantage, and I’m certain you have not thought of it.”
Host: “Oh, what advantage?
Do continue.”
Tian Hongqing: “Such lightings would be quite cost-saving.
The forty sports cards must have been borrowed from friends of the planning team.
The team did not have to spend a cent on the concert lightings.”
Host: “Now that you have mentioned, I’m truly enlightened!”
Tian Hongqing: “Yes, I’m full of admiration for the god-level planning team.
From then on, there was no doubt about Miss Li Nianwei’s popularity.
Within days, Miss Li Nianwei’s worth rocketed up.
From what I know, at least twenty companies were wishing to work with Miss Li Nianwei.
And the endorsement fees would not be less than five million yuan.
But it seems Miss Li Nianwei has no time to accept these endorsement deals.
I estimate her current worth to be about 20 million yuan.”
Host: “Twenty million yuan!
Oh my god, that should be the same as the net worth of a top star, right?”
Tian Hongqing: “Yes.
Definitely at the top.
And still rising.
How much do you think this almost-perfect, textbook-material planning cost?”
Host: “How much?”
Tian Hongqing: “The free-spending at Ye Lai Xiang, 500 thousand yuan.
The stage building, 500 thousand yuan.
Acoustics, 500 thousand yuan.
Promotion fee, 500 thousand yuan.
Lighting, free.
With two million yuan, the planning team made a superstar overnight, whose net worth continues to rise as we speak.
To be able to produce clouds with one turn of the hand and rain with another, this style of planning is definitely textbook-material.
This concert is sure to appear in the history of concert planning.
This god-level planning is sure to be a hit.”
Host: “Yes, yes.
It must be so!
Okay, now, let us contact the leader of the planning team again to ask him how he came up with such a fabulous idea.”
The phone got through almost instantly.
Host: “Hello, I’m the host for Tianjing Variety Channel, Wang Yong.
May I know if Mr.
Hong’s latest planning has ended?”
This time, Hong Dali did not end the call.
“I’m done with the dogs.
What is it?”
Host: “We would like to ask Mr.
Hong, with regards to Miss Li Nianwei’s concert, where did you get your inspiration from?”
Hong Dali: “Oh, you’re asking about the concert.
There was no plan.”
Host: “How could there be no planning for such a perfect concert?
Um, in that case, may I know your initial reason for holding this concert?”
Hong Dali replied naturally, “No reason, I just wanted to squander.”

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - I Can’t Speak The Truth?
paragraphs: “I just wanted to squander.”

Hearing Hong Dali, the host started to sweat profusely. Fortunately, the host was quick-witted and was able to respond quickly. “Ah ha ha. Mr. Hong Dali must be joking. Oh yes, I forgot to inform you, we’re broadcasting live now. Mr. Hong Dali’s words are currently being transmitted to the world.”
Hong Dali: “Live broadcast? Wait a minute. What channel is this?”
The host wiped his sweat away. “This is Tianjing Variety Channel.”

Hong Dali: “Xiaoyi, change the channel to Tianjing Variety Channel.” A short moment later, Hong Dali started speaking. “Hello, can you hear me? Can you hear what I’m saying? Aye? It seems like this is really broadcasting live. Whatever I’m saying can be heard from the television. This is fun!”
The host was on the verge of breaking down. “Mr. Hong Dali, do you believe me now?”
Hong Dali: “Ah yes, I believe you. What were you asking me? What plan? I was not planning anything.”

Host: “How could that be? Miss Li Nianwei’s concert was so successful that her net worth shot up to the skies within days. We would like to find out, where did you get the inspiration for this god-level plan?”
Hong Dali: “Oh, the concert. What did I do then? I really had no plans. I only wanted to squander. I was bored, and there was nothing to do anyway...”

Live broadcast and yet his response was so insipid! The host decisively ended the call. “My apologies everyone. We must have got the wrong person. Please hold on for a moment. We must have gotten the number wrong.” While speaking, he winked at the people in the backstage, attempting to get their attention to call someone else more accommodating. If this continued, the program was sure to crumble.

Hong Dali was cursing at the phone on the other end. “Heck, why is this person so lacking in quality. Can’t I speak the truth? Don’t tell me I have to lie to accommodate you? Ridiculous. Completely ridiculous!”

Xiaoyi stood in the corner wiping her sweat. This young master really dared to speak his mind. But he really didn’t have to care too much about this. With his background and status, he couldn’t care less about this TV program.
Hong Dali continued grumbling for a while, and later threw Ling Xiaoyi’s phone out.
Ling Xiaoyi was aggrieved. “Young Master, that phone... belongs to me...”
Hong Dali: “It’s alright. I’ll give mine to you.” Hong Dali gave away a limited edition smartphone that cost 125,000 yuan just like that...
It went quiet in the room for a while. Hong Dali suddenly rubbed his chin and said, “Oh yes, Xiaoyi, how is the Zhong Dian website? When will the recruitment drive be held?”
Ling Xiaoyi replied, “Young Master, about forty people have signed up. The interview is set on this coming Saturday at 9 AM. Does Young Master intend to take a look then?”

“This coming Saturday at 9 AM?” Hong Dali rubbed his chin. “It is 8 PM now. There is nothing much to do, and the streets are crowded and noisy. Let’s arrange for the interview to happen now. Give them a call. Say that I will hold the interview at 9 PM. We will interview whoever can make it.”
“Okay, Young Master.”
9 PM. Chenhui Building, level 8.

Since Hong Dali bought Chenhui Building, his varied collection of things had been moved over. Caiwei Entertainment was situated at level 9. Zhong Dian website was situated at level 8. More than ten plus levels were vacant. Hong Dali did not lack money; hence, he kept them for use later—the way Hong Dali was squandering, the building would be filled up in no time.
The Zhong Dian’s office was at level 8.

When Hong Dali arrived at the door of Zhong Dian website’s office, all the employees were standing in two neat lines at the door. Once Hong Dali walked in with his nine famous lackeys, the employees bowed at the same time. “Hello, Young Master!”

When the general manager of the Zhong Dian website heard that the famous prodigal, Hong Dali, was coming, he immediately gathered all forty employees—It didn’t matter if any of them couldn’t make it, but they would miss out on the chance to get tips!

Within 10 minutes, all the employees gathered. They strongly believed that Young Master Dali would not disappoint them. True enough, Young Master Dali waved his hand before he said anything. “Very efficient, two thousand per person.”

All the employees were filled with gratitude, and a few young female editors were excited. “See, see, see, see. Young Master is different indeed. With nine lackeys following behind him, holding a dog on a leash. Once he spoke, everyone got two thousand yuan of tips. He’s so awesome!”
“Li Nianwei is the perfect wife material, and Hong Dali is the perfect husband material. I wonder if I am Li Nianwei’s type...”

“I heard that acting cute appeals to men. Should I purposely fall down in front of Hong Dali to show him my face? Forget it. If the nine lackeys think I’m trying to assassinate Hong Dali, I’m sure to be beaten to death...”
Hong Dali didn’t know what they were thinking at all. He sniffed and asked, “Where are the interviewees? Let’s go. Bring me to them. See if any of them can make me happy.”
“Okay.” The Human Resource manager led the way. “They’re in the meeting room waiting for Young Master to arrive. Thirty-six people turned up tonight. The rest couldn’t make it.”
“Too bad if they can’t make it.” Hong Dali muttered. “Sometimes fate matters.”

Hong Dali and his lackeys walked into the meeting room like an army. Hong Dali freely sat on the seat in the middle of the room while the Human Resource manager and the general manager sat in the rows on either side. The nine lackeys stood in a row against the wall. The rest of the employees sat down orderly. The interview began.
Hong Dali: “Who is first?”

A man strode forward. “Hello. My name is Jing Shaohui. I graduated from Tianjing University, School of Economics, majored in economic analysis, Ph.D. With regards to the current situation of the company, I’m confident of turning the company’s losses into profits within half a year.”
The Human Resource manager nodded his head and whispered. “He’s not bad. Ph.D. in economics; seems competent.”
General manager: “Um, he will do well.”
Hong Dali listlessly said, “He’s so-so. Next.”

The second person stepped forward. “Hello. My name is Hao Jialiang. I graduated from Tianhai University, School of Chinese Language. I majored in modern language research, Ph.D. I think the most important thing in an online novel website is the quality of novels. I’m confident of being able to increase the quality of novels, turning losses into profits in five months.”
The Human Resource manager whispered. “This one seems not bad as well. Quality is important indeed. He hit the nail on the spot.”
General Manager: “Um. Interesting. This young lad will be able to make it.”
Hong Dali waved his hand, looking listless as before. “So-so. Next.”

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - I Choose You!
paragraphs: “Even... even this one cannot make it?” The HR manager felt dizzy. If he doesn’t want even this kind of talent, then what exactly does he want?

One by one, Hong Dali passed the third, fourth, fifth person... and gradually got restless. The surrounding employees watched on in bewilderment, unable to fathom what was going on in his mind. However, since he was the chairman, they were powerless to say anything. Furthermore, they had already taken the 2,000 yuan red packet. Thus, all they had to do was tolerate and wait for it to end.

Very quickly, the last person for the interview came up. The employees didn’t hold any hope, because the first words that he said were: “Greetings to all, my name is Zhang Wenyang. I graduated from... I shall just skip mentioning this since it’s just a third-class university, there isn’t much point in mentioning it.”
Upon hearing his words, quite a number of female employees couldn’t help but laugh.
The HR manager was immediately angered to the point of amusement. “We’re hiring a director to be the head of the business service department. You... are you sure you are capable?”

Hong Dali lay on the office table with his eyes half-closed and casually took a look. This Zhang Wenyang was sloppily dressed, his hair was in a mess, and he was tan skinned. He looked like a brick-carrying worker from a construction site. Even so, it didn’t cause Hong Dali’s first impression of him to be bad, but only asked weakly, “Yep, I got it. What are you capable of?”

“I know how to spend money!” Zhang Wenyang stood with his head held high and chest puffed. “I believe that the most important thing to do for Zhong Dian in the current situation is to spend money on it as much as possible!”

“I choose you!” Hong Dali’s spirit immediately lightened up. He smacked the table fiercely with a bang, causing everyone to be shocked. “I choose you. Finally, I found someone who suits my taste. That wasn’t easy!”
Crashing sounds of jaws dropping on the floor could be heard.
The HR manager violently covered his chest with his hand. “My heart, oh mine... what rule is this small ancestor abiding by in choosing people...”
The nine lackeys were thinking: Look at these country bumpkins, do they think they can fathom Young Master’s thoughts?

Those people with high qualifications who were already interviewed all exclaimed and objected. That country bumpkin Zhang Wenyang who graduated from a third-class university beat them to the job, how could they accept that!
A few even shouted: “Underhand dealings, this is an underhand dealing!” Then, they were dragged out of the meeting room by the lackeys.

Hong Dali totally ignored the sighs and exclamations from the people around. Eyes glowing, he asked Zhang Wenyang, “Tell me how you are planning to spend money! If your plan is good, I shall reward you!”

“It’s a must to spend.” Zhang Wenyang gradually said. “In my opinion, if a website wants to succeed, the numbers of authors must be large. Therefore, the scale of their treatment must be increased. Currently, the largest online novel website in the country is Turkey Bookstore, and of the profit there, 60% belongs to the website and 40% to the authors. They also have a reward for full-time attendance—the website rewards the authors a hundred yuan if they renew their chapters at a rate of 5,000 characters per day for a month. There are also some more minor rewards.”

Speaking to up to there, Zhang Wenyang paused before continuing, “Therefore, since Turkey Bookstore is our largest rival, we have to beat them in terms of our treatment toward the authors. Only then will we be able to attract more authors. My plan is for our website to split the profit—40% for the website and 60% for the authors—and a monthly reward of 200 yuan if they maintain a rate of 6,000 characters per day.”

The general manager couldn’t help but feel like giving Zhang Wenyang a kick. Does this rascal know that we’re already making a loss now that our treatment is on the same level as them? If we increase the treatment, how much money will we lose?
Unexpectedly, Hong Dali laughed and said, “Very good, I like your idea! I didn’t plan to make money anyway. We shall follow your plan. Do you have any other suggestions?”

Zhang Wenyang continued, “Then, there’s also advertising. There must be advertisements of our website everywhere. As long as one reads, they must be aware of our website. Even if they have never heard of Turkey Bookstore, they must know of Zhong Dian!”
The HR manager couldn’t tolerate it anymore. “Young man, do you have any idea how much money we will need to spend? At least millions! Who can afford that?”
“That shall be how it will be done!” Hong Dali ignored the HR manager and directly decided. “This is how I like things to work!”

Sounds of exasperation came from the employees. The performance of the company wasn’t high in the first place; thus, they would definitely make a loss if they followed Zhang Wenyang’s plan. It wouldn’t be long before the company wouldn’t be able to sustain its operations at this rate. Even if Hong Dali had the money, he would not be able to afford such a loss. Advertising was totally different from other investments. Unlike others which only needed a single investment, there was no limit to how much one would need to spend on advertisements.

After Zhang Wenyang finished his previous sentence, he paused for a moment before concluding: “Currently, it’s not the best timing to start doing advertisements. Novels and entertainment are similar in that their value both depends on their quality. Goddess Li Nianwei would not have been able to rise to fame in just a single concert had she not been highly talented in the first place. If a second-rate singer had taken her place, no matter how much money and resources one spent to support her, it would have been in vain. It will be meaningless.”

“En, you have a point there.” Hong Dali nodded. “Then, just follow the plan for now. Start from raising the treatment of the authors. Oh right, don’t do four-six, do three-seven. We’ll take just 30% profit.”
“Prodigal, what a prodigal...” The general manager face-palmed. “How will we make any profit, then?” Of course, he didn’t dare to say this out loud.
“Alright, you’re all dismissed. Oh right, the editors stay back, I have some questions to ask.” Hong Dali chicly waved his hand. “Those of you who have nothing left to do can go back home now.”
Soon, those unrelated left the meeting room. Now, only Hong Dali, his nine lackeys, and 10 plus editors were left behind.
Hong Dali asked, “I have one question to ask. I plan to seek some authors. You guys help and see if you have met someone like this before.”
“Young Master, please state your mind.” A bald-headed editor asked amidst the crowd.

“En, I want the kind that writes about fighting and killing; if you stare at me, I will beat you up; if you scold me, I will kill your whole family; those kinds. Is there any?” Hong Dali’s eyes almost glowed to the point of being comparable to 200-watt lightbulbs—he depended on this kind of stuff to pass his time in class.

“This... this...” The editors were all violently wiping their sweat and staring at one another. Finally, the bald-headed editor nervously said, “I did meet this kind of authors before. I secretly remembered their names because of the novelty of their novels...”
“Really!?” Hong Dali’s spirits were finally lifted. “What’s your position in the company now?”
Baldy replied, “Young Master, I’m the main editor of group one now. My name is Tang Jinghui.”

Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “From now on, you shall be the chief editor!” Upon hearing his words, a middle-aged man at the side shuddered. Needless to say, he must be the previous chief editor, an ill-fortuned guy.
“These authors you’re talking about, recommend them to me.” Hong Dali said matter-of-factly. “Let me see if they’re able to satisfy me.”

My plan is for our website to split the profit—40% for the website and 60% for the authors—and a monthly reward of 200 yuan if they maintain a rate of 6,000 characters per day.”
The general manager couldn’t help but feel like giving Zhang Wenyang a kick.
Does this rascal know that we’re already making a loss now that our treatment is on the same level as them?
If we increase the treatment, how much money will we lose?
Unexpectedly, Hong Dali laughed and said, “Very good, I like your idea!
I didn’t plan to make money anyway.
We shall follow your plan.
Do you have any other suggestions?”
Zhang Wenyang continued, “Then, there’s also advertising.
There must be advertisements of our website everywhere.
As long as one reads, they must be aware of our website.
Even if they have never heard of Turkey Bookstore, they must know of Zhong Dian!”
The HR manager couldn’t tolerate it anymore.
“Young man, do you have any idea how much money we will need to spend?
At least millions!
Who can afford that?”
“That shall be how it will be done!” Hong Dali ignored the HR manager and directly decided.
“This is how I like things to work!”
Sounds of exasperation came from the employees.
The performance of the company wasn’t high in the first place; thus, they would definitely make a loss if they followed Zhang Wenyang’s plan.
It wouldn’t be long before the company wouldn’t be able to sustain its operations at this rate.
Even if Hong Dali had the money, he would not be able to afford such a loss.
Advertising was totally different from other investments.
Unlike others which only needed a single investment, there was no limit to how much one would need to spend on advertisements.
After Zhang Wenyang finished his previous sentence, he paused for a moment before concluding: “Currently, it’s not the best timing to start doing advertisements.
Novels and entertainment are similar in that their value both depends on their quality.
Goddess Li Nianwei would not have been able to rise to fame in just a single concert had she not been highly talented in the first place.
If a second-rate singer had taken her place, no matter how much money and resources one spent to support her, it would have been in vain.
It will be meaningless.”
“En, you have a point there.” Hong Dali nodded.
“Then, just follow the plan for now.
Start from raising the treatment of the authors.
Oh right, don’t do four-six, do three-seven.
We’ll take just 30% profit.”
“Prodigal, what a prodigal...” The general manager face-palmed.
“How will we make any profit, then?” Of course, he didn’t dare to say this out loud.
“Alright, you’re all dismissed.
Oh right, the editors stay back, I have some questions to ask.” Hong Dali chicly waved his hand.
“Those of you who have nothing left to do can go back home now.”
Soon, those unrelated left the meeting room.
Now, only Hong Dali, his nine lackeys, and 10 plus editors were left behind.
Hong Dali asked, “I have one question to ask.
I plan to seek some authors.
You guys help and see if you have met someone like this before.”
“Young Master, please state your mind.” A bald-headed editor asked amidst the crowd.
“En, I want the kind that writes about fighting and killing; if you stare at me, I will beat you up; if you scold me, I will kill your whole family; those kinds.
Is there any?” Hong Dali’s eyes almost glowed to the point of being comparable to 200-watt lightbulbs—he depended on this kind of stuff to pass his time in class.
“This... this...” The editors were all violently wiping their sweat and staring at one another.
Finally, the bald-headed editor nervously said, “I did meet this kind of authors before.
I secretly remembered their names because of the novelty of their novels...”
“Really!?” Hong Dali’s spirits were finally lifted.
“What’s your position in the company now?”
Baldy replied, “Young Master, I’m the main editor of group one now.
My name is Tang Jinghui.”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers.
“From now on, you shall be the chief editor!” Upon hearing his words, a middle-aged man at the side shuddered.
Needless to say, he must be the previous chief editor, an ill-fortuned guy.
“These authors you’re talking about, recommend them to me.” Hong Dali said matter-of-factly.
“Let me see if they’re able to satisfy me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - Five Authors
paragraphs: Tang Jinghui carefully asked, “Then... if you’re satisfied, what should we do?”
Hong Dali touched his chin. “En, how do you guys ensure that the authors don’t quit halfway? Also commonly referred to as eunuch1?”

Tang Jinghui respectfully replied, “Normally, the method we use is the severance method. Meaning that we pay them for every thousand characters that they write. We will disregard the result of their novels, but just pay them according to the number of characters. The normal rate we are using now is 30 yuan for every thousand characters, and this is already slightly above average pay. If I offer this rate to them, it shouldn’t be a problem.”
“Ah, this is a good method.” Hong Dali immediately decided. “If their style of writing satisfies me, I will offer them a hundred yuan for every thousand characters.”

Oh my god, he hasn’t even read their novel but already decided to offer them such a high rate as long as their style of writing satisfies him? If the authors write 10,000 characters per day, that will earn them a thousand yuan in a single day—that means 30,000 yuan per month. That would definitely be the highest salary ever in the history of online authors!

Hearing the high rate that Hong Dali offered, Tang Jinghui broke out in sweat and reported: “These authors might write in the style you are looking for, but the performance of their novels are quite average. I reckon that 30 yuan for every thousand characters is already enough for them...”

Hong Dali was puzzled and asked, “What has the performance of their novels got to do with me? It’s just simply that I prefer this kind of novels. Since this is what I like, then I should pay them well to help them focus on their novels and not constantly paused their work, or totally quit after writing halfway. Just settle on the rate of a hundred yuan per thousand characters! If I’m satisfied with their novels, I will increase the rate!”

“Yes, yes.” Tang Jinghui secretly thought to himself: This is really the infamous prodigal. Just because he’s happy, he offers a rate of a hundred yuan per thousand characters, and will even increase the rate if he’s satisfied. That will mean a monthly income of tens of thousands, which is even more than what I’m earning. This makes me feel like becoming an author too.” Although that was what he was thinking, he couldn’t say that out loud. Instead, he said, “OK, I got it. En, the kind of authors that you are looking for, I know five of them.” Saying so, he took out a laptop from beside him. “Their pen names are: Dark Dragon of the Universe, Drunk Venom, Ultimate Sky Limit, Treasure Slayer, and Smile of the Vagrant.”
Yep, these authors are the ones I’m seeking. Just looking at their names, one can tell that they are filled with a murderous aura.
Hong Dali asked, “Then, what about their current works? Show them to me.”
Tang Jinghui replied, ” OK.”

Hong Dali looked at the laptop’s screen and said, “Ah, not bad. The story that this Dark Dragon of the Universe creates is filled with imagination. His words are simple, straightforward, and hot-blooded. I like it!” Although this was what he said, in his heart, he was utterly delighted. His style of writing is quite similar to that of the famous author Chen Dong from my previous life! I have found a treasure. I have something to look forward to reading now.
“O... OK...” Tang Jinghui wiped off his cold sweat. “Then how about the rest?”

“I’m looking at the quality of writing first, be patient.” Hong Dali opened up the novels of the other authors. He started reading from the first chapters and commended as he did so: “This is more like it, this kind of novel is more interesting. This is the way to do it, kill their entire family if they dare to scold me! Yep, correct, this is the effect I want, dominance! These are online novels, after all. How will they be welcomed if their story isn’t domineering! Yep, I like this novel from Ultimate Sky Limit, just eat those that they don’t like, awesome!

“Hahaha, the way this Dark Dragon of the Universe writes is quite interesting; one will be tempted to read the second chapter after the first one. His style of writing is also very hot-blooded. Look at this Drunk Venom. Look at how the main character retaliates—The tide changes with time, never look down on a young man just because he is poor. Awesome, this is the kind of effect I’m looking for. If one can’t feel invigorated from reading online novels, then what is the point of reading them at all?

“Look at this novel from Treasure Slayer, the flow of his story is nicely crafted. Every part of the story is connected to one another. What’s rarer is that his words are comfortable to read. This is what I call grasping the essence of online novels. The words don’t need to be elegant, as long as they are not tiring to look at and smooth to read, this kind of writing style is what I deem good.”
“This Smile of the Vagrant is not bad too... competition within the academy, good!”

Tang Jinghui was sweating bullets as he heard on. This young master’s taste is really different from a normal person. The literate works in this world have always sought elegance and magnificence, using various idioms just to express a single sentence. But to Hong Dali, these kinds of authors whose words are not beautifully crafted are what he admires. However, disregarding his true thoughts, he still had to agree with him on the outside. “Yep, Young Master’s comments make sense. Then, these few novels... should we really pay them at a rate of a hundred yuan per thousand characters? That will exceed our budget.”

Hong Dali immediately decided. “Yes, pay them at a rate of a hundred yuan per thousand characters! Ask their editors to inform them. I only have two conditions. Firstly, they’re not allowed to pause in between. Secondly, the story must be filled with content, not filled with meaningless words! As for the money, I will transfer three million over to the company for current usage.”

Tang Jinghui hurriedly took note of these two conditions. This was all money! As long as he could make this Young Master happy, money was not a problem at all! At this point, Hong Dali continued, “Oh right, there’s this novel called ‘Evil Spirit.’ I quite liked the story. Contact the author and offer him the rate of a hundred yuan per thousand characters too!”
Tianjing City, villa by Hong Lake in the southwest, villa no. 16.

“Damn it, I wonder what kind of dog shit luck this prodigal Hong Dali has got. He actually managed to create an artist with a value of more than 20 million yuan overnight.” Hong Anbao angrily lay on the sofa and scolded. “Why is he so fortunate, actually managing to get ahold of such a talent? How come I have never met such a good chance before!?”

“Just a lowly artist, there’s a limit to how much she can be worth.” Hong Anbao’s father, Hong Jianye, held a cup of red wine, one leg resting upon the other, and said, “What I’m more concerned with is that recently, I heard that Hong Weiguo bought quite a few pieces of land in the fourth loop. Anbao, what do you think of his actions?”

Hong Anbao scorned. “What use does that useless piece of land have? He only bought it because of that prodigal Hong Dali.” Saying this, Hong Anbao laughed. “Dad, after I sold away those estates, I have expanded my factory. The sales performance almost doubled during this period, and quite a number of buyers came to buy from my factory. I reckon that if I can expand it again before the family meeting and do some public relations, the sales performance can continue to double. If I’m lucky, this year’s profit might reach 40 plus million yuan!”

“Haha, good job!” Hong Jianye laughed loudly. “A profit of 40 plus million in a single year, this performance can rank amongst the top few in your generation. Not counting that business freak Mu Yuxi, I reckon that you can be ranked amongst the top three. Those elders will definitely allocate more resources to you and groom you. When that time comes, you can perform to the best of your abilities, hehe.”
Hong Anbao laughed loudly too and said, “Haha, that’s for sure. So what if Hong Dali has a good birthplace? He’s still a useless person who only knows how to squander.”

“Right.” Hong Jianye gave a cold smile. “Hong Weiguo might be a business genius, but it’s unfortunate that he doesn’t have someone capable of succeeding him. When the time comes and he becomes an elder, at least 90% of his estates will be taken back by the Hong family. What’s left will sooner or later be squandered away by that prodigal Dali. He is not a threat. Work hard and show off during the family meeting, Hong Weiguo’s money will become ours in the future!”
“I got it, Dad. Haha!”

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - Awesome Recipe for Prodigals
paragraphs: West fourth loop, Hung Lung Hotel.
Hong Dali, who just returned from Chenhui Building, was laying on a couch made of Chinese redbud wood, humming to himself and fishing at the newly dug pond.

Come to think of it, I was so occupied with other stuff these few days that I had totally forgotten about this hotel. Now that I remembered, it was indeed a good decision to come here. I can come here to fish, drink some beverages, and ask two female lackeys to massage my leg while doing it. What a pleasurable experience, brouhaha!

The pond was quite well built. It was 30 meters deep, surrounded by large rocks, and exuded an ancient feeling. A water circulation system was installed, and at the center was a three-meter tall waterfall. Coupled with a few slow-paced songs sang by Li Nianwei, it was undoubtedly a high-class experience fishing here.

Ling Xiaoyi came to Hong Dali’s side and softly asked, “Young Master, the sales performance of this place for these few days have been calculated. Would you like to take a look? It seems to be doing quite well.”
Hong Dali snorted. “No, just roughly tell me the result. I will just listen.”

“OK.” Being Hong Dali’s private housekeeper, Ling Xiaoyi naturally knew how to report things like this smoothly. “Currently, the gross profit per day for Hung Lung Hotel is about 16,000 yuan. Out of this, 7% came from ‘Who listens as the plum flowers fall to the jade flute’s tune,’ while ‘Fine Match Soup’ takes up... takes up... 34%.”
Hong Dali felt puzzled. “Oh? These two dishes made so much money?”

Ling Xiaoyi smiled and said, “I’m surprised as well. ‘Who listens as the plum flowers fall to the jade flute’s tune’ attracted many customers’ attention because its name sounds nice. As for ‘Fine Match Soup’...” This time, Ling Xiaoyi was really impressed with Hong Dali. “It’s because the story behind its name that you told us about was quite interesting. Therefore, many young people nearby who wish to be in a relationship came here to have a bowl of ‘Fine Match Soup.’ This is especially suitable for those young men who wish to confess but are not good with words. Under normal circumstances, after hearing the story about ‘Fine Match Soup,’ if the lady does not dislike the guy, she will drink the soup to show that she has accepted him. Therefore, ‘Fine Match Soup’ is quite well-known in the vicinity. Even though it costs 58 yuan per bowl, the supply still can’t keep up with the demand.”
“Oh...” Hong Dali touched his chin.My recipe for prodigals is actually so awesome? He suddenly asked, “Xiaoyi, who came up with the idea to promote ‘Fine Match Soup’ using this method?”
Ling Xiaoyi replied, “It was the lobby manager’s idea.”
“En, he’s quite capable.” Hong Dali directly waved his hand and said, “From now on, he shall be the general manager here.”
“O... OK.” Ling Xiaoyi wiped off her cold sweat. “Young Master, someone was asking to see you just now. He said he has a business to talk about with you.”
Hong Dali declined without a second thought. “No, I’m not seeing him. Can’t you see that I’m fishing? I don’t have the time to waste right now.”
“Er...” Ling Xiaoyi was dazed for a while before saying, “He says his business will need to spend a lot of money...”

“Really!?” Hong Dali’s spirits were immediately raised.Spending money is good. I’m just waiting for opportunities to spend money to earn some attribute points and to complete the mission right now. Such a good thing actually delivered itself to my doorstep? Hong Dali threw the fishing rod aside and said, “Ask him to come over!”

Shortly after, an impeccably attired middle-aged man carrying a briefcase walked over. He seemed to be about 40 years of age, was quite good-looking, and had hair combed to the point it shined—to the extent that a fly may slip and break its leg. Upon coming over, he bowed and said, “Greetings, Young Master Dali. I’m the general manager of Westwood Advertising. My name is Zhang Wuyang. Here is my name card.” Saying so, he opened his briefcase, took out a name card, and passed it to Hong Dali.
Hong Dali didn’t even take a look. He just placed it aside and asked, “You said you have a business proposition to discuss with me, so what it is? How much money will it cost?”

“It’s like this.” Zhang Wuyang’s voice was like a magnet, attracting quite a number of young female employees to look at them. “Our company has discovered a new business service that’s online operated. More specifically, one has to open an account, register to become a VIP member, and every day, click on the advertisement that we put up. Then, they receive a sum of money per month. It’s a really good service.”
“Ok, continue.” Hong Dali took a mouthful of his beverage. “How much will it cost?”

“Ah, we have divided the membership into nine different levels. The amount they need to invest and earn differs according to the different levels.” Zhang Wuyang explained in detail. “For a level one VIP membership, they only need to invest 200 yuan. Every month, they will receive 30 yuan. Therefore, after seven months, the money they receive will be pure profit. As for level two VIP membership, they need to invest 1,000 yuan and receive 160 yuan per month. Of course, the amount of investment needed for the first few levels is too low to suit your status. Starting from level seven, the amount of investment needed will increase drastically. For level seven, invest 300,000 yuan and receive 60,000 yuan per month. For level eight, invest one million yuan to receive 240,000 per month. As for the highest level, level nine, invest three million yuan to receive one million yuan per month.”

Speaking to this point, Zhang Wuyang took out a small notebook and placed it in front of Hong Dali. “Young Master Dali, this is our website. Please take a look. The business service and others are all inside.”

“Yep, this seems quite interesting.” Hong Dali played around for a while and mumbled. “Invest three million and receive one million per month? Is there a limit to how many months we will be receiving money?”
“There is no time limit, it is a lifelong membership for the highest leveled members.” Zhang Wuyang hurriedly explained.
“Where is this business service?” Hong Dali searched the website for quite a while. “How come I can’t find it?”

“It’s here.” Zhang Wuyang opened the link to enter the web page meant for VIP members and a pop-up appeared. On it, several small advertisements were neatly arranged in rows and columns, and each advertisement only took up a very small space. He then clicked on one and said, “Just like this, just click on all of the advertisements, and that will do it. It wouldn’t require much time, but the rewards are not bad. I know that Young Master Dali likes to... En, not interested in money. But there isn’t much harm having some extra income, right?”
“You’re right, there isn’t much harm in that.” Hong Dali snapped his fingers at the two male lackeys standing nearby. “The two of you, come here.”
The two male lackeys hurriedly came over. “Young Master, what’s the matter?”
Hong Dali sniffed and said, “Drag this fellow out and break his doglegs.”

The male lackey standing on the left gave a cold smile and looked at Zhang Wuyang’s left leg, then looked at his right leg. He excitedly squeezed his fist, madecracksounds and asked, “Young Master, how many legs should we break?”
“Three.” Hong Dali directly instructed.

Zhang Wuyang immediately broke out in cold sweat. As he was begin dragged out, he continuously shouted: “You can’t do this. Why do you want to beat me up? I’m here to make a business proposition! To make a business proposition!”
“This idiot.” Hong Dali laughed. “I may be a prodigal, but I’m not a moron. Even if he wants to bluff me, he should at least come up with something more professional.”
Xiaoyi was secretly laughing at the side.Those that think Young Master is a moron, they have all had their legs broken so far.
