Actually, one couldn’t blame Hong Dali.
After all, he didn’t really understand the way the Hong family’s meeting worked.
In his impression, even if he passed away, his own family’s assets should still belong to his parents.
The final rights to their assets should be controlled by his parents, not someone else.
But hearing Tang Muxin’s words today, Hong Dali instantly understood everything.
The reason that the Hong family could develop to this extent depended upon this rule—the reclaiming of assets.
Meaning to say, the assets in the Hong family would not flow out to outsiders regardless of whatever reason.
Their assets would only become more and more.
Allocating more resources to those capable of earning money and reclaiming assets from those without heirs was to ensure this point.
Because of this rule, it was particularly difficult for outsiders who wanted to seize the Hong family’s assets.
Those with children, their asset would go to their children.
From the looks of things, it seemed that the assets would only be passed to their male children and not females, or at least the difference in proportion would be quite large.
As for those without children, the Hong family would reclaim their assets.
This way, outsiders who planned to join the Hong family through marriage then secretly plot against the members of the Hong family in order to obtain their assets would find this method impossible.

This should have been a good thing, but now that it happened upon himself, it didn’t seem to be a good thing anymore—at least now that his body had recovered, this news indeed had to be kept a secret.
The cooked duck had flown away; anyone would be unhappy about this.
One did need to fear a thief who had stolen but a thief who planned to steal.
Hong Dali didn’t wish to constantly be on the alert fearing a killer who might suddenly appear on the street, wanting to take his life.
After all, a real death soldier was definitely capable of killing him then committing suicide.
Thinking of this, Hong Dali felt his body go cold and broke out in cold sweat.
He softly said, “Thank you for your reminder, Xinxin.
But, why are you telling me this?
Didn’t you always dislike me?”
“Did you that I disliked you without reason?” Tang Muxin humphed and said, “Towards a prodigal, any normal person will not have any liking towards them, OK?
Furthermore, whatever the case, you’re still my fiancé in name.
It isn’t much of a big deal for me to help you.” Speaking of this, Tang Muxin’s small face blushed, and she humphed in mosquito-level tone.
“Who will be willing to have a prodigal for a husband...”
Alright.
Hong Dali’s impression of Tang Muxin instantly improved by a great deal.
Although this little lass constantly went against me, the main reason was that she wanted to lead me back onto the correct path.
Unfortunately, this is something that is destined to be impossible—if I don’t squander, I won’t be able to obtain attribute points.
If I don’t obtain attribute points, I won’t be able to become a true man.
This is really an unsolvable puzzle, Hong Dali thought to himself.
Although this was what he thought in his mind, he couldn’t speak the truth to her.
Hong Dali instantly changed the topic.
“OK, I know what to do now.
Oh right.
Xinxin, tonight after school, I will go fetch you to go and film the movie, OK?
The low-cost movieUnexpectedly, Dali Creates Miracles!
This micro movie will only cost about 10,000 yuan per episode.
It’s very easy.”
“That’s more like it!” Hearing that Hong Dali finally didn’t want to squander so much, Tang Muxin deeply felt that her efforts weren’t in vain.
“Then, I shall wait for you in my classroom after school ends.
You must remember to come and find me.
Since we have agreed on it, you can’t go back on your word!”
“OK!” Just as Hong Dali agreed, his expression suddenly changed.
He didn’t regret it, just that his intestines went green.Oh crap, what is my house’s Xinxin’s class number?
My god, where am I supposed to go find her after school!?
Luckily, Hong Dali was after all Hong Dali, he still had some quick thinking in him.
When they returned back to school, Hong Dali pretended to sleep for the lesson.
Then, he messaged Xiaoyi: [Xiaoyi, help me find a student and ask about how my house’s Xinxin is doing in class.
See if anyone is bullying her or something.]
Unsurprisingly, Ling Xiaoyi wasn’t in the least suspicious that Hong Dali was totally clueless of what Tang Muxin’s classroom number was.
She only asked: [Young Master, what’s the matter?
Is Young Madam facing some problem?]
Hong Dali: [No, I just wish to understand her situation, in case someone is bullying her in class and I didn’t know about it.
That would be embarrassing.
After all, she’s my fiancée, isn’t she?
OK, actually, I just want to know if there’s anyone in school harboring any intentions towards her.]
Ling Xiaoyi: [Yep, understood.] Shortly after, Ling Xiaoyi sent him the information of Tang Muxin’s life in school.
[Young Madam is in the second year third class, which is the key class of Tianjing College.
All of the students in this class belong to those with excellent grades; their main objective is to study, no one bullied her.
Also, Young Madam’s grades are very good, and she rarely talks to male students.
Even when she occasionally talks to them, it’s regarding questions about their study.
Currently, other than the Liu family’s Liu Mingcheng who always had ideas about Young Madam, the rest of them are behaving very well.
I didn’t find anyone with any special case.]
Hong Dali: [OK, now I can feel relieved.]
OK, that settles it.
Tang Muxin is in the second year third class, her grades are excellent, and only Liu Mingcheng, that moron, has ideas about her.
In any case, I’m destined to have a battle with Liu Mingcheng in the future.
Whatever ideas he harbors about Tang Muxin is of no importance—Tang Muxin will definitely not take a liking to Liu Mingcheng.Hong Dali was quite sure of this point.
Finally, school ended.
Hong Dali carried his schoolbag and slowly strolled to the door of the second year third class.
As expected, Tang Muxin was reading a book in the classroom.
Hong Dali couldn’t make out what book it was due to the distance, just that it was a really thick one.
This caused Hong Dali to feel impressed even without knowing what it was about.
“Cough cough, Xinxin, I’m here.” There wasn’t anyone else in the classroom.
Thus, Hong Dali smilingly walked over to her side.
“What book are you reading?
So hardworking, you’re so focused even after school ended?”

“Oh, nothing much, I’m just reading up on the history of ancient China.” Tang Muxin flipped over the book, displaying the cover which showed “Records of the Three Kingdoms” in big font, and beside it was a line of small characters that said: “Explanation in plain text.”
“You like The Three Kingdoms?” Hong Dali was quite surprised that Tang Muxin would read up on The Three Kingdoms.

“I never expect that you would like The Three Kingdoms, let me think... yep, if my house’s Xinxin were to be sent to The Three Kingdoms, your beauty would definitely be on the same level as Diao Chan1!”
“You’re wrong.” Tang Muxin proudly said, “Dian Chan is too weak.
If I were to go there, I would at least be a female Lu Bu2!”
OK...” Hong Dali wiped off his cold sweat.
“Next time when we’re free, I shall film a movie where you will portray a female Lu Bu.
Gorgeous wars and epic battles, the optimal choice to burn money.”
“You’re planning to squander again!” Tang Muxin instantly changed the topic.
“I’m hungry, let’s go eat now.
Then go and filmUnexpectedly!”
“OK, whatever you say.”
The two of them immediately left the school building.
Same as always, one at the front and one at the back.
Just that this time, the distance between them was slightly nearer compared to last time—if the original distance between them was two meters, their distance apart now was about 1.9 meters...
After dinner, they sat on Hong Dali’s Soaring Angel and went directly to Chenhui Building.
But when they reached there, both of them were astonished.
The plaza in front of Chenhui Building was filled with young men and women.
Quite a lot of them were holding up signboards written with: “Li Nianwei, I love you!”, “Weiwei, my goddess!”, “My goddess, I want to be married to you!”.
Hong Dali casually glanced around and estimated that about 3,000 plus people were crowding the small space.
Hong Dali’s mucus almost flowed out from his nose.
“What... what situation is this!?”

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - Liu Mingxin
paragraphs: These people present were all screaming at the top of their lungs, their voice comparable to that of Vitas from his previous life, all screaming the same words: “Weiwei, I love you!”

Hong Dali watched on with a pain in his testis. The entrance to the building was totally blocked by the crowd, how was he supposed to go in? He instantly took out his phone and called Zhang Cai. “Sister Cai, we have reached the ground floor. Can you think of a way for us to get in?” Although the grandeur of his group was sky high, it still seemed lacking when facing these die-hard fans.

Over on the other side of the phone, Zhang Cai stuck her head out of the window upon hearing these words and instantly saw the four cars belonging to Hong Dali and high group. She replied, “OK, I will be sending people down to bring Young Master and Young Madam in. But there are really too many people downstairs, it may be a bit difficult.”
“Just try your best.” Hong Dali helplessly said.

Having experienced similar things in his previous life, Hong Dali could best understand the power of die-hard fans—he didn’t have a single doubt that he would be trampled to death if he got off from his car. They wouldn’t care if he were a Young Master or an ordinary high school student, all those who interfered in them looking at their idol would be their arch-enemy! Especially in this kind of place which was packed with people. Furthermore, Hong Dali couldn’t be sure whether someone harboring dark intentions towards him was hiding in the crowd.

If there really were people from the Hong family jealous of him or rivals of the Hong family who wanted to strike out at the Hong family, and they knew that he would be coming here, they might specially arrange a few people undercover in the crowd. Once he got off the car and the crowd squeezed around him, it was of no importance whether he had nine lackeys or ninety. The only result was would probably be pushed to the ground once the crowd rushed toward them.
Therefore, the best solution now was to wait and see how things went.

While he was feeling melancholy, a blue super-sports car came up from the side, its appearance full of dynamism. Although Hong Dali was unfamiliar with the cars in this world, he could still tell that the value of this car was on par with the Prayer Angels that his lackeys drove.

Accompanied by the roar of the engine, the super-sports car slowly stopped outside the crowd below Chenhui Building. The back door of the car was then lightly pushed open, and an invincibly handsome, cool young man carrying a confident smile got off from the car.

He seemed to be around 25 or 26 years old, was wearing a well-ironed dark purple western-style suit, a concentric mechanical man’s watch embedded with diamonds, and a sky-blue shirt of an unknown brand with the first button unbuttoned. Overall, he portrayed the appearance of composure mixed with a bit of naughtiness.

A pair of slender red phoenix eyes slightly narrowed, a slightly tilted aquiline nose, and thin lips tightly pressed together, all exuding a fatal attraction towards women. A headful of slightly long hair coupled with his somewhat evil glance caused him to be filled with an air of danger.

When he got off the car, the surrounding crowd suddenly went silent, then came a scream that pierced through the clouds. “AH——!!! It’s Liu Mingxin! The Liu family’s Big Young Master Liu Mingxin!” “Oh my heavens, he is too handsome, I... I can’t take it anymore!” “It’s Big Young Master Liu Mingxin! Is he a fan of Weiwei too?” “Look, look, he’s carrying a bouquet of roses! Is he going to confess his love to Weiwei? That must be the case, it must be!”

Facing the screams from the people around him, Liu Mingxin’s mouth slightly tilted upwards, creating a slight smile with a pinch of evilness. His handsomeness was to the extent that it could shock the heavens and shake the earth, causing the female fans around him to immediately faint. Hong Dali watched from his car, scorned and humphed. “I can tell he’s a gigolo with just a single look.”

Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin couldn’t help but laugh till her eyes tilted upwards like a crescent moon, She said, “Hee hee, could it be that you’re jealous of him after seeing that he’s more handsome than you? Yep, speaking of which, you’re indeed slightly less handsome than him.”
“Who says that I’m jealous!” Hong Dali humphed angrily and said, “Isn’t he just a little bit more handsome than me? What’s the big deal about that?”

Tang Muxin looked outside again and suddenly said, “Then, I have to remind you. He’s the biological older brother of Liu Mingcheng. His name is Liu Mingxin, the Big Young Master of the Liu family and the successor of the Liu Corporation. He’s definitely a business tycoon, a talent that is rarely found in a hundred years. It was said that he took 50 million from his family and used it to develop to an asset of 400 million in less than four years, shocking the chins off an uncountable number of people. From the looks of it, he came today for Sister Nianwei.”

“The older brother of Liu Mingcheng?” Hearing Tang Muxin’s words, Hong Dali immediately had a deep understanding of the phrase: “The nine sons of the Dragon are all different.” Liu Mingcheng was just a standard second-generation ancestor who strutted around lying to the higher-ups and bullying the weak. His brother, instead, appeared to be talented and striking. This was really... Hong Dali murmured, “Are you sure that he’s their biological son?”
Pu! Tang Muxin coughed violently. Whilst coughing, she said, “Dali, these words of yours are really sinister, cough cough, too malicious!”

“Whatever the case, he’s a foe, not a friend, why must I be so polite for?” Hong Dali gave a cold laugh and said, “His younger brother was beaten down and got his car smashed by me in public. And now, after just a short period, he came personally to seduce Sister Nianwei to checkmate me?”

Hong Dali’s words weren’t wrong, Li Nianwei could be said to be entirely groomed by him. Now that her net worth had increased sharply, once she was pulled over by his rivals, Hong Dali would lose his face greatly. Not only that, once this really happened, Turkey Company would hire a few public writers to hype this news without constraint. By that time, the entire Hong family’s face would be thrown away by him.

One had to admit, this move of Liu Mingxin was really sinister. It was akin to hitting the snake at its weak spot. What was more clever of him was that Hong Dali couldn’t oppose him openly—after all, this was an era labeled “freedom of love.”
Softly sucking in a breath, Liu Mingxin was quite satisfied with the atmosphere he created.
At the same time, he didn’t forget to look back at Hong Dali’s position and give a slight smile, carrying with him an air of easiness, his pretentious behavior really exceeding the sky’s limits.
“He really thinks highly of himself.” Hong Dali gave a cold laugh. “Is it that he thinks he will definitely succeed?”

“Aren’t you in the least worried?” Tang Muxin asked curiously. “He’s the Big Young Master of the Liu family, a real Young Master of a prestigious family. Not only is he handsome, but he is also talented. To be honest, being publicly proposed to by him, even I’m not sure whether Sister Nianwei will be moved by him.”
At this moment, Ling Xiaoyi, who was sitting at the last row, carefully asked, “Young Master, should we alight now? This matter, I’m afraid...”
“Of course, we shouldn’t alight.” Unexpectedly, Hong Dali said in a very natural tone. “Wait for Sister Cai to disperse the crowd, there is no need no rush.”
“OK, I understand.” Upon hearing Hong Dali’s words, Ling Xiaoyi immediately replied.

But Tang Muxin was getting nervous. “Dali, did you hear what I just said? Are you really not in the least worried that Sister Nianwei will be moved by him? If Sister Nianwei really goes with him, your losses will definitely not just be a highly valued celebrity, but a loss of face for your entire Hong family! The celebrity that you personally groomed becoming someone else’s—if that happens, you have no idea what other people will say of you!”
“Since I’m not nervous, what are you nervous for?” Hong Dali laughingly replied. “My Sister Nianwei isn’t that kind of person.”

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - A Trick Within a Trick
paragraphs: “How can I not be nervous at a time like this?” This time, Tang Muxin was really nervous. “You’re betting everything on Sister Nianwei’s moral quality? No, you can’t do that. One’s moral quality is the least reliable thing in this world. Open the door, I want to get out!”

She tried to open the car door as she spoke, but Hong Dali dragged her back tightly. However, even though Hong Dali’s health attribute points were maxed out, his strength attribute was still low. Hong Dali was dragged back and forth by Tang Muxin as she struggled. He continuously shouted, “Have you watched The Three Kingdoms for nothing? Can’t you tell this is a plot? It’s so obvious. Stop now, or I’m going to end up in tragedy.”

“Plot? What plot?” Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin finally calmed down. In fact, whether Li Nianwei stayed by Hong Dali’s side or left with Liu Mingxin, it had nothing to do with her. Furthermore, from a woman’s point of view, she also did not wish for a second woman to hang around Hong Dali, especially a pretty one, even though she did not plan to marry Hong Dali.

However, she just couldn’t stand seeing Hong Dali being bullied. Now that Liu Mingxin deliberately made a move against him, Tang Muxin immediately stood by his side without a single hint of hesitation.

“Phew, you almost shook me to death.” Hong Dali didn’t have any negative feelings towards Tang Muxin’s rashness just now. After all, she was only trying to protect him, just that her intelligence level seemed to have dropped. After taking in a few deep breaths, Hong Dali slowly said, “How obvious the plot is today? Don’t you think it’s weird how there suddenly seems to be so many excited fans here?”

Tang Muxin looked around. The fans were starting to hold up their signboards again, continuously shooting Li Nianwei’s name. It seemed normal, but very quickly, Tang Muxin found some clues and said, “Speaking of which, the number of fans here today seem more numerous than normal, and their expression seems to show that they’re much more fanatical than normal fans.”

Hong Dali smilingly said, “Exactly. This Liu Mingxin is indeed quite capable. He can be said to be cunning and vicious. I have noticed from the start that many of the fans here are acting weirdly. Ever since we arrived, they keep looking at us. Also, it’s quite obvious that they have moved closer to us.” Speaking to this point, Hong Dali pouted his lips towards where Liu Mingxin was standing. “Look at Liu Mingxin, have you noticed that the fans around him are mostly female, and their distance from him is quite far?”

“Yep, I have noticed that now.” Tang Muxin looked meticulously, and quickly said, “Those females are surrounding him, seemingly protecting him from those frantic fans. Also, they’re constantly peeking at us!”

“That’s right.” Hong Dali gave a cold laugh and said, “Therefore, I guess that there is quite a number of people here that were sent by Liu Mingxin. Humph, on the surface, he’s here to propose his love to Li Nianwei. But in reality, his aim is to lure me out of the car. Once I alight, and his people shout ‘Young Master Dali is here’ and surge towards us, we might get trampled to death if we’re unprepared. But If I don’t alight, he can make his pretense real by proposing his love for Li Nianwei in front of me. This is what is called an eye for an eye! This Liu Mingxin is really something, killing two birds with one stone. This trick within a trick of his is really something.”

Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin felt a cold air flowing through from her feet to her head, her scald going numb. Carefully pondering his words, the truth might really be what Hong Dali said. She went blank for a while, and suddenly asked in a curious tone, “Dali, how did you become so smart today? Could it be that you’re possessed by Zhu Geliang’s ghost1?”
Hong Dali helplessly said, “I’m a prodigal, not a fool, OK? Why are you equating a prodigal to a fool?”
“OK, OK, my fault.” This was the first time that Tang Muxin lowered her head in front of Hong Dali. “Then, what do you think we should do now?”

Hong Dali grinned. “Isn’t that simple? We shall use the rule of using no change to counter all kinds of changes. Once Sister Cai brings reporters and security guards down with her, the first setup of Liu Mingxin will be spoiled. Even this Liu Mingxin will not have the courage to cause a stampede in front of a group of reporters and security guards. Then—” Hong Dali eerily said, “It’s time to witness a miracle!”
“So... so scary!” Looking at Hong Dali’s expression, Tang Muxin sucked in a cold breathe.

As expected, it was just as Hong Dali had said. After about five minutes or so, the manager Zhang Cai led a big group of reporters and security guards out from Chenhui Building’s entrance. Protected in the middle of this group of reporters and security guards stood a beautiful lady in a white dress. Who else could it be but Li Nianwei?
“Weiwei! I love you!”
“Weiwei, my Goddess!”

The excited fans immediately started to roar and scream when this group of people appeared. The noise level really skyrocketed above the limits of the sky. Having been a manager of celebrities for so many years, Zhang Cai understood how scary fans could be. She hurriedly instructed the security guards to separate the road, creating a space for Hong Dali’s car to move.
Liu Mingxin frowned, then gradually relaxed. He had arranged an entire set of a trick within a trick. But from the looks of things, his first plot had failed.

Very quickly, the crowd split apart. Liu Mingxin carried the bouquet of roses and gradually stepped forward. He first smiled at Zhang Cai, then said, “Hi, my name is Liu Mingxin.” He had a handsome face and an elegant and graceful carriage. Seeing him, Zhang Cai obviously went blank for a while before nodding and said, “Hello, hello, I have heard of you. You’re the Big Young Master from the Liu Corporation, am I right?”

“You speak too highly of me, just calling me Mingxin will do.” Liu Mingxin pushed aside the reporters and finally stood in front of Li Nianwei. “The prettiest of flowers for the prettiest lady. I hope that Lady Nianwei will not be ceremonious with me.” He slightly bowed as he spoke, making his greeting.

He already had a handsome face and an air of elegant grace, and his status was also grand. Now, seeing how gentlemanly he was, the surrounding fans instantly screamed, with quite a number of young female fans so excited that they collapsed.

Facing such a scene, any normal girl’s heart would definitely start pumping madly. Li Nianwei was a normal girl; therefore, she was quite surprised too and felt her heartbeat going faster. However, she didn’t accept the bouquet, but instead lightly shook her head and rejected him. “I’m very sorry, but I can’t accept it. Sorry for causing you to waste money.”

He didn’t force her, but instead placed the bouquet in Zhang Cai’s hands and said, “En, I understand what you mean. After all, this is our first meeting, it was impudent of me. Liu Mingxin was still planning to say something, but he heard a languid voice behind him. “Don’t bother wasting your saliva, my Big Young Master Liu Mingxin.”

Can’t you tell this is a plot?
It’s so obvious.
Stop now, or I’m going to end up in tragedy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - The Story About One Dollar
paragraphs: Who, but Hong Dali, could say that at a moment like this?

Liu Mingxin turned around to look at him and smiled briefly. “So it’s Young Master Dali. I heard Young Master Dali has always been weak. Do you feel better recently?” It might be obvious that both of them were not friends, but Liu Mingxin was clearly more magnanimous than his younger brother, Liu Mingcheng. Regardless of how they fought under the table, Liu Mingxin displayed the necessary etiquette towards Hong Dali.

“Thank you for your concern.” Hong Dali sniffed. The nine lackeys followed behind him as he held Tang Muxin’s hand and walked to Li Nianwei’s side. Smiling, he said, “I guess I should not die within the next one or two years.” As he spoke, he took the bouquet of flowers from Zhang Cai, threw Liu Mingxin’s name card away, and beamed as he handed it to Li Nianwei. “Sister Nianwei, these flowers are pretty. You can have them.”
Watching Hong Dali’s actions, Liu Mingxin’s pupils contracted.

Liu Mingxin’s flowers were for Li Nianwei, but she didn’t accept them, and just handed them over to her manager, Zhang Cai. All that trouble he took came to nothing. He felt terrible. However, there was nothing he could do since Hong Dali was younger, in addition to being thin and frail.

“Thank you, Young Master.” Li Nianwei giggled and accepted the bouquet of roses from Hong Dali. “Young Master, it’s windy outside. Let’s talk inside.” Her relationship with Hong Dali was not easily understood by outsiders. Only those within the team would know the reasons behind it.

Li Nianwei was a very smart lady. She knew what she had to do when she saw Liu Mingxin. Liu Mingxin’s was undeniably desirable. He was handsome, poised, rich, and came from a good background. He was the perfect lover of every woman, the prince among princes. But Li Nianwei knew, in terms of importance, ten Liu Mingxins could not be compared to one Hong Dali.

There was no hate for no reason in this world, neither was there love without reason. From the moment both met, Hong Dali had treated Li Nianwei like his elder sister. And Li Nianwei willingly protected the weak and frail Hong Dali like a little brother.
The love between siblings, though simple, was strong.
Li Nianwei knew how serious the consequences would be if she left him. Hence, she rejected Liu Mingxin decisively without hesitation.

The reporters did not hesitate when they saw Li Nianwei accepting the roses from Hong Dali. The flashlights from the cameras were comparable to the lightning on a stormy night. At almost ten flashes per second, everything around was lit up. They hadn’t come for nothing. This piece of news was sure to hit the headlines without a doubt.

The surrounding fans went crazy! They did not know how to react faced with a scene like this. A goddess like Li Nianwei accepting roses from a man. This was big news. Though those two did not seem like a couple, that made them very excited. But in the end, they could only turn their excitement to screams for Li Nianwei. “Weiwei, I love you!” “Weiwei, good job!” “That’s my goddess, you did well!”
Facing these fanatical fans, Li Nianwei smiled and bowed gracefully. “Thank you for your concern. Thank you.”
“Nianwei.” Liu Mingxin should have left feeling defeated, but he did not show any unhappiness. He asked, “You and Young Master Dali are not lovers, right?”
In an instant, the surroundings became quiet. He was not the only curious one. Everyone was waiting for Li Nianwei’s answer.

Li Nianwei prepared to speak but did not know how to respond to that question. If she said yes, it would be a lie. If she said no, that would let Liu Mingxin think that he still stood a chance. While she hesitated, Tang Muxin responded, “What has their relationship got to do with you? It’s none of your business!”
It was clear that Tang Muxin was on Hong Dali’s side. She did not mince her words. The decision was to fight together against others, everything else could be discussed later.
Hearing Tang Muxin, Liu Mingxin broke into a smile. “Um, I understand. That means I still stand a chance.”

“No, there are no chances for you.” Hong Dali turned out his pockets and found nothing. Finally, he took out a shiny dollar coin from Tang Muxin’s pocket and placed on his palm. He stretched out his hand toward Li Nianwei, smiling. “Sister Nianwei, shall I provide for you in the future?” He sniffed. “I’m poor, I only have a dollar left...”
In front of everyone, and through the lens of the reporters’ cameras, Li Nianwei gently stretched out her hand and took the one dollar coin. She smiled and said, “Okay.”

Today’s plan was a complete failure, but Liu Mingxin did not feel one bit defeated. Instead, he got excited and looked at Hong Dali. “Haha, I admit my loss. I underestimated you. Um. In that case, I shall not bother you further. We shall meet again soon.”
He bowed gracefully at Li Nianwei before he turned to board his car, leaving at his own pace.

This old man is not easy to handle. Watching Liu Mingxin’s car disappear in the horizon, Hong Dali ruffled his hair. “He’s elegant, eligible, and shrewd too. Dealing with an opponent like that is hard. The brothers are born to the same parents, but why are they so different?”
The world went mad.

Within half an hour, the number of searches on Sangle soared by 5%. The new age keyword was “one dollar.” In two hours, there were 134,156,715 searches. The entire internet was discussing the mystery young master who wanted to provide for Li Nianwei with one dollar. Naturally, as someone who was not within the entertainment circle, Hong Dali’s faced was blurred out.
To provide for someone with just one dollar, the impact of this news was divided into three extremities.

The first view was how Li Nianwei was indeed the new age goddess. Her response to a gentleman’s expression of love was elegant. Although she had rejected him, the way she rejected was ingenious. Especially the one dollar. Who would think that Li Nianwei would accept the proposal of being provided for with just one dollar? And she actually agreed on the spot. In an instant, she had become Master Hong Dali’s mistress. That was hard for anyone not to back off.

The second view was that, although Hong Dali only gave Li Nianwei one dollar, what Li Nianwei was after was Hong Dali’s entire fortune. But most people did not agree with this. In all aspects, Liu Mingxin was clearly better than Hong Dali. One was a prince, and the other was a squanderer. There was nothing else that needed to be compared.

The third view was that Li Nianwei had taken this opportunity to indirectly reject all pursuers and concentrate on her career. She had handled the situation so well with Liu Mingxin. Many fans concluded that not only was Li Nianwei a goddess, but she was also the goddess of wisdom.
Of course, no matter what anyone said, the common understanding was that Li Nianwei’s worth had risen once again.

“Liu Mingxin came in time, creating publicity for Sister Nianwei for free. He must be the reincarnation of the money god.” Hong Dali propped the pillow against Li Nianwei’s thigh and adjusted himself so it was comfortable. “Let’s rest for a while. Later on, we will start filmingUnexpectedly!”

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - Dont Stop The Medicine!
paragraphs: Chenhui Building, level 9, Caiwei Entertainment, in the recording studio.
Ling Xiaoyi started with the introduction. “This program is brought to you by...”
A lackey with a deeper voice continued, “Prodigal League...” Followed by Hong Dali: “I want to spend freely, I want to squander!”
Ling Xiaoyi continued, “And also...”
The same lackey said, “Tang’s Pharmaceutical...” And then it was Tang Muxin’s turn: “Don’t stop taking the medication!”
With the closure done by Ling Xiaoyi: “Sponsored and broadcasted.”

After the introduction, a group of people around were rolling on the floor laughing. Zhang Cai could not even lift her head. Li Nianwei covered her mouth as she giggled. Even Tang Muxin, who had just finished reading her line, could not stop laughing.

Ling Xiaoyi, who was the leader of the lackeys, could not hold back any longer and burst out laughing. “Young Master is too good at playing tricks. I’m certain that before the movie even starts, the introduction will send everyone into fits of laughter.”
Tang Muxin: “I have just realized how talented Dali is at making others laugh. Hahaha, it’s too funny.”

At this moment, Hong Dali maintained his dorky expression while looking at the laughing staff members. “It was just a few lines, was it really so funny? I’m not well-read, don’t laugh just to appease me!”

Tang Muxin tried to catch her breath while laughing. “No, no. Hong Dachui. Oh, no. Wang Dali. Oh, no. Hong Dali, what should we do next? The introductory lines are done. Is it time for the title song?”
“That’s right!” Hong Dali started to sing: “Everyone, sing with me. Unexpectedly, my principles are gone...”
“Unexpectedly, my principles are gone!”
Right after singing this verse, everyone started laughing again.
“Alright.” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders, defeated. “I must be doing something wrong. You’re all too easily amused.”
Another round of laughter ensued.

Finally, the big sister Li Nianwei spoke up: “Okay. Stop laughing everyone. Let’s hear the Young Master’s script. We will record what we can now. Young Master did say that we will be broadcasting one episode per week.”

“Yes, yes, yes. Everyone gather around.” A group of people gathered joyfully beside Hong Dali. Hong Dali coughed and cleared his throat, then spoke with a serious tone, “This episode is named Low-Cost Martial Arts Drama. It tells a story about a beautiful princess who was captured by the demon king. The male lead is a hero who is full of justice and saved the princess.”
After hearing Hong Dali summarize the storyline, Tang Muxin doubtfully said, “There’s... nothing special about this. There are many martial arts movies and dramas with similar plots.”
The others nodded their heads in unison.
Hong Dali nodded too. “That’s right.”
He admitted shamelessly!

Hong Dali continued, “At the beginning, my lines are ‘My name is Dang Dachui, and I’m an actor. I’m currently starring in a Low-Cost Martial Arts Drama.’” As he spoke, his mouth was slightly ajar, his eyes dazed, and expressionless. Together with his lines, it created a comical scene.
Tang Muxin held in her laughter and asked, “And?”
Hong Dali held up the plastic sword. “And? This is my weapon!”
Everyone was shocked. So was Tang Muxin. “Dali, you didn’t squander this time. You didn’t get an antique sword that costs hundreds of thousands?”

Hong Dali looked at Tang Muxin. “That’s right. My next line is ‘This is too low-budget. This is just a toy sword!?’” Hong Dali started to imitate the sound of the weapon illuminating. “Ding! At a time like this, we need cool special effects. The sword must shimmer and illuminate! Then I will say, ‘This sword is too lousy, yet it shines and illuminates?’”

As he spoke, he swung the sword about. It was not a tough movie to make. A few lines were enough to send the audience into bouts of laughter. Hong Dali called out a lackey with a soft voice to prance around while pinching his throat and read out the lines: “I have no regrets in my career. When I thought about running under the sunset that day, it was just like my youth fading away...” Everyone was rolling on the floor laughing. Some could not even pick themselves up. Even the gentle and elegant big-sister-like Li Nianwei was laughing while covering her mouth.

When Hong Dali had finished describing the contents of the episode, Tang Muxin’s eyes lit up like a 200-volt lightbulb. She grabbed and shook Hong Dali’s arm. “Chuichui, can we come here every day after school to film this movie? Can we? Can we? Can we?”
Her delicate voice charmed everyone.

Seems like I will have to change my name to Chuichui...There was no way Hong Dali could resist Tang Muxin’s gentle voice. He surrendered decisively. “Okay, okay, okay. We will come here after school every day. Just that this doesn’t allow me to squander much.” Hong Dali couldn’t squander much with this movie even if he tried. That made Hong Dali very concerned. Thankfully, there was still The Gale Flash and Zhong Dian website to count on. He would have to think of a few more ideas on the gale flash to squander fifteen million in one month; it should be easy. Hong Dali expressed satisfaction in his thoughts.
Just at this moment, Li Nianwei softly asked, “Young Master, we know the plot now. Where will be the shooting the scenes? Since it’s to be a martial arts drama, we can’t film it here, right?”
Shooting scenes? Hong Dali rubbed his chin in deep thought. Ling Xiaoyi, who was standing beside, reminded him. “Young Master, how about the mountain beside Fengyuan Lake? That should work.”
Fengyuan Lake. There are mountains and water, and the scenery is nice and quiet. It’s indeed a good place.

“Ah, that place...” Hong Dali was about to agree when a thought flashed by his mind. “No way! How could I miss such a chance to squander! I recall the mountain near Fengyuan Lake is just a stone’s throw from the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain...” Hong Dali suddenly said, “I have decided! We will look for a good place!”
“Where?!” The surrounding people were curious.

“On the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain!” Hong Dali laughed heartily. “There are not many chances to squander for this micro movie. Let’s do it from the shooting scene! I have decided. Let’s buy the land outside of Tianjing Mountain, and set it up so that it’s suitable for our filming. In the future, we will use that place forUnexpectedly!”

“Oh my god...” Tang Muxin covered her face. “You’re going to spend millions, or even tens of millions to buy a piece of land just to make a micro movie that costs barely hundreds of thousands?!” It’s no wonder Tang Muxin was upset. To rent the mountain would only cost tens of thousand for a whole year. But it was a different matter entirely to purchase it. It would take at least hundreds of thousands to buy Tianjing Mountain since it was near the city.
To make such a big decision just to make a micro movie that cost mere hundreds of thousands, especially to purchase a mountain that could not be developed, was really an extravagant move to squander!
“That’s right!” Hong Dali laughed. “We shall do just that! Xiaoyi, I don’t care how you do it, but that mountain belongs to me in future!”

Ling Xiaoyi started with the introduction.
“This program is brought to you by...”
A lackey with a deeper voice continued, “Prodigal League...” Followed by Hong Dali: “I want to spend freely, I want to squander!”
Ling Xiaoyi continued, “And also...”
The same lackey said, “Tang’s Pharmaceutical...” And then it was Tang Muxin’s turn: “Don’t stop taking the medication!”
With the closure done by Ling Xiaoyi: “Sponsored and broadcasted.”
After the introduction, a group of people around were rolling on the floor laughing.
Zhang Cai could not even lift her head.
Li Nianwei covered her mouth as she giggled.
Even Tang Muxin, who had just finished reading her line, could not stop laughing.
Ling Xiaoyi, who was the leader of the lackeys, could not hold back any longer and burst out laughing.
“Young Master is too good at playing tricks.
I’m certain that before the movie even starts, the introduction will send everyone into fits of laughter.”
Tang Muxin: “I have just realized how talented Dali is at making others laugh.
Hahaha, it’s too funny.”
At this moment, Hong Dali maintained his dorky expression while looking at the laughing staff members.
“It was just a few lines, was it really so funny?
I’m not well-read, don’t laugh just to appease me!”
Tang Muxin tried to catch her breath while laughing.
“No, no.
Hong Dachui.
Oh, no.
Wang Dali.
Oh, no.
Hong Dali, what should we do next?
The introductory lines are done.
Is it time for the title song?”
“That’s right!” Hong Dali started to sing: “Everyone, sing with me.
Unexpectedly, my principles are gone...”
“Unexpectedly, my principles are gone!”
Right after singing this verse, everyone started laughing again.
“Alright.” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders, defeated.
“I must be doing something wrong.
You’re all too easily amused.”
Another round of laughter ensued.
Finally, the big sister Li Nianwei spoke up: “Okay.
Stop laughing everyone.
Let’s hear the Young Master’s script.
We will record what we can now.
Young Master did say that we will be broadcasting one episode per week.”
“Yes, yes, yes.
Everyone gather around.” A group of people gathered joyfully beside Hong Dali.

It tells a story about a beautiful princess who was captured by the demon king.
The male lead is a hero who is full of justice and saved the princess.”
After hearing Hong Dali summarize the storyline, Tang Muxin doubtfully said, “There’s... nothing special about this.
There are many martial arts movies and dramas with similar plots.”
The others nodded their heads in unison.
Hong Dali nodded too.

He admitted shamelessly!

Together with his lines, it created a comical scene.

Hong Dali held up the plastic sword.

This is my weapon!”
Everyone was shocked.
So was Tang Muxin.
“Dali, you didn’t squander this time.
You didn’t get an antique sword that costs hundreds of thousands?”
Hong Dali looked at Tang Muxin.

My next line is ‘This is too low-budget.
This is just a toy sword!?’” Hong Dali started to imitate the sound of the weapon illuminating.
“Ding!
At a time like this, we need cool special effects.
The sword must shimmer and illuminate!
Then I will say, ‘This sword is too lousy, yet it shines and illuminates?’”
As he spoke, he swung the sword about.
It was not a tough movie to make.
A few lines were enough to send the audience into bouts of laughter.

When I thought about running under the sunset that day, it was just like my youth fading away...” Everyone was rolling on the floor laughing.

Can we?
Can we?
Can we?”

Seems like I will have to change my name to Chuichui...There was no way Hong Dali could resist Tang Muxin’s gentle voice.

Just that this doesn’t allow me to squander much.” Hong Dali couldn’t squander much with this movie even if he tried.
That made Hong Dali very concerned.

Hong Dali expressed satisfaction in his thoughts.

Shooting scenes?

That should work.”
Fengyuan Lake.
There are mountains and water, and the scenery is nice and quiet.
It’s indeed a good place.

How could I miss such a chance to squander!

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - Since Yu Was Born, Why Liang Was Also Born
paragraphs: Sky-blue Wings coffeehouse.

Liu Mingxin casually held a cup of coffee, legs crossed, and occasionally took a few sips. His appearance was full of grace, attracting the attention of the young females in the coffeehouse. Their face and noses were red and constantly peeked at him.
To outsiders, this guy seemed to be here purely to exude his charm. But in fact, he was actually pondering about Hong Dali.

“This Hong Dali, he’s much smarter than I thought.” Liu Mingxin slightly narrowed his eyes, fingers lightly tapping the tabletop in front of him. “Today’s plan was almost perfect, yet it didn’t succeed.

“Arranging my men amongst those excited fans, once that kid got off the car, and the crowd surged towards him, even if he weren’t stampeded to death, he would at least have to stay in the hospital for a few months to recuperate. I would never expect for the kid actually to stay on his car the whole time.” Liu Mingxin frowned and said to himself, “According to logic, since I appeared there, any other normal guy would definitely not be able to hold their calm if someone else tried to snatch away the celebrity they groomed. But Hong Dali didn’t panic at all, could it be that he saw through my plan? Or was it that he really was so confident in Li Nianwei, and really thought that I would not succeed in snatching her away?

“What a headache.” Liu Mingxin lightly rubbed his temple. “Where did his faith come from? In terms of family background, our families are on par with each other. In terms of looks, he’s indeed good looking, but I will not lose out to him either. As for capability, what capability does this prodigal have? It was only dog shit’s luck that he managed to groom Li Nianwei to fame. What capabilities can he possibly have?

“But a person such as him has so much confidence?” Liu Mingxin continued thinking. “Could it be that he and Li Nianwei were already in that kind of relationship? That’s unlikely. If they really were in such a relationship, he wouldn’t have spoken of keeping Li Nianwei as a mistress in public. That means that his words were meant for me. It was just a show.”
Puff...Liu Mingxin lightly said, “Looks like there’s a need for me to know the real him.”
As he thought of this, a young and beautiful girl nervously came up to him. Face red and heart pumping quickly, she asked, “Sir, may I sit here?”

This girl was very pretty. She was quite tall, her legs were long, her breasts were bulging, and her make-up was also very delicate. If she stood in a crowd, she would instantly stand out. The kind that a lot of people would keep turning around to see.

If it were some other man that met such a lady striking a conversation with them, they would most likely be happily shouting and heart pumping madly. But Liu Mingxin only lightly nodded, smiled and said, “You may, but please try to keep quiet, in case you break my flow of thought.”
Hearing Liu Mingxin’s approval, the lady was pleasantly surprised and quickly sat down. After that, she just lowered her head and only occasionally raised it to peek at him, then lowered it again.

Liu Mingxin seemed to have forgotten about the girl, so totally immersed was he in his own thoughts. “Only one who knows his enemies well can win every battle. My previous understanding of Hong Dali was indeed limited. Currently speaking, there is a need for me to know him better. Our family’s business areas are overlapping too much with each other. There will be a battle between the two families sooner or later. Since we’re on different sides, don’t blame me for being vicious.”

He took another sip of coffee, his elegant posture causing the girl opposite him to watch on enthralled. Liu Mingxin was thinking, En, there is an auction tomorrow night, why not invite him too. This kid likes to squander, he will most likely agree to go to an auction house. If he really attends, I can use the opportunity to observe him, especially to understand his characteristics and lifestyle attitude.

Having made up his mind, Liu Mingxin helplessly shook his head. “What a pity. If it isn’t because we’re on different sides, it would be interesting to have this little prodigal as a friend. At least, I heard that he’s quite amicable to those around him.
Since Yu was born, why Liang was born as well1. I can only account this to fate’s doing. What a pity.”
Making up his mind, Liu Mingxin put down his coffee, gradually stood up, and softly said to the girl, “I should go now, see you.” Then, he slowly left, leaving nothing behind.
The young girls in the coffeehouse were totally charmed by him.

“Ah, I’m tired.” Inside Caiwei Entertainment, after being done with telling the others the key points of the script, he stretched his body lazily, yawned and said, “Time to go home and sleep!” Actually, Hong Dali’s health attribute point was already maxed at 100 points. He didn’t really felt tired but was just acting like he was to not raise suspicions to himself.

“En, then we shan’t keep you behind anymore.” Zhang Cai and the rest of the people present all stood up. Li Nianwei, like an older sister, softly instructed: “Young Master, go to bed early when you reach home. After all, your body condition isn’t very well, don’t stay up too late.”
“Yep, I know that.” Hong Dali giggled and said, “Everyone, settle the theme song forUnexpectedly! first. Tomorrow, we shall go to Tianjing Mountain to shoot the outdoor scenes.”
After giving out his instructions, Hong Dali waved his hand. “OK, there is no need to send me away. Bye.”
Instantly, his nine lackeys led the way with their heads held high and created a path for him to walk. Hong Dali held Tang Muxin’s hand and followed behind.
After boarding the car and leaving, it was only a short while before the car stopped.

“Liu Mingxin?” Seeing a young man resting on a blue super-sports car, Hong Dali muttered. “What is this guy doing here so late at night? Shouldn’t he be looking for Sister Nianwei while I’m not around instead?”

Seeing Hong Dali’s convoy, his hair lightly flying in the night wind, the incredibly handsome Liu Mingxin slowly walked up towards him. His posture was full of grace, not a single flaw could be found. Very quickly, he reached Hong Dali’s car and knocked lightly on his window with a finger. He smiled and said, “Young Master Dali, can we have a word? En, you don’t have to alight, it’s just a few words.”

Rolling down the window, Hong Dali looked at his shockingly handsome face and gloomily said, “Do you know that whenever I see your face, I will think of how I can destroy it to pieces so that you will not be as handsome as me.”

“Hehe, Young Master Dali must be joking.” Liu Mingxin didn’t speak of a single word regarding the previous incident, but only softly said, “Since Lady Nianwei is your mistress now, I will naturally take her away from you. I’m waiting for you here today to ask if you’re interested in attending a small party tomorrow night, 7 PM, at Mingjing Building level 26, after which is followed by a charity auction.”
“An auction!?” At first, Hong Dali was still quite restless. But upon hearing that there would be an auction, his eyes immediately lit-up. “Will it require a lot of money!?”
Liu Mingxin nodded and said, “Somewhat. I heard that the value of the items ranges from a few hundred thousand to a few million, not very expensive.”
“I will go!” Hong Dali nodded decidedly.

An auction, hundreds of thousands or even millions worth of items. Oh my, this is definitely the best place to squander. This value is just nicely within my limit. If the items cost tens of millions, I will not be able to afford them!
There is finally hope for my little stick!

Speaking of which, Hong Dali had never seen an auction before in all these years. When he thought of the image of raising a card and increasing the bid, “One million!” “I add another one million!” “I offer four million!”
That’s what one calls imposing! And satisfying!
Hong Dali thought for a while and suddenly asked, “Speaking of which, why did you think of inviting me?”
Liu Mingxin said, “Young Master Dali, don’t you think that an auction is a very suitable place for a challenge?”
“Heh heh.” Hong Dali nodded. “Understood. In terms of squandering, I have yet to fear anyone.”
“En.” Liu Mingxin nodded, smiled and said, “Then, I shall be awaiting your arrival.”

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - Come, Let’s Squander to My Heart’s Content!
paragraphs: After Liu Mingxin left, Hong Dali touched his chin and looked at Tang Muxin who was sitting beside him. “Xinxin, this guy asked me to join that something auction, what do you think of it? It’s unlikely that he really wants to compete with me to see who can squander more, can it?” Speaking of which, whenever Tang Muxin was with him, Hong Dali especially likely to ask her “what do you think.” It felt really interesting every time he said it.

“I have to say, even though we’re not on the same side, I can’t bring myself to dislike him.” Tang Muxin frowned her cute little nose. “This old guy is very handsome looking and graceful. Even though I know we’re enemies, it’s still hard to be angry at him—but he is definitely plotting something this time, I’m sure of it. As for why he especially came here to invite you to the auction, and his reason for it, I still have to ponder on it.”
“En.” Hong Dali muttered. “He actively invited me to the auction, could it be that he just wants to see me squander?”
“Squander?” Tang Muxin repeated it two more times, and her eyes suddenly lit-up. “Dali, this time, you definitely have to squander!”
“Huh?” Hong Dali curiously asked, “Why are you supporting me this time? Don’t you hate seeing me squander?”

“Am I such a person that doesn’t know how to set her priorities?” Tang Muxin pouted and humphed. “Last time was last time, now is now. The situation is special now, we can’t view problems the same way as we did in the past. Think about it, his evil plot didn’t succeed today, and he also failed to win Sister Nianwei’s heart. If you put yourself in his shoes, what would you think of?”

“If it were me?” Hong Dali slowly said, “I would definitely find out the reason for why I failed. En, this fellow failed, then he will think that it’s because I saw through his plans. But I don’t think he will believe that this is the reason. After all, everyone seems to equate prodigals being the same as fools. But I believe he still suspects me. Therefore, this auction is a chance for him to test my personality and character. Whether I’m a real prodigal, who will squander on impulse or an old demon in disguise.”
Tang Muxin grinned. “Hee hee, if you’re an old demon, doesn’t that make me an old demoness?”

After saying this, her face went red, her finger pressed upon her lips, and she immediately changed the subject. “However, my view on this matter is the same as yours. This time, the best solution is to squander as much as you can. This way, he will lose interest in challenging you. People like him who seeks perfection will not be interested in weak opponents.”
“Is that a personal attack on me?” Hong Dali pouted and said, “You want me to act foolish and weak in front of him?”

“Not just in front of him.” Tang Muxin placed her mouth beside Hong Dali’s ear and softly said, “This also includes those family members of yours. After all, the more you squander and make a show of doing nothing useful, the less they will pay attention to you. You will be much safer then.”
“Fine.” Hong Dali sucked in a deep breath. “Then, this time I shall listen to you—brouhaha! Finally, I can splurge as much as I want. Come, let’s squander to my heart’s content!”
An auction! No matter how much I try to save, I will at least need to spend a few million yuan, isn’t it?
After that, let’s see how big my little stick can become!
After sending Tang Muxin home, Hong Dali returned home and slept.

After Hong Dali went back to his room, the driver came to the study room on the first floor and lightly knocked on the door. Very quickly, a deep low voice sounded from inside. “Come in, the door isn’t locked.”
The driver entered the study room and bowed slightly towards Hong Weiguo and his wife. “Greetings, Master, Madam.”

Hong Weiguo was practicing his calligraphy. Without raising his head, he said, “En, it has already been so many years, there is no need to be so polite. You came to see us today, is it regarding Dali? What has happened? Tell me in detail.”

“Yes, Master.” The driver told them the important things that happened today from start to end. Hong Weiguo’s eyes gradually lit-up as he listened. In the end, he slowly nodded and said, “En, not bad. Leave the USB flash drive here, you may go and rest now.”
“OK, goodnight, Master and Madam.”
“Goodnight.”
After the driver left, Hong Weiguo pulled out a cigarette and lit it up. Sucking in a deep breath, he smiled and said, “My wife, looks like our house’s little prodigal has really grown up.”

“You’re right.” Tears of happiness flowed out from Lan Ruoxi’s eyes. She smiled and said, “Eighteen years, this little rascal has always been living his life in a muddleheaded manner in the past. We have also let him have his way. Hearing what Old Wang said today, I just realized that our little prodigal is also a big kid now, hehe. It’s really wonderful how he handled this issue.”

“En, this is really a deep change from him in such a short time.” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly. After a while, he smoked for a bit and suddenly asked, “This kid Liu Mingxin is someone to be reckoned with. He handles things fast and decisively, and he’s also very handsome and very talented. He is somewhat similar to Zhou Yu1from The Three Kingdoms. It’s a pity that the business service of our families is overlapping more and more these days. There will be a battle between us one day. This is a matter of sides, such a pity. If he were from another family, I would definitely be willing to groom him.”

“That’s right, one will most likely experience things that don’t go smoothly eight or nine out of ten times in a lifetime.” Lan Ruoxi thought for a while and asked, “My husband, are you planning to repay him the same way he tried to treat our Dali?”

“Xinxin, this guy asked me to join that something auction, what do you think of it?

It’s unlikely that he really wants to compete with me to see who can squander more, can it?” Speaking of which, whenever Tang Muxin was with him, Hong Dali especially likely to ask her “what do you think.” It felt really interesting every time he said it.
“I have to say, even though we’re not on the same side, I can’t bring myself to dislike him.” Tang Muxin frowned her cute little nose.
“This old guy is very handsome looking and graceful.
Even though I know we’re enemies, it’s still hard to be angry at him—but he is definitely plotting something this time, I’m sure of it.

“En.” Hong Dali muttered.
“He actively invited me to the auction, could it be that he just wants to see me squander?”
“Squander?” Tang Muxin repeated it two more times, and her eyes suddenly lit-up.
“Dali, this time, you definitely have to squander!”
“Huh?” Hong Dali curiously asked, “Why are you supporting me this time?
Don’t you hate seeing me squander?”
“Am I such a person that doesn’t know how to set her priorities?” Tang Muxin pouted and humphed.
“Last time was last time, now is now.

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - The God-level Nouveau Riche
paragraphs: On the second day, Hong Dali was lying on his desk in the classroom and blissfully reading a novel on his cell phone.

Come to think of it, being a happy prodigal was pretty enjoyable—good students had to study hard and listen attentively to lectures. Should their transmigration go wrong, they would have to worry all day about fleeing from danger and training hard to fight. He had it good. He was enjoying the bliss and was living the life.
The most enjoyable thing was that the teacher did not even dare to discipline him. They had to be thankful that he didn’t cause any disaster for them.

“Kneel neatly! Hahaha, good, this segment is really nicely written. This is very satisfying, domineering! This is exactly what the effect should be!” Hong Dali read this book titled “God Slayer” and felt like he was in the skies. He immediately logged in to his super VIP account in Zhong Dian website. He then opened the bestow reward page and clicked on the bestow reward button for a good ten minutes.
I’m loaded anyway, I shall bestow the reward however much I deem fit!
Half an hour later, the entire Zhong Dian website was completely brewing with excitement.

Initially, there was a reader who chanced upon the refreshed web page, which was filled with the rewarded credits. This shocked the reader, and he screamed in the chat room for readers: “What the heck, there’s a nouveau riche offering huge rewards for the ‘God Slayer,’ everyone quickly come and take a look!”

And the second person saw this and commented in another chat room: “The heck! There’s a super nouveau riche on the web page. He’s already alliance-leader ranked. He’s been sending rewards for five minutes already and is still going strong!”

And the third person saw it and it became: “Everyone come and look, a God-level nouveau riche has attained the alliance-leader rank! Spending money like turning on the tap, really impressive! Everyone quickly come and look!”
Ten minutes later, the “God Slayer” review section wrote:
Reader 1: “This fellow is definitely a real nouveau riche. I have been reading novels for a few years, and this is the first time I’ve seen anything like this. What the heck, he’s still going on!”
Reader 2: “God-level nouveau riche, let’s be friends, shall we? Please provide for me, I can warm the bed for you!”
Reader 3: “Is this book really that well-written? So much credit rewards? This cannot do, I shall take a look.”
Reader 4: “This guy is probably a rich boss? This rhythm, it’s like he’s trying to create a hole in the sky!”
Reader 5: “Let me have a look at this book, is it really that good?”
Thirty minutes later, the “God Slayer” book review section:
Reader 3: “What the heck, this book is so thrilling. I have never noticed that in the past. No wonder someone actually spammed bestowing rewards!”
Reader 5: “I totally support this book, this is definitely a great book, period! Those who haven’t seen it will definitely regret it!”
Forty minutes later, Chenhui Building level 8, Zhong Dian website headquarters—
Secretary: “Director Yang, Young Master is spamming on bestowing rewards for ‘God Slayer,’ what should we do...”
Director Yang: “Go and find that spendthrift, let him handle this.”
Business service director’s office.
Secretary: “Director Zhang, Young Master is spamming on bestowing rewards for ‘God Slayer.’ Should we be doing anything?”

Zhang Wenyang, who earned the favor of Hong Dali due to his tendency of spending money like water, smiled and said, “Is there a need to ask? Draw 100,000 yuan from the finance department and recruit the Internet Water Army. Do it like this, and that!”
After leaving the business service director’s office, the secretary muttered, “Spends money like water indeed, spending 100,000 yuan on the Internet Water Army? What a retard.”
Regardless of what she thought, she had to do what she was told to do.
Thus, one and a half hours later, “God Slayer” book review section:
Internet Water Army Soldier 1: “This is definitely a great book. Brothers, come and support!
Internet Water Army Soldier 2: “Supported, continuing on doing it!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 3: “What’s the matter? Why are there so many bootlickers? This is definitely a hype, I shall go and verify it!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 4: “I’ll go and see what this is about too.”
Two and a half hours later, “God Slayer” book review section:
Internet Water Army Soldier 5: “Damn, this book is really thrilling to the core! How did I not notice this in the past?”
Reader 6: “Really? I’ll go and have a look!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 6: “This is a top class God-level book, period!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 7: “What the heck, everyone look, that super nouveau riche is back at it again. Now he has already awarded 6.5 million fan points. That means he has spent 65,000 yuan!”

Reader 7: “Nouveau riche, this is definitely a super nouveau riche! This cannot do, I have to go and have a look at the book. Why is this book so unheard of in the past? I just don’t believe that such an impressive nouveau riche would reward it if the book were trash!”
Four hours later, “God Slayer” book review section:
Reader 8: “I’m convinced. This book is freaking thrilling. Definitely, something I haven’t seen before! The enemy is totally overwhelmed by the main character!”
At the same time, Hong Dali, who had just woken up from a nap after lunch, had a good stretch and yawned. He muttered, “Ah, these days have been a blast. Now let’s have a look at other books.”
Ten minutes later, the Zhong Dian website once again had an upsurge:

Reader 1: “Damn, that God-level nouveau riche is back at it again, this time it’s ‘The Undying’! He’s spamming on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank again! The ‘God Slayer’ that he rewarded just now was precisely an underrated gem, everyone quickly come and take a look!”

Reader 2: “I’ve read the ‘God Slayer,’ and I was thrilled to the skies! Let’s see how this ‘The Undying’ will fare. If it’s as thrilling as the ‘God Slayer,’ the issue of the lack of good books to read will then be solved!”
Twenty minutes later, the Internet Water Army arrived:
Internet Water Army Soldier 1: “God-level nouveau riche, please provide for me!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 2: “Seems like we have another thrilling book. Everyone follow the God-level nouveau riche! We go wherever he goes!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 3: “Yes, yes, yes. This book can hold a candle to the ‘God Slayer.’ The God-level nouveau riche is really sharp-eyed. Every book he finds is a gem! What a thrill!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 4: “Hahahaha, everyone please follow closely, report at once when you take notice!”
Reader 3: “Good book, what an absolutely good book! Had the God-level nouveau riche not taken action, I’d probably have never noticed this!”
Reader 4: “Indeed, that would’ve been such a pity. This book is really pretty well-written. You will get addicted to it once you start reading it!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 5: “Damn, look, that God-level nouveau riche already has 5 million fan points for this book! Impressive!”

Internet Water Army Soldier 6: “What are you guys looking for, look at the God-level nouveau riche’s bookshelf! Just these two books are already so wonderful. The rest of the books on his shelf must be as good!”
Internet Water Army Soldier 7: “Yes! What a smart dude you are! Everyone, quickly go and access the God-level nouveau riche’s bookshelf! All the books inside are definitely good!”

Meanwhile, in the classroom. Hong Dali said, “Ah, this story is so thrilling. The rest of the story hasn’t been updated yet though. Forget it, I’ll go and sleep now. Seems like I still have to wait for a few more days for the author to upload more chapters.”
Zhong Dian website HQ.
The secretary stood in front of the general manager with a forehead full of perspiration and said, “Director Yang, according to the tabulations, the website traffic has risen by...”
Director Yang impatiently asked, “Risen by how much? Why are you stuttering?”
“It has risen by...” The secretary gulped and continued, “It has risen by an entire 20%, and it is still growing exponentially. I reckon by the end of today, traffic can rise to 220,000 per day.”
“What the heck!” Director Yang uncontrollably blurted a classic expletive. “I must be freaking dreaming!”
He slapped himself twice and realized it hurt. He hurriedly said, “Have you found the source of the traffic? How much of this traffic is from the Internet Water Army?”

“This... this is...” the secretary said in a difficult tone. “The traffic rise was computed after accounting for the removal of the Internet Water Army’s IP addresses. The traffic is concentrated on the Young Master’s favorite books. And those who have seen them all gave pretty good reviews.”
“Get on with those recommendations!” Director Yang decided on the spot. “Remove all those badly performing books and put these up straight away! Quick!”

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - I Cannot Tolerate This!
paragraphs: Hong Dali: “This is so boring, there’s nothing to do...” He lay on the desk for a bit. “Forget it, I think I’ll go spam on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank for fun...”
The Zhong Dian website exploded once again. “Quick, look, the God-level nouveau riche is spamming on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank again!”
“Yes, yes, quickly come and look!”
The Internet Water Army went: “Brothers, let’s go!”
Things turned chaotic.

On the one hand, Hong Dali was spamming on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank out of boredom. On the other hand, Ji Zhiruo, who was by his side, took a glance at him before turning her head back quickly. After just a while, she looked at him again and gingerly queried: “Young Master Dali, what, what are you doing?”
“Me?” Hong Dali was listless. “I was reading a novel, and then it stopped halfway, so I got bored and started spamming on bestowing rewards for fun. What’s up?”
“No... nothing much,” Ji Zhiruo turned her back in a hurry like a scared little rabbit. After a while, she turned her head again and quietly asked, “Is... is that novel good?”
Eh? Since I have nothing to do anyway, chatting about this seems like a good idea too.Hong Dali nodded resolutely and said, “It’s good!”
“What novel is it? Can you tell me?” Ji Zhiruo asked.

“Sure. ‘God Slayer’ and ‘The Undying’ from Zhong Dian website. They’re all pretty decent. I have nothing else to do, so I’m just spamming on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank.” Hong Dali seemed to have become more spirited. “Zhiruo, do you want to give it a try?”
“I... I think I’ll pass for now.” Ji Zhiruo panicked and continued, “Let me ask Ling Yi and the rest first.”
Classroom group chat:
Ji Zhiruo: “Young Master Dali is reading ‘God Slayer’ and ‘The Undying’ from the Zhong Dian website. He says they’re good.”
Ling Yi: “Didn’t I say that Young Master Dali has found something interesting for the past two days? I’ll go and have a look as well.”
Du Xinzhen: “Yours truly has made a prediction. I predict that this is definitely a good read. I’m in too!”
Half an hour later.
Zhong Dian website once again welcomed the second peak of rewards. This time, it was due to over ten new sockpuppets spamming on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank—
Reader 1: “What the heck, another 5 or 6 God-level nouveau riches are spamming on bestowing rewards for the alliance-leader rank for the ‘God Slayer’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - The Zealous and Righteous Hong Dali
paragraphs: Qian Ge Headquarters Building, Tianjing City Central, Level 16.

“CEO Hong, there has been a purchase of several pieces of land over at the West Four Loop’s side in the past few days. The total cost is 270 million yuan, for your perusal.” The secretary gently set a document of about five to six pages down onto Hong Weiguo’s office desk and stood by awaiting her following instructions.

“Oh? That was pretty quick, let me take a look.” Hong Weiguo picked the document up and started perusing it. “Hmm, it’s indeed not too far from Ye Lai Xiang, but the area isn’t that big. 270 million yuan sounds acceptable.” Hong Weiguo set the document down, stood up, and approached the map displaying the area nearby Ye Lai Xiang. He pointed his finger and gestured a little, continuing, “It’s a pity that it’s still rather far. We’ll leave it like that for now and see how it goes. En, how are the relocation intentions of the residents nearby Ye Lai Xiang?”

“As of now, it seems pretty good.” The secretary smiled and continued, “The residents nearby Ye Lai Xiang are generally all actively asking about the relocation issue. After all, exchanging a new building for an old one is a good thing. Those buildings have mostly been around for almost a decade, and they’re simply normal low-rise buildings. Besides, the property management in that small estate is pretty average.”

“Hehe, that’s good then.” Hong Weiguo touched his chin and continued, “Hmm, remember to give them a little something. How about this, tell them this. After the relocation, property fees will be set as 0.2 yuan per square meter per month. And we will ensure that the little estate is safe and clean.”
“Yes, CEO Hong.” The secretary replied.

“By the way, how are the talks for the area surrounding Tianjing Mountain near Fengyuan Lake going?” Hong Weiguo pointed to the map again and continued, “Speaking of which, this place seems decent. If we develop a high-end villa here in the future, I reckon it will fetch a good price.”

“The talks over at that side are about done. In total, there are 12 hills big and small, costing a total of 86 million. We can sign the contract in a few days time.” The secretary thought about it and carefully advised. “CEO Hong, I feel that it would be better if we were to build a golf course over there. In this way, we can link the villa with some sort of entertainment.”

“A golf course?” Hong Weiguo muttered for a bit and decisively shook his head. “Forget it, that’s pretty bad for the environment, especially our natural water sources. It may be beneficial in the short term, but I don’t think it’s any good in the long run. Let’s put that aside for now.”
“Noted.”
“Ah, class dismissed! Finally!” Hong Dali had a good, long backstretch.I finally made it through the day in school. I’ll have dinner, then it’s off to the auction.

Hong Dali packed his belongings, grabbed his bag, and leisurely strolled out of the classroom. But just as he had left the classroom, Ji Zhiruo’s voice sounded. “Young... Young Master Dali. Can you, can you wait for me a bit?”

Hmm? Seems like she’s had something on her mind all day long.Hong Dali stopped his footsteps and curiously asked, “Zhiruo, what’s wrong? Something bugging you today? I’ve been getting the feeling that you’re acting pretty strange for the past few days.”
It was no wonder Hong Dali said that. Ji Zhiruo seemed to be really down for the past few days. She had been out of sorts when hanging out with her classmates.
Ji Zhiruo jogged towards Hong Dali and softly said, “Young Master Dali, can, can you do me a favor?”

“What’s wrong? What’s making you look so grieved? Oh, you’re tearing up, who bullied you?” Hong Dali had a pretty decent impression of Ji Zhiruo. This little girl had been rather stable and obedient. She was the apple of the teachers’ and her classmates’ eyes.

“I... I...” Ji Zhiruo hesitated for a good while before she continued, “Young Master Dali, can, can you lend me some money? My family’s business is having some issues recently, and my dad has grown so much more white hair.”

“Oh, I thought it was something more serious.” Hong Dali shoved his bank card into Ji Zhiruo’s hands without question and continued, “The pin is six zeros. Just take whatever you need. How much is left in there... forget it, I can’t remember. But I reckon there should be two or three million in there. If it’s not enough, just let me know, and I’ll ask for more from my family.”

“It’s enough, it’s enough!” Ji Zhiruo was nearly moved to tears. “My family’s capital flow has broken, and I heard from my dad that we’re down by less than two million. This money is definitely enough.”
Ji Zhiruo hurriedly continued, “I will definitely repay you!”

“Haha, no issue, it’s just a small matter, there’s no need for all the formality.” Hong Dali snorted his nose and waved to Ji Zhiruo, leaving her with his chic back view. “It’s just one less chance for squandering, no big deal. You can go home first, I have a movie to film tonight.”

“Young Master Dali...” Two streams of tears flowed down from the corners of her eyes. Ji Zhiruo bowed deeply towards Hong Dali while thinking to herself, After this crisis, I will definitely repay you more than what I took!
Hong Dali left the school, got on the car, and said to Ling Xiaoyi, “Xiaoyi, help me ask for some money from my family later, I’m out of money.”
Ling Xiaoyi nodded and replied, “Yes, Young Master.”
“Out of money!” Tang Muxin, who was seated by the side, asked with surprise, “Don’t you have a few million in your card? How did you use it up so fast?”
“Doesn’t count as spending it away. “Hong Dali gestured and continued, “Ji Zhiruo said her family is facing some issues and needs a few million, so I lent her the money.”
“Didn’t you ask for an IOU or something?” Tang Muxin glared at him till her eyes turned into a perfectly round shape. “You lent her the money just like that?”

Hong Dali replied, bewildered, “Yeah. I don’t even know how much is left in the card, how am I supposed to ask her for an IOU? Besides, as a prodigal, how can I even do something like asking someone for an IOU?”

“Seriously, you...” Tang Muxin stopped in her tracks and suddenly burst out laughing, as she reached her hands out to pinch Hong Dali’s cheeks. “Didn’t think you would be such a righteous and considerate person.”

Hong Dali’s normally decently handsome face was pinched to distortion, as he said, “Hey stop, stop. Come to think of it, don’t you have some self-sense a fiancée should have? Shouldn’t you leave me some man’s pride?”

“Fine.” Tang Muxin grinned and let go. “By the way, Dali, have you prepared how you’re going to squander away tonight? That Liu Mingxin is not just some Tom, Dick, or Harry. You’re not going to be able to bluff him if you don’t act well.”
Hong Dali was pretty serious towards Liu Mingxin.

Liu Mingxin was rich, had status, had a respectable family history, was intelligent and handsome. However you look at it, this dude was definitely a lucky person born with the destiny to be the main character of a story.
Hong Dali couldn’t care less about competing with this dude. Being a blissful, happy, carefree prodigal was what he sought and his lifelong dream.

Hence, Hong Dali decisively said, “Of course, I’ve thought about it. I can’t be bothered with him, he can piss off. Let’s go, let’s have something to eat, and then we’ll go for the auction tonight. Speaking of which, this is a charity auction, eh. Is all the money going to be used for charity?”

“Of course, why would it be called a charity auction otherwise.” Tang Muxin nodded and continued, “So, it seems like this squandering is actually for a good cause. How else do you think I’d be this supportive this time.”
“OK, I got it.” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders and continued, “When the time comes, just tell me if anything catches your eye. I’ll buy it for you.”
“No way!” Tang Muxin shook her head decisively and continued, “I don’t like such expensive stuff, it makes me feel uneasy. You just go ahead and buy whatever you like, I’ll just have a look.”
“Alright then, we’ll see how it goes.” Hong Dali looked out of the window and continued, “OK, let’s go and have our meal first!”
