Let’s go, let’s have something to eat, and then we’ll go for the auction tonight.
Speaking of which, this is a charity auction, eh.
Is all the money going to be used for charity?”
“Of course, why would it be called a charity auction otherwise.” Tang Muxin nodded and continued, “So, it seems like this squandering is actually for a good cause.
How else do you think I’d be this supportive this time.”
“OK, I got it.” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders and continued, “When the time comes, just tell me if anything catches your eye.
I’ll buy it for you.”
“No way!” Tang Muxin shook her head decisively and continued, “I don’t like such expensive stuff, it makes me feel uneasy.
You just go ahead and buy whatever you like, I’ll just have a look.”
“Alright then, we’ll see how it goes.” Hong Dali looked out of the window and continued, “OK, let’s go and have our meal first!”

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - Manner
paragraphs: 7 PM, Mingjing Building

When Hong Dali’s fleet of luxury cars pulled up at the square in front of Mingjing Building, the entrance to Mingjing Building was clear of any unrelated idlers. The parking lot was filled with all kinds of cars, their cost ranging from 200,000 to millions of yuan. The security guard patrolled back and forth, armed with an electric baton. The place was heavily guarded, and any suspicious person was questioned immediately. People who did not know would think that someone important was coming to inspect.

Once the cars came to a halt, people rolled out the carpet, followed by a few beautiful ladies donned in high-slit cheongsams. They stood in a straight line along each side of the carpet. When Hong Dali and Tang Muxin alighted the car, the beautiful ladies bowed 90 degrees to them and spoke in unison, “Welcome.” No matter where Hong Dali looked, all he saw were the ladies’ bare skin glistening. As he trembled, Hong Dali almost thought he had arrived at some high-class social club in Dongguan city.
As they passed the beautiful ladies, they were faced with reporters from more than ten news media. Hong Dali was giddy with the camera flashes flashing nonstop like lightning.

“Are you trying to murder someone?” Others were afraid that when it was them, there were not enough flashes from the camera. But Hong Dali was fuming. “I’m not a star. Stop taking pictures of me! If you continue, do you believe I’ll show you how the flowers turned red1?!”

The nine lackeys cleared the path in an imposing manner, short of hitting someone with a brick. A group of reporters saw that they were getting upset and quickly turned off their cameras. If anything happened to their cameras, they would have come for nothing.
It was finally quiet. Hong Dali muttered, “What kind of lousy cocktail party requires such publicity? Is that old fool Liu Mingxin trying to bluff me?”

While he spoke, Tang Muxin suddenly exclaimed and tugged at Hong Dali’s arm twice. She pointed at a luxury sports car driving in and excitedly said, “I know that car! It belongs to the superstar Tai Yajing!”
Hong Dali replied uninterested, “Oh. It’s just a celebrity, see how excited you got. Our Sister Nianwei is also a superstar. I don’t see you being so excited to see her?”
Tang Muxin eagerly said, “Tai Yajing used to be my idol. I used to like her so much, she was so beautiful! She sings well too, and she was in several movies. Those movies all did quite well.”
Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders. “Alright, it seems like she’s here to attend this charity dinner. Do you want to go get her signature?”
Tang Muxin’s eyes brightened at once. “Signature! I almost forgot. I’ll go upstairs to ask for her signature later!”
Really...Hong Dali muttered, “I’ve never seen you in this manner before.”
Tang Muxin coyly said, “Everyone had an idol in their childhood. I had one too. Didn’t you have one?”
Hong Dali gaped as he spoke, “I... Alright, I had one too.”
Having spent such a long time in this world, Hong Dali was experienced with scenes like this. He didn’t care much about this charity dinner.

That was human nature. Circumstances would affect people’s view. Hong Dali walked past the two statues of three meters tall red jade lions at home every day. Naturally, he would not be shocked by a situation like this.

Disregarding the reporters, Hong Dali and Tang Muxin went upstairs with the driver and his 9 lackeys. The welcoming staff could tell that Hong Dali was an affluent young master from his entourage and did not dare to block them. Not to mention ask for the invitation card. They led them to the elevator which brought them straight to the event hall on level 26.

The elevator arrived promptly at level 26. As its doors slowly opened, what greeted them were at least 20 men and women holding video recorders, cameras, audio recorders, and microphones who immediately started filming and recording once they saw them.
Hong Dali held up his hand to shield Tang Muxin’s and his’ eyes. When the sounds of shutters stopped, he opened his eyes and clenched his teeth while ordering the lackeys. “Go!”

The male lackey ferociously marched towards a reporter who was still trying to squeeze his way to the front. He barked at him. “What are you filming? Do you even know who we are before you start to film?”
It was only then that the reporter came to his senses and realized he was filming the wrong person. “You are...”
The male lackey said, “This is our young master and young madam. Do you know now?”
The reporter shook his head and wondered who claimed himself to be a young master in that tone. “No... I don’t know.”
The male lackey raised his hand and pushed the reporter, causing him to stumble to the ground. “You lived in vain!”

Hitting a reporter? That was big news. The other reporters rushed to take photos to make the headlines, but the lackeys were quick to stop them. Hong Dali took Tang Muxin and walked into the event hall with their heads up and chests out. He did not forget to snap his fingers while saying, “Good job. Twenty thousand yuan tip for you!”
The lackey who pushed the reporter hurriedly thanked him. “Thank you, Young Master, for the tip!”

The reporters were stunned to hear about the 20,000 tip. Hong Dali knew to apply the principle of the carrot and stick approach. He sniffed and said while he continued walking, “Xiaoyi, tell them. Those who delete the photos will be tipped 5,000 yuan each.”
In an instant, the reporters deleted all the photos of Hong Dali and his entourage!

That’s right. This is how it is like for a great prodigal’s son! Hong Dali had come with the intention of getting the others to let their guard down. Hence, it was best for him to appear like an arrogant wastrel. The lackeys had understood Hong Dali’s intention before arriving at the event hall and did their best to play along. When they arrived at the door of the event hall, the hostess asked to see the invitation card, to which Hong Dali directly replied, “No.”

The hostess was full of cold sweat. She looked at the fierce-looking lackeys and instinctively felt that if she dared to say no, she would definitely be dragged away to god-knows-where and what they would do to her. In consideration of her life and safety, she bowed immediately and said, “I’m sorry, Sir. I did not see anything.”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said, “Um, not bad. Five thousand.”
A male lackey promptly took out a stack of notes, counted them, and stuffed them into the hostess’ hands. “A tip to soothe your nerves.”
While the hostess was in a state of shock, Hong Dali and his entourage walked in.
Finally, they arrived at the event hall on level 26 without any mishaps.
In all honestly, Hong Dali had experienced and seen events of such a big scale. But even he was made aware of the luxurious setting of the event hall.

Thousands of square meters in area, exquisite paintings on top of a Basilica-style arch. Eighteen chandeliers, each with 6 tiers in the shape of an inverted pyramid and encrusted with many small bulbs. It was simply beautiful and luxurious.
The most amazing thing was the marble flooring that looked like it was waxed multiple times. Hong Dali unknowingly looked down and was extremely pleased with it. “Hm, it’s white.”

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - Acting One’s True Self
paragraphs: At this moment, the hall was filled with guests gathering in groups of two or three, chatting among themselves. Some other guests were standing along at the balcony admiring the night view while discussing business propositions on the phone, and some were searching for the perfect lover on the dancing floor. There were no less than three to four hundred people. Including the waiters and waitresses shuffling among them, the scene appeared extremely lively.

With Tang Muxin helping him discreetly, Hong Dali was able to tell that the guests present included political figures, business tycoons, celebrities, and even mafias who were known to be in charge of several areas. Hong Dali deduced that these people probably controlled 40% of Tianjing City and were intimidatingly known as people of the upper class.

Hong Dali mumbled to himself, “Who could be so affluent to gather these people here?” Earlier, Liu Mingxin did not mention who the organizer was, but only said that it was a private event. It seemed that this was far from it.

The most dazzling star at the event was Tai Yajing. She had a head full of golden, wavy locks which fell on her shoulder, beautiful as silk. Her thick lashes, charming eyes, plump and full lips exuded charisma at every second. A cropped light purple jacket complemented her good figure perfectly. Along with a warm yellow velvet knee-length dress and long black boots, even Hong Dali could not disagree. It was no wonder Tang Muxin liked her so much. This star definitely had the confidence to be so proud.
Upon seeing her childhood idol, Tang Muxin was quite excited, pulling Hong Dali and wanting to run towards Tai Yajing. “It’s Miss Tai Yajing. Dali, can I go ask for her autograph?”

“Is there a need to be so excited...” It was no wonder Hong Dali was uninterested. He was not familiar with the celebrities in this world. If it were Andy Lau, he might have run faster than Tang Muxin.

At this moment, Tai Yajing was overwhelmed with the situation, there was no way she could pay any attention to Tang Muxin. Besides, Tang Muxin did not bring any pen or paper, there was nowhere for Tai Yajing to sign on. Hong Dali hummed as he said, “Wait for a while. If you approach her now, she’s sure to reject your request.” He looked over to the next table and his eyes brightened up. “Oh, there is a lot of delicious food there. Let’s eat something first.”

It was embarrassing to be eating something at a place like this. Tang Muxin looked left, and then right, her face red with embarrassment. She pulled Hong Dali discreetly, saying, “Are you crazy? You will be laughed at for eating here.”
Hong Dali mumbled, “My role today is to be a prodigal son. What are you worrying about? If the food is delicious, I will reward them.”
Tang Muxin felt helpless and decided to give up. They had a motive for appearing today, after all.

At the dinner table, Hong Dali sat with Tang Muxin, along with nine smart lackeys preparing utensils for him. Even Ling Xiaoyi especially took out a white handkerchief to tuck into Hong Dali’s collar. The scene blinded the rich and influential people around and their 24K gold-plated eyes. With a few more people sitting beside Hong Dali, it would look like The Last Supper scene.

This charity dinner was like a business-oriented seminar; no one was really interested in the food. Everyone was busy looking for new partners, getting to know some big shots, talking to strangers who might seem useful in each other’s business, or simply going after beautiful women. But Hong Dali’s exaggerated moves had attracted many people’s attention.
As Hong Dali was about to eat, he heard a chuckle. “Hey, isn’t this my brother Dali? What are you doing here? Not squandering at Ye Lai Xiang?”
The voice sounded familiar. Hong Dali turned around to see his family brother, Hong Anbao.

It was not unusual for Hong Anbao to turn up there, but Hong Dali naturally did not have any kind words for him. “Why can’t I be here?” As he spoke, he started eating. A female lackey presented him with a rather pleasant-looking dessert. Satisfied with her performance, Hong Dali said, “Um, not bad. Five thousand.”
The female lackey was jubilant as she backed off.

“Hahahaha, you’re still such a wastrel!” Watching Hong Dali, Hong Anbao laughed till he couldn’t straighten his back. He pointed at Hong Dali and said, “I finally understand. I was wondering why you would come here. It seems you’re here to squander. Speaking of which, how much are you planning to spend at the auction later?”
“My actions are for you to see, idiot.”
Hong Dali did not say a word, but Tang Muxin was furious. “How does it matter to you how much we want to spend?”
“Alright, this has got nothing to do with me. I’m just asking.” Hong Anbao sniggered. “Dali, have you reached the point that you have to rely on a woman to protect you? Aiya, what a pity.”

Hong Dali mumbled something but appeared to look shocked. “No. Do you mean others can’t even say anything now? How did you know I was here for the auction? Give me a moment. I left the house in a hurry without having dinner. Do you want to grab a bite with me?”
Hearing Hong Dali’s invite, Hong Anbao took two steps backward. “I don’t want to embarrass myself. To eat at a gathering like this, you’re embarrassing our family.”

Hong Dali laughed and said, “Isn’t it the same where we eat? The ambiance here is elegant and lively. It’s not bad. I can eat while watching others dance. If someone dances well, I could tip them. Isn’t that good?”
Hong Anbao was red with anger and was sweating.

He had wanted to ask Tai Yajing for a dance earlier to show off his dance moves which he had practiced so hard. After hearing what Hong Dali said, he didn’t dare to enter the dance floor. If Hong Dali suddenly called out “Nice moves, five thousand,” there would be nowhere he could hide.
The scariest thing was, Hong Dali was completely capable of doing that...
As they stared each other down, a delicate voice came from behind. “Master Anbao, why did you ignore me? This is?”
Hong Dali turned around and was elated. It was Tang Muxin’s idol, Miss Tai Yajing.
“Oh, nothing. This is my wastrel brother, Hong Dali.” Hong Anbao smiled. “Dali, this is Tai Yajing. I suppose there is no need for more introductions?”

Hearing that this was the famous prodigal son in the whole of Tianjing City, Tai Yajing smiled. “I have heard so much about you, Young Master. You’re really as I have heard.” As she said this, her eyes wavered between Hong Dali and the dinner table, jesting as she spoke. Her face did not hide the fact that she was belittling Hong Dali.

Hong Dali sniffed. It seemed these two people had something going on. They had just met, but her words were cold and harsh, clearly not respecting Hong Dali. Wasn’t this the best time to show off his squandering? Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “This sister is quite pretty. Tip her twenty thousand!”

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - I Better Just Look at the Pork Shoulders...
paragraphs: “Tip her 20,000 yuan!”

Once he said this, Tang Muxin puffed out in laughter. As for Tai Yajing, her eyebrows almost went vertical as she frowned in anger. “You, what kind of person do you think I am? Do you think I will want your tip! You think you’re extraordinary just because you’re rich?”
Hong Anbao face turned green and slammed the table fiercely. “Don’t be too much! Is Lady Tai Yajing someone you can speak to?”

“Oh?” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders nonchalantly. “Whatever, I shan’t say more to her then. Xiaoyi, you can have the tip, instead.” As he spoke, he started eating again. “If there’s nothing else, I’m going to have my meal first. You don’t say, I’m actually quite hungry.” Before he came, he didn’t eat much. After all this commotion, he really felt hungry.

“Anbao, let’s go. There’s nothing much for us to say to this prodigal.” Seeing that Hong Dali really started eating, Tai Yajing shook Hong Anbao’s arm and said, “He’s so impolite, it’s unpleasant just to look at him.” Tai Yajing was aware that the relationship between Hong Dali and Hong Anbao wasn’t good.

“Oh?” Hearing this, Hong Dali slowly turned around his head and looked at Hong Anbao. Then, carefully looked at Tai Yajing who was hugging his arm. He snorted and decisively turned his head back. “I better just look at the pork shoulder...”
Upon hearing this, Hong Anbao, who was smiling coldly, immediately burst out in rage. “Are you saying that the pork shoulder looks better than us?”
Tang Muxin and the nine lackeys were already laughing until they almost couldn’t catch their breath. This Hong Anbao was really cooperative and replied to Hong Dali’s provocation.
Picking up a piece of meat and putting it into his mouth, Hong Dali lazily replied, “The pork shoulder can help to ease my hunger, but looking at you reminds me of the sea.”
“Reminds you of the sea?” Tang Muxin curiously asked. “Dali, why are you reminded of the sea?”

Everyone collapsed in laughter.

“Hong Dali, wait until the family’s meeting. “See.” Hong Dali looked at Tang Muxin. “You were still planning to ask for her autograph. She’s obviously not worth it.”

“Yup, I don’t want it anymore too!” Tai Yajing was obviously on Hong Anbao’s side. From the looks of it, they were very close to each other. Now, even if Tai Yajing wanted to give her autograph to Tang Muxin, Tang Muxin wouldn’t care less for it—this little lass’ stand was very firm.
Speaking of which, although the food at this private party was almost just a decoration, it was still undeniable that it tasted quite good.

Very soon, Hong Dali was finally full. He lazily found a corner with very little people and rested on the sofa, waiting for the food to digest. The nine lackeys stood in rows by the side while Tang Muxin sat at one side and looked at the people dancing in the dancing pool with a smile on her face. It was a warm and funny scene, filled with the air of a prodigal.
As they were resting, the conversation from two people who were near them reached Hong Dali’s ear—

One person said, “Director Huang, do you think you can increase it by a bit? My company capital flow is having some difficulty currently. Once the payment for the goods is collected, I will definitely pay up the remaining sum.”

The person who was addressed as Director Huang spoke somewhat impatiently. “I’m also just following the rules. You’re aware too, the higher-ups are keeping a strict watch on us recently. If I don’t receive the money, how am I supposed to help you advertise your products? Frankly speaking, what if your company collapsed, who am I supposed to go get back the money from?”

The first person said, “That will not happen, Director Huang. Definitely not! I have already sold the goods, just that the payment hasn’t been made yet. The payment will reach us in just a month or two. Please help me think of something!”
From their conversation to this point, Hong Dali was already clear of the situation.

These two people, the first one had sold out the goods in his factory but was unable to collect the money, causing the cash flow in the company to break. Now, he didn’t have enough money for advertisement. If he couldn’t advertise his products, the new goods in his factory wouldn’t be able to be sold out. This would end up in a vicious loop. No wonder he was so panicked.

On the other hand, Director Huang was afraid of his company’s policies and afraid that the other person might go bankrupt. Thus, he didn’t dare to open up and agree. Otherwise, when he really couldn’t get the payment for the advertisement, the responsibility would be too great, and he wouldn’t be able to handle it.

As Hong Dali was thinking of this, he heard Director Huang say, “Director Ji, it isn’t that I’m not giving you respect. We have collaborated for so many years, and you have never caused any problem for us—your credit has always been quite good. But there really isn’t anything I can do. It’s tough to get a loan from the bank now, and you can’t collect the payment for your previous batch of goods. I really wanted to help you, but the responsibility is too great. Once I’m found out helping you advertise your products without collecting the money, I will be reported.”

That Director Ji let out a long sigh and said, “Since that’s the case, I shall not put you in a difficult position. Director Huang, I just raised three million yuan, can you give me some leeway and not take down my advertisement? As for the rest of the money, I will think of something and rush the other side to collect the payment as soon as possible. Is that OK?”

Director Huang said, “Three million yuan? Alright, then you can come to the station to sign the contract first. I will try my best to help you drag on for half a month. Remember, you must pay up the remaining money in the remaining half a month’s time. If not, you’re aware. Once the advertisement is removed from the golden timing, there are a lot of people who will take up the slot. If that happens, it will be difficult for you to put up advertisements anymore.”
“I know, I know.” Director Ji sighed and said, “I will pay up as soon as possible!”

The two of them finally finished their conversation. Hong Dali and Tang Muxin looked at each other. Tang Muxin softly said. “Surname is Ji, and he just raised three million yuan. Could it be that this uncle is Ji Zhiruo’s father?”
“80%, it’s him.” Hong Dali touched his chin. “Should I help him?”

Tang Muxin shook her head. “This is hard to help. What he needs now is to ensure that his advertisement will carry on. Once the payment stops and his advertisement is removed, the slot will be taken up. By that time, even if he has the money, there’s nothing he can do about it.”

“Right.” Hong Dali nodded and thought for a while before suddenly saying, “Xiaoyi, go and ask that uncle to come here for a moment.” After all, this was his classmate’s father. Since he was here to squander, there was not much difference between where it was squandered at.
Soon after, that person walked over.

Hong Dali took a look. This was a middle-aged man about 45 or 46 years old. He wore a simple western-style suit with tie, and the first impression that he gave off was pretty good. However, it was obvious that he wasn’t resting well lately. His eyes’ circles were a bit greenish, and his hair on the temples was turning white. It was plain to see that this event had caused him much anxiety.
“Uncle, how may I address you?” Hong Dali grinned and said, “I heard the entire conversation between you and that Director Huang just now.”

“Sigh, don’t mention about that anymore.” Director Ji said, “My name is Ji Tianyu, I’m the Director of Might Beverages Private Limited.” As he said this, he sighed again. It was obvious that he was feeling quite down now.
“Might Beverages?” Hong Dali was surprised. “This is a big brand. I drink it frequently.”

“So what if that’ the case?” Ji Tianyu gave a bitter smiled and said, “The goods were unable to be sold out, payments from previous batches couldn’t be collected, no money to advertise for the products. All the bad things keep coming together, sigh.”

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - Erase to the Zeros
paragraphs: Just as Ji Tianyu spoke up to this point, a girl’s surprised voice suddenly sounded. “Young Master Dali, what are you doing here?”

Hong Dali turned around and took a look. The girl’s appearance was delicate and beautiful, pitiful looking. Who else could it be but Ji Zhiruo? He instantly smiled and said, “Aren’t you here too, what’s there to be surprised for?”

Ji Zhiruo jogged to Ji Tianyu’s side and softly said, “Dad, how was your discussion?” After which she immediately introduced him to Hong Dali. “Young Master Dali, this is my father. I, I told you previously about him...”

“Heh heh, I heard everything.” Hong Dali asked, “Why not you tell me in detail? To be honest, I’m quite curious. By rights, your family’s company is on quite a large scale. How did it end up in this state?”
Ji Tianyu smiled bitterly and shook his head. He slowly said, “Speaking of which, this is but another proof of the phrase, ‘the business world is just like fighting a war.”

“At first, the sales for my Might Beverages were quite good. At that time, the sales result every year was on the rise, and you could say that I was flushed with success. However, the good times didn’t last long. Just as my company was slowly growing, another brand called Fierce Bull beverages suddenly appeared on the market.”

“From the time it entered the market, this Fierce Bull beverages was on a roll. Everywhere was flooded with its advertisements, causing quite a few beverage companies to close down. Actually, this is very normal. This is the market, after all; some people win and some people lose. Since this Fierce Bull got popular, the stocks of other beverages brands naturally couldn’t be sold out. Originally, my Might Beverages could be considered to be one of the larger brands in the market, so the impact was powerful. However...”

Speaking up to this point, Ji Tianyu sighed again and said, “Bad things always come together. Fierce Bull beverages suddenly got injected by a large sum of capital—tens of millions of yuan. It’s size immediately expanded, it’s advertisements were put up in many stations in the golden timing slot, it’s sales performance rose more and more. On the other hand, my goods couldn’t be sold out, the capital couldn’t recover, and now even the money for advertisements also ran out.”

“For food and beverages business such as mine, advertisements are vital. Once the advertisements stop, spenders will quickly forget about us, then it will get harder and harder to get our capital back. Under this vicious cycle, the time before we close down will not be long.”
After he explained it in simple and easy terms, Hong Dali understood his meaning perfectly.

This was how it was for the food and beverages industry—the competition was intense to the point of cruelty. It was a matter of life and death. Especially for the advertisements, it couldn’t stop. Otherwise, without enough publication, spenders will quickly forget that such a company even existed.

In his previous life, Hong Dali knew of quite a few factories that were doing pretty well, but because their advertisements didn’t keep up, spenders had forgotten about them in just half a year to a years’ time. Then, they either ended bankrupted or struggled to survive under the onslaught of new companies.

The situation of Ji Tianyu’s company was likely to be of the same. No wonder Ji Zhiruo didn’t attend the last few class gatherings, it was probably because that she didn’t have the mood to go out and play when her family was facing such a big problem.
Hong Dali sucked in a deep breath, suddenly turned around, and said to Xiaoyi, “Xiaoyi, help me check the background of this Fierce Bull.”
“OK.” Xiaoyi immediately turned around, went to a quiet corner, and made a call.
“Uncle Ji, don’t worry, we can think of something together.” Now that the information on the opponent wasn’t enough, Hong Dali could only comfort him first.

Very quickly, Xiaoyi came back. However, this time, the expression on her face was quite interesting, like she was crying and laughing at the same time. “Young Master, this Fierce Bull beverage, is... is...”
“What is it?” Hong Dali curiously asked.

“It’s a property under Hong Anbao’s name.” Ling Xiaoyi didn’t forget to remind Hong Dali. “Which is that Young Master from just now. Also, the 25 million yuan worth of capital was obtained by selling those estates that he sold to you.”
“What the heck!” Hearing this, Hong Dali almost jumped up. “No wonder he was in such a rush to sell those estates, so that’s the reason. This fellow is really vicious.”
Tang Muxin helplessly shrugged her shoulders. “See, I told you off that time when you were squandering. Now let’s see what you can do.”

“What can I do?” Hong Dali laughed and said, “Being a prodigal, I must buy two bowls of beancurd, drink one bowl, and pour one bowl. Companies must buy in pairs and use one to play with the other. Now, it’s obvious that both companies can’t be bought. The only solution is for one of them to play the other until it dies.”
Tang Muxin sighed softly. This was the first time she heard such a saying...

After saying this, Hong Dali looked at Ji Tianyu and said, “Uncle Ji, don’t worry. Although this Hong Anbao is from my family, our relationship is far from being close. I guess that he’s probably hoping that I can die as soon as possible. Therefore, we’re on the same side now. We might as well play a big one this time, heh heh.”
“Play a big one?” Tang Muxin curiously asked, “How to play?”
“That is simple.” Hong Dali looked at Ji Tianyu. “Uncle Ji, how much did Ji Zhiruo borrowed from me previously?”
Ji Tianyu said, “A total of 3,850,000 yuan.”

Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said, “Erase the behind digits to zero, take it as three million yuan. I will invest another three million in exchange for 10% of your company’s share. Then, we will be on the same side. What do you say?”
Tang Muxin smacked her forehead. “I have never seen someone erasing to the zeros like this...”
Being someone who was able to create such a big company, Ji Tianyu wasn’t a long-winded person. He instantly decided without another word. “OK!”
Hong Dali laughed and said, “That settles it then. This is what we shall do first...”

Their heads immediately came together. After hearing Hong Dali’s plan, Tang Muxin was the first to collapse on the floor in laughter. “Dali, this plan of yours is totally—hee hee, hahaha, it’s too funny!”
Everyone else in the group also lost themselves in laughter.
At the same time, on the other side of the party.
Tai Yajing hugged Hong Anbao’s arm and tenderly said, “Anbao, just now you said that you want to be my boyfriend, is that true?”

“How can that be false?” Hong Anbao gave a cheap laugh and touched her breast. After which, his eyes gradually moved towards her pair of long and sexy legs. He grinned and said, “Your legs are still so long, just that I’m not sure if some other man has touched them after that time?”

“Good gracious, you’re so mean.” Tai Yajing objected in a seductive tone. “Other than you, could I have possibly let anyone else touch even a hair of mine? Don’t change the topic, quickly tell me if you really mean it when you said that you wanted to be my boyfriend.”
Hong Anbao laughed loudly and complacently said, “Since you didn’t have relationships with any other man, then I shall take you in. There isn’t much problem in that.”

“Yup, you’re really my darling.” Tai Yajing instantly started to act coquettishly. After being intimate for a while, Tai Yajing asked, “Anbao, your Fierce Bull beverages is doing very well now. Do you have any new plans?”

Hong Anbao moved his mouth close to her ear and softly said, “Is there a need to ask? After I expand the company again this time on a larger scale, I will have some power to speak up during my Hong Family’s meeting. Hong Dali, that prodigal, humph. He’s already 18 this year. By that time, I will make him suffer!”
Tai Yajing secretly kissed Hong Anbao before curiously asking, “Speaking of which, why do you dislike him so much? He’s just an incapable prodigal.”
Hong Anbao smiled maliciously and viciously groped Tai Yajing’s leg. He said in a deep voice, “Don’t be a busybody, don’t ask what you shouldn’t ask.”

Everyone else in the group also lost themselves in laughter.
At the same time, on the other side of the party.
Tai Yajing hugged Hong Anbao’s arm and tenderly said, “Anbao, just now you said that you want to be my boyfriend, is that true?”
“How can that be false?” Hong Anbao gave a cheap laugh and touched her breast.
After which, his eyes gradually moved towards her pair of long and sexy legs.
He grinned and said, “Your legs are still so long, just that I’m not sure if some other man has touched them after that time?”
“Good gracious, you’re so mean.” Tai Yajing objected in a seductive tone.
“Other than you, could I have possibly let anyone else touch even a hair of mine?
Don’t change the topic, quickly tell me if you really mean it when you said that you wanted to be my boyfriend.”
Hong Anbao laughed loudly and complacently said, “Since you didn’t have relationships with any other man, then I shall take you in.
There isn’t much problem in that.”
“Yup, you’re really my darling.” Tai Yajing instantly started to act coquettishly.
After being intimate for a while, Tai Yajing asked, “Anbao, your Fierce Bull beverages is doing very well now.
Do you have any new plans?”
Hong Anbao moved his mouth close to her ear and softly said, “Is there a need to ask?
After I expand the company again this time on a larger scale, I will have some power to speak up during my Hong Family’s meeting.
Hong Dali, that prodigal, humph.
He’s already 18 this year.
By that time, I will make him suffer!”
Tai Yajing secretly kissed Hong Anbao before curiously asking, “Speaking of which, why do you dislike him so much?
He’s just an incapable prodigal.”
Hong Anbao smiled maliciously and viciously groped Tai Yajing’s leg.
He said in a deep voice, “Don’t be a busybody, don’t ask what you shouldn’t ask.”

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - Difference Between the Tips
paragraphs: Whilst Hong Dali and his gang were excitedly discussing the plans for the future, Ji Tianyu brought Ji Zhiruo along and directly went home to make arrangements. Now that he got this superprodigal Hong Dali as his support, it would be much easier for him in the future.

After ten minutes or so, shouts of surprise sounded from outside the door. Then, the cracking sounds of the flashes from the cameras could be heard as several cameras were pressed in a short amount of time. This was practically the craziest act that occurred during this private party as this carried on for another three whole minutes before the entrance door was pushed open. Two ladies walked into the room with slight smiles on their faces. Around them were ten plus security guards surrounding them. As Hong Dali turned around and took a look, he saw that it was Li Nianwei and her manager Zhang Cai that had arrived.
“I didn’t expect that my Sister Nianwei would be here too.” Hong Dali sniffled and said, “The capabilities and power of the boss behind this party are quite large.”

Li Nianwei wore a long black dress that dragged on behind her, her graceful carriage making her stand out immediately. Her hair was simply let loose around her shoulders, and she wore a pair of black high-heels. Her overall appearance wasn’t complicated, but the design wasn’t simple.

Exuding charm just by walking and looking around, she was like the sun, radiating off so much light that others almost couldn’t bear to watch. Everyone that she looked at felt nervous and inferior to her.

What was most surprising about her today was her neck. A thin platinum necklace was hanging on it, the reflecting light from it caused her neck to look smooth and pale. To the surprise of everyone, the pendant was just a one dollar coin!

Quite a lot of reporters raised their microphones high up and asked, “Lady Nianwei, what’s the reason for using this one dollar coin as the pendant, is there any special meaning or significance in it? This coin seems to be just an ordinary one dollar coin, could it be... that this is the one that Young Master gave to you?”
“Yes.” Li Nianwei carried a slight smile on her face, and her voice was pure like water. “This is just an ordinary one dollar coin. But in my heart, it’s a priceless treasure.”
Everyone was moved to tears.

Since Li Nianwei entered the stage, she blocked out all of the light from Tai Yajing. Standing at quite a distance away from Li Nianwei and holding Hong Anbao’s arm, Tai Yajing looked at the direction of the entrance and said in a tone full of spite and jealousy, “She’s just a newbie who’s being kept as a mistress, what is she so cocky for?”

Li Nianwei walked directly inwards, and the surrounding people split apart and left a path for her to walk on their own initiative, furiously clapping their hands as she walked past. When she walked near Tai Yajing, she lightly nodded her head, smiled and said, “Greeting to you, senior. I have heard of your famous name for a long time. Now that I have finally met you in person, I can see that you live up to your reputation. Please guide me in the future.” The speech that Tai Yajing said to Hong Dali just moments ago was returned to her in full now with just a slight change. However, the tone and expression were entirely different.

Although unwilling, Tai Yajing didn’t dare put up a face in front of so many reporters. After all, they would both be working in the entertainment industry in the future. She unwillingly said, “You’re too modest, let us take care of each other in the future.”
“Thank you, then.” Li Nianwei smiled and said.

“What are you so cocky for. Damn, you’ll be just a golden sparrow in the future. Now that you’re Hong Dali’s mistress, your future is already ruined.” Tai Yajing wasn’t sought after any more now that Li Nianwei was here and thought in her heart. However, she lacked the courage to speak it out loud.

At this moment, Hong Dali walked over and welcomed her with a grin. When they met, he hugged Li Nianwei’s elbow and said, “Sister Nianwei, you’re here too? You look really pretty today, I shall tip you 50,000 yuan! Sister Cai too!”

“Thank you, Young Master.” Upon hearing this, Li Nianwei didn’t feel embarrassed at all. She calmly agreed, smiled and said, “How long have Young Master been here for? I heard about this private party just a while ago and that there is a charity auction here. Therefore, I came here to join in the fun and play a part in society too, heh heh.”

Although Li Nianwei spoke of it lightly, in reality, it wasn’t as simple as she said. For today’s private party, those who attended included Tai Yajing, the famous celebrity, Hong Anbao, Director Huang from the television station, and Liu Mingxin. The background of the host was definitely powerful to be able to attract so many famous and influential people here.
Hong Dali wasn’t sure of other people, but he knew that Liu Mingxin was a person who was very proud of himself. A normal person would not have been able to invite him here.

As Hong Dali and Li Nianwei chatted, Tai Yajing, who was at the side listening, felt sourness in her heart. “Why am I only worth 20,000 yuan in tips but she is worth 50,000 yuan? Isn’t this difference too much?”
She was lucky that Hong Dali didn’t know her thought, or else, he would definitely tell her that 20,000 yuan was too much for her. She should be only worth 200 yuan worth of tips.

From the current scene, it would appear that Hong Anbao and Tai Yajing were a pair. As for Hong Dali, his group formation was formidable. He had two great beauties by his side—Tang Muxin and Li Nianwei. He also had nine lackeys plus one driver following him; the spectacle was really stunning. Just by looking at this, one could tell just by thinking with their feet that Hong Dali was a superprodigal and a great hedonist, which was exactly what Hong Dali wanted others to think of him.

As expected, just as this two groups of people were acting amicable on the surface but were secretly thinking evil of each other on the inside, a gentle baritone voice sounded: “I was wondering who came with such a big formation. As expected, it was Young Master Dali who arrived. Oh? Lady Nianwei is here too, this is really unexpected. I, Liu Mingxin, give you my greetings, Lady Nianwei.”

Someone who would speak in such a manner and such words was naturally the one was loved by anyone who saw him, the invincibly handsome Big Young Master Liu Mingxin who just arrived. As he finished, the surrounding people immediately screamed again.
That was why Hong Dali disliked this guy. It was a crime for one to be too handsome.

Hearing his words, Li Nianwei turned and just lightly nodded her head, keeping a light distance from him. As for Hong Dali, he grinned and said, “So it’s our Big Young Master Liu. I was just saying how come you haven’t got here after so long. Come, come, come. I must introduce this person to you.”

Hong Dali grabbed his sleeve and said towards Hong Anbao, “This is my brother from the family, Hong Anbao. He’s a business prodigy, with Fierce Bull beverages under him. Oh my, this advertisement of his, it was really all over the place. Very impressive, indeed!”

Although they were enemies, hearing Hong Dali praising him in front of so many people still made him felt great inside. Hong Anbao hurriedly reached out his hand and put on his most sincere smile, saying, “Hello, hello.”

Once Liu Mingxin reached out and held his hand, Hong Dali again said, “This is Liu Mingxin, hm... I forgot which gaming company it was that belonged to him. What was it called again? Basically, he is really formidable, much better than me who is a prodigal.”
Liu Mingxin slightly nodded and said, “Hello, I’m Mingxin Network’s director. Please guide me in the future.”
Once they shook hands, the introduction was over.

Hong Dali, Tang Muxin and the rest of his gang almost laughed their hearts out. This Liu Mingxin was a business prodigy, and Hong Anbao was always very proud of himself. One belonged to the Hong family, while the other belonged to the Liu family. Now that the two of them met, there definitely wouldn’t be a happy ending. Hong Anbao might not dare to make a move against Liu Mingxin, but Liu Mingxin even dared to lay his hands on Hong Dali; he definitely wouldn’t leave Hong Anbao alone.
A simple plan of using the wolf to eat the tiger, it could be expected that Hong Anbao would have something to worry about in the future.

The most brilliant part of it was that both of them were being sold out by Hong Dali and had no notion of it. Especially Tai Yajing whose eyes had never left Liu Mingxin for more than two seconds ever since he stepped inside the room. With such a bomb that could go off at any time, it could be expected that there would be a great show to enjoy this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - A Toy to Grind One’s Teeth
paragraphs: Expectedly, it went as Hong Dali predicted. After all, Hong Anbao wasn’t a fool, he quickly realized what was going on with Tai Yajing.

Being a proud and arrogant Young Master, Hong Anbao naturally would not reprimand Tai Yajing, that love-struck idiot, in public. His first instinct was to win over Liu Mingxin in the bidding for the auction later, so as to show who was the real winner in life.
If Hong Dali knew what he was thinking now, he would definitely sigh—this was plainly a suppression of his intelligence level over Hong Anbao’s.

In just a short moment, the people all gathered and moved to an inner hall. Without question, that was the venue for holding the auction. Since this was a charity auction, all the proceeds would be used to do charity. This would help boost one’s public image; therefore, no one present refused.

As Hong Dali and his group majestically entered the hall, Hong Dali brought Tang Muxin and Li Nianwei to the best seats and sat down. If anyone dared to oppose him, his lackeys would glare at them angrily. By then, everyone was aware that he was the renowned prodigal in Tianjing City. Thus, they could only swallow their anger and keep quiet. After all, they couldn’t afford to offend the Hong family.
The environment was slightly dusky. As the auction hall quickly became full, those who knew each other seated together and discussed the auction items.
Tang Muxin sat beside Hong Dali, looking around in boredom. Suddenly, she caught sight of someone in the corner of her eye. Giving out a sound of surprise, she said, “What is she doing here?”
Hong Dali curiously asked, “Who? Who is here?”

“Ah, it’s nothing.” Although she said that, Tang Muxin secretly thought in her heart: Is it truly her? The Blood Concubine? Is there some hidden meaning for her being here? Is she here to bid for the items too? She instantly shook her head.What can possibly catch her eye here? This is really strange. I must have seen wrongly.
Just at this moment, Hong Dali suddenly felt something and turned his head around.

Following his line of sight, Hong Anbao, who was seated to the right and in front of him, was secretly glancing at Liu Mingxin who was three meters away on the left, his mouth hanging with an evil smile. Hong Dali immediately pulled Tang Muxin’s elbow. “There’s a good show to be seen soon. From the looks of it, that brother of mine is seeking to show off his manly awe soon.”

Seeing this, Tang Muxin secretly laughed. This trick of using the wolf to eat the tiger by Hong Dali was really too evil. Both of them were proud and arrogant, there would definitely be a good show today.
At the same time, the people surround them was pointing and mentioning towards Hong Dali too.

There was no need to mention Li Nianwei. Now that her fame was over the sky limits, she naturally attracted others’ attention. Combined with Hong Dali, who was a superprodigal in everyone’s hearts, the effect was imaginable.
A lot of people were looking to enjoy a good show. Although it was a charity auction, a fantastic fight could definitely be expected today.
Moments later, the lighting softened. That was a sign that the auction was about to start.
The murmuring and discussion noise in the hall immediately quietened down. Very soon, the stage suddenly brightened up, and the auction started.

A man with a mustache walked up on stage and spoke gradually in a deep and seducing voice, “Hello, everyone. I’m Su Lei, the host for today’s auction. I believe that everyone has gone through the contents’ manual for the items today. Without further ado, let’s start with the first item!”
“Contents’ Manual? How come I didn’t see it?” Hong Dali’s face was full of surprise.
“Oh, we were asked here by Liu Mingxin in the last minute, so we don’t have one.” Tang Muxin pulled him and softly murmured, “But that’s ok, just prepare to bid later.”
“Oh, OK.” Hong Dali directly replied.
On stage, Su Lei continued to speak while looking around, then lightly clapped his hands. An attendant instantly brought forth the first auction item.
The item didn’t seem to be large in size and was covered by a red cloth. Just as Su Lei was about to introduce the item, a voice directly sounded off from below. “300,000 yuan!”
“Er...” Su Lei was almost choked to death by his own saliva. He gave a few violent coughs before carefully saying towards the source of the voice, “This Sir, I haven’t introduced the item yet...”
Hong Dali sniffled and said, “I know that. Is it not enough? Then I shall bid 400,000 yuan instead. If no one wants this item, then I shall take it.”

At times like this, Su Lei’s experience as a seasoned auctioneer came to use. He decisively said in a 200 words per minute speed, “This is a green sculpted jade which is excellent in both quality and design it was refined by the famous master of sculpting Mr. Jia Hongguang the starting price is 50,000 yuan this Sir has already bid 400,000 yuan is there anyone else who wants to bid too!?”
The rest of the people all shook their heads. Then, Su Lei resolutely dropped his hammer. “Deal!”

Speaking of which, he was indeed good at controlling the mood of the crowd. Every time he reported a price, he would make them feel that the item was not only worth the price, but he also caused the atmosphere to be maintained constantly at a climax.
Also, Su Lei was quite confident that the final price of this jade that had a 50,000 yuan starting price could be brought to above 200,000 yuan.

Even if he thought until his head broke, he could have never expected that before he even started the bidding process, Hong Dali would bid a price of 400,000 yuan to win the item. Luckily, his reaction was still fast enough...
Now, all those attending the charity auction broke-down.
It was not that they had never seen awesome people before, but someone as awesome as Hong Dali was someone they were seeing for the first time.
Then, they heard a sentence that made them even more broke-down.
They heard Hong Dali say, “The little Samoyed in my house finally has something to grind his teeth with, not bad.”
A high price of 400,000 yuan, with the aim of buying a tooth-grinding toy for his dog!? All those present felt their sense of logic being shattered to the floor and broken into pieces.
One person said, “I’m crazy, I’m really crazy! This... isn’t this simply too much squandering?”
Another person said, “I have really expanded my horizons today. One can really anger oneself to death if we compare ourselves with others.”
A third person said, “This superprodigal from the Hong Family really lives up to his reputation. I must say that I’m impressed!”
Tang Muxin almost laughed her heart out. This Hong Dali was really natural at being a prodigal. With his act today, no one would imagine that he did it on purpose.
Indeed, Hong Anbao, who was sitting at the front, laughed loudly and slapped his thigh. “This prodigal, hahaha!”

As for Liu Mingxin, he helplessly shook his head. “This Hong Dali, he’s really a prodigal just like the rumors say. Sigh, regarding this kind of person as a rival is really beneath my status. Forget it, I shouldn’t fight with this kind of joker. There isn’t any meaning in it. Instead, this Hong Anbao seems to harbor quite a sense hostility towards me. It should be quite interesting to play around with him.”

At times like this, Su Lei’s experience as a seasoned auctioneer came to use.
He decisively said in a 200 words per minute speed, “This is a green sculpted jade which is excellent in both quality and design it was refined by the famous master of sculpting Mr.
Jia Hongguang the starting price is 50,000 yuan this Sir has already bid 400,000 yuan is there anyone else who wants to bid too!?”
The rest of the people all shook their heads.
Then, Su Lei resolutely dropped his hammer.
“Deal!”
Speaking of which, he was indeed good at controlling the mood of the crowd.
Every time he reported a price, he would make them feel that the item was not only worth the price, but he also caused the atmosphere to be maintained constantly at a climax.
Also, Su Lei was quite confident that the final price of this jade that had a 50,000 yuan starting price could be brought to above 200,000 yuan.
Even if he thought until his head broke, he could have never expected that before he even started the bidding process, Hong Dali would bid a price of 400,000 yuan to win the item.
Luckily, his reaction was still fast enough...
Now, all those attending the charity auction broke-down.
It was not that they had never seen awesome people before, but someone as awesome as Hong Dali was someone they were seeing for the first time.
Then, they heard a sentence that made them even more broke-down.
They heard Hong Dali say, “The little Samoyed in my house finally has something to grind his teeth with, not bad.”
A high price of 400,000 yuan, with the aim of buying a tooth-grinding toy for his dog!?
All those present felt their sense of logic being shattered to the floor and broken into pieces.
One person said, “I’m crazy, I’m really crazy!
This... isn’t this simply too much squandering?”
Another person said, “I have really expanded my horizons today.
One can really anger oneself to death if we compare ourselves with others.”
A third person said, “This superprodigal from the Hong Family really lives up to his reputation.
I must say that I’m impressed!”
Tang Muxin almost laughed her heart out.
This Hong Dali was really natural at being a prodigal.
With his act today, no one would imagine that he did it on purpose.
Indeed, Hong Anbao, who was sitting at the front, laughed loudly and slapped his thigh.
“This prodigal, hahaha!”
As for Liu Mingxin, he helplessly shook his head.
“This Hong Dali, he’s really a prodigal just like the rumors say.
Sigh, regarding this kind of person as a rival is really beneath my status.
Forget it, I shouldn’t fight with this kind of joker.
There isn’t any meaning in it.
Instead, this Hong Anbao seems to harbor quite a sense hostility towards me.
It should be quite interesting to play around with him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - I Didnt Regret It, Just That My Intestines Went Green
paragraphs: In a flash, the past few irrelevant auctioned items had been auctioned off. Su Lei laughed and said, “Everyone, our auction house received a treasure a few days ago that I believe everyone will be interested. This treasure is an awesome weapon!”
After completing the sentence, he clapped his hands, and immediately, an attendant carried a red sandalwood tray, on which lay a long wooden chest.

After opening the wooden chest, Su Lei retrieved a longsword from within. A crisp, clearshingsound materialized with the pulling out of the sword. The sword had a dragon’s roar to it and brightly glittered, truly befitting of an item worth auctioning. It was indeed an extraordinary piece of equipment.

“This longsword is named the Iron Executioner. It was manufactured by our Heavenly State’s most famous blacksmith, Ruan Chengzhi. Its blade is extremely sharp and is definitely an elite level weapon, a treasure worth collecting! Everybody knows that this is the age of technology. This kind of ancient, purely handcrafted weapon normally is highly valued but has no market to buy from. We all know many people love to decorate the walls of their homes with an elegant, beautiful longsword. We call it ‘hanging sword,’ but this Iron Executioner longsword is definitely fitting of its title as the house guarding treasure sword! Everyone, please have a look!”

As he was done talking, an attendant holding a metal pole walked up to the stage. Su Lei wielded the Iron Executioner Sword and swung it with a crispswooshsound. A softchasound was heard, and the metal pole was split into two segments, with the slicing point as smooth as a mirror. This feat got the cheers and screams from all the guests present in the area.
Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “This thing is really not bad.”
The surrounding crowd likewise nodded their heads.
“Now,” Realizing that everyone was hooked by it, Su Lei nodded in satisfaction and loudly announced: “The Iron Executioner is now up for auction. First bid, 100,000. Please start bidding.”
“This is good, I’ll buy and play with it!” Hong Dali immediately raised his sign and shouted, “300,000!”
Tripling the value in just one bid? Who the heck does that!

This bid instantly outbid at least 80% of those who were planning to submit their bids. However, after all, there were still people who loved to collect these kinds of God-level treasure swords. Very quickly, someone submitted a higher bid. “350,000.”
“Someone has bid 350,000. Anyone going for higher? 350,000 going once!”
“500,000.” Hong Dali didn’t even think twice and submitted another bid.

At that moment, Hong Anbao sneered and said, “This prodigal has started; seems like he really wants this. I should take this opportunity to lay a trap for him.” As he thought of that, Hong Anbao slowly raised his sign and said, “600,000.”
Hearing that, the entire auction venue immediately turned silent.

Surprisingly, it was Hong Anbao from the Hong Family! Speaking of the Hong Family, they were known by every single person in the venue. That was the high and mighty Hong Family that had their influence spread over more than half of the country. Although most people would first think of Hong Weiguo, the leading identity, Hong Anbao was also a powerful subsidiary of the Hong Family—he had a decent status in the Hong Family. Didn’t you see that? Even the great actress Tai Yajing wanted something to do with his family, there was much less to say about other people.
Since Hong Anbao had shouted a high bid of 500,000, he had both face and money. The entire auction venue instantly turned silent.
No one was willing to offend the Hong Family.
While the Iron Executioner was great, it wasn’t something particularly precious. Even if it was rare, it was, after all, not a necessity.
Besides, the most important thing was, Hong Anbao and Hong Dali were completely different in nature.

Hong Dali was a well-known prodigal—he gave no qualms about spending money. Even if someone raised his bid, he would not mind. However, that Hong Anbao was different. If he had wanted anything, fighting with him over it would not end well.
Hence, at that instant, the entire venue turned silent, and everyone’s eyes turned towards Hong Dali and Hong Anbao.
Sitting aside and watching the tigers fight, this exciting scene wasn’t something they saw every day.
“Iron Executioner Sword, 500,000, going once!”
Su Lei saw Hong Anbao bid and gave him some face, immediately facilitating the bidding.
Hong Anbao was smug and did not forget to turn back and laugh at Hong Dali.
“800,000.” Hong Dali twitched his nose, and his expression was quite unperturbed. In reality, to him, there was no need to hesitate for any price within 5,000,000.
“1,000,000!” Hong Anbao clearly understood Hong Dali’s limit and immediately raised his sign and continued the bid.
“1,500,000.” Hong Dali did not hesitate for one bit and even grinned.

Pricing a regular high-grade iron manufactured sword at 500,000 was already considered a sky-high price to the others. That could still be justified as giving support to the charity. Instantly inflating the price to 1,800,000, however, was really astonishing.
“2,150,000.” Hong Dali continued.
At that moment, Hong Anbao was completely into the tempo. As if by reflex, he raised his sign and shouted, “2,500,000!”
Alas, the moment he shouted the bid, he knew he had done something bad. Indeed, many people were secretly laughing. Hong Anbao’s face turned blue and hurriedly changed the bid, “2,600,000!”

However, this time, Hong Dali did not raise the bid. Hong Anbao only heard Tang Muxin, who was sitting beside Hong Dali, say, “Dali, stop bidding. I just realized, are you even strong enough to play with that thing?”

“Eh!?” Hong Dali seemed to have woken up from a dream. He thought about it carefully and suddenly exclaimed in shock. “Ah! Good thing you reminded me. Good, good. He just raised the bid again, right? Then I shall withdraw!”
I shall withdraw... withdraw... draw...
The auction venue turned silent. After a brief moment of silence, people suddenly burst out in discussions!
“He, he actually gave up! He actually gave up at this moment?”
“You don’t say! It’s just a sword. That would’ve been worth at most 500,000 to 600,000. Now, it’s at 2,600,000, what a sky-high value!”
“Yeah, yeah. What a back-out just as it was at the climax. Had it been me, I would have fought till the end for my face.”
“How else would we say you suck? Lacking the resolute determination, how could you advance and retreat at will? There’s a difference in level.”

“Look at what you all are saying, how is it all that glamorous? Didn’t you hear Young Master Dali say? He has always had a weak body. That thing is probably quite a few kilograms heavy. He was originally planning to buy it to play with it. Now that he realized that he probably can’t handle it properly, he didn’t feel like playing with it anymore. It’s perfectly normal to give up. Just that...” He didn’t complete his sentence, but everyone naturally knew what he meant.
Hong Anbao gritted his teeth and sank into his chair. He wanted to cry but couldn’t.

He had calculated Hong Dali’s baseline, but he forgot Hong Dali’s body! Now that he thought of it, what kind of body did that Hong Dali have? Someone who got tired from walking for about a kilometer or so could definitely not handle that thing properly. Had it been something else that caught his eye, he would have no qualms bidding up to 4,000,000. But alas, it was just such a thing that didn’t suit him.
This time it was definitely a huge loss. 2,600,000! This wasn’t a small sum.

But what caused the most damage to Hong Anbao was that he could not even display any hint of regret—that would invite even more contempt. He could only pretend that he really wanted that article very badly, as he kept smiling to everyone around him, seemingly showing that he was very satisfied.
Hong Anbao didn’t regret it, just that his intestines went green.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - Dark Gold Quality, Trustworthy
paragraphs: At this point, Su Lei could only sigh. “This is all I can do for you!” He then resolutely held the hammer and continued, “2,600,000 going once. 2,600,000 going twice. 2,600,000 going thrice!” The hammer finally went down. “Deal!”

2,600,000, that was 2,600,000! Had it been a normal person, 2,600,000 would have been enough to spend for multiple lifetimes, and there would probably still be some left over. Even for a rich family, it would also have been enough for a lavish two to three generations.
But the words had already been said. In front of so many people, he could only hold it in!
Unfortunately, he did not dare to exact vengeance. If Hong Dali withdrew again due to whatever reason, he would have had to commit suicide!

Liu Mingxin, who was at the side, couldn’t help but shake his head. That Hong Dali was too unpredictable. Simply playing around was fine, but he shouldn’t go too far. Had Hong Anbao not charged ahead in front, Liu Mingxin felt that he would have been the depressed one—who would have thought that Hong Dali would withdraw due to that reason?

Tang Muxin laughed till her abs almost materialized with her eyes squinted in the shape of a crescent moon. Li Nianwei at the side also couldn’t help but chuckle. Whoever wanted to cheat Young Master Dali would be akin to jumping off a cliff. Young Master Dali would even give a hard kick from behind to help with the fall.
“Speaking of which, playing with blades and swords is indeed not a thing for a prodigal like me. Lucky I didn’t get it.” Hong Dali beamed with delight.
Meanwhile, at the front, Hong Anbao seemed like he was about to spew blood.
The next item up for auction, which was the second highlight of the auction, was a secret piece of jewelry.

“The next item up for auction is a piece of jewelry from the Tang Dynasty.” Su Lei once again activated his eloquent tongue, but this time, he learned first to introduce the item. “This piece of jewelry is oriental and valuable. Both its workmanship and material quality are considered top notch. Its name is the Dark Gold Earring!”
At this time, the attendant who was by the side carried a wooden tray forth, on top of which also lay a piece of red cloth.
“Everybody, please take a look!” Su Lei was about to unveil the red cloth when Hong Dali directly shouted, “500,000!”

What the heck, not again! Since this had already happened once, this time Su Lei was quick to respond and immediately unveiled the red cloth. “The Dark Gold Earring’s starting bid is 150,000, but Young Master Hong Dali already bid 500,000. Does anyone else want to bid?”
This earring looked decent indeed, and its actual price was at about 800,000. Hence, this time, many people cooperated and bid.
Liu Mingxin was about to raise his sign and bid 1,000,000 when Hong Dali resolutely bid: “1,200,000!”
Liu Mingxin helplessly shook his head and put his sign down.
The crowd started to give up—God knows whether Young Master Hong Dali wanted that item or not...
The final result was clear without any doubt. This set of Dark Gold Earrings was sold to Hong Dali at the high price of 1,200,000 yuan.
“Dali, why did you buy the earrings? You can’t wear them anyway.” As the auction for this item ended, Tang Muxin half curiously, half intentionally probed.

Hong Dali sniffled and said, “Didn’t you hear the name of these earrings? It’s Dark Gold, Dark Gold! This is definitely something valuable. When I’m on my game, those Dark Gold equipment stats are really strong. There’s a saying, Dark Gold quality items are trustworthy.”
Tang Muxin immediately collapsed in laughter. They both had already planned to squander big time even before they came. This Hong Dali was really talented at doing so...

Having said that, Hong Dali immediately turned around and asked Li Nianwei, “Sister Nianwei, I noticed that you still don’t have earrings. Here, these earrings are for you. Hehe, Dark Gold equipment are precious, they’ve quite a few additional stats!”
Li Nianwei gently smiled and replied, “Alright.”
Her goddess-like smile instantly charmed all the guys nearby.

Liu Mingxin covered his face.I treated Hong Dali as a rival. But... forget it, take it that I was wrong. Next time we’ll just let this clown squander as he deems fit. Pitting against him will only reduce my own intelligence.

Although Hong Anbao had lost 2,600,000, at this moment, he didn’t feel so depressed and instead thought, This prodigal, fine, let him squander big time. I assume that those old fogeys in the family will not simply let him squander his family’s entire assets away. It would be good if I can get even 10% of his family’s assets.Having thought so, he felt much better.
Of course, Hong Dali was even more pleased—this was the effect he wanted!

“Ladies and gentlemen, next up is our last item up for auction. I have to say this. This item is very incredulous.” At this moment, the auction was about to reach its end. The auctioneer Su Lei cleared his throat and introduced. “This item, in reality, is a technology, a marvelous technology!”
Having heard Su Lei’s introduction, the crowd immediately got really curious.
“Technology, what kind of technology can be up for auction?”
“You’re not fooling around with us, are you? That can’t be just a single copy. Once it gets copied, the entire world will have learned it already.”
“Yeah, yeah, technology is not something unique.”
Before arriving, everyone was curious about this item while browsing the auction handbook. Naturally, they had to clear this doubt when the time came.

It was natural that everyone felt it was strange. One had to understand that, strictly speaking, a technology could be infinitely duplicated. Especially in such an auction. Since a copy of technology was being auctioned, the creator would definitely have had created a copy. Even if there wasn’t a copy, the creator himself was as good as a copy, as he could fine tune it and put it up for sale again anytime.

“Everyone be quiet, quiet!” Su Lei gestured and waited for the crowd to quieten, before solemnly continuing, “Strictly speaking, this technology, exactly as everyone has mentioned, has all the reasons as to why it should not be apt for auction. However, this unprecedented technology is indeed a highly advanced one. However, the creator has used up his entire funding and has no choice but to put it up for auction in exchange for funding. As to how much it can fetch, this is up to you all, no obligations.”
Noticing that the crowd did not have any objection, Su Lei cleared his throat and solemnly continued, “This technology is named Virtual Reality Projection. Everyone, please watch the demonstration.”

Immediately, an attendant dressed in a blue, tight-fitting outfit with black nodes scattered all over walked up the auction stage. Subsequently, another two attendants carried a gigantic television screen up as well.
Very quickly, everyone knew what this technology was.

When the television screen was switched on, the attendant in the tight blue outfit started to perform all kinds of movements. Simultaneously, a simple 3D figure on the screen actually began copying and performing the exact same movements.

After a minute of demonstration, the attendants left the stage, and Su Lei loudly said, “I believe everyone now understands the general idea of this technology. Then, this Virtual Reality Projection technology, nodal projection outfit, working principle, and manufacturing method will start at 500,000. The auction starts now.”

“You’re not fooling around with us, are you?
That can’t be just a single copy.
Once it gets copied, the entire world will have learned it already.”
“Yeah, yeah, technology is not something unique.”
Before arriving, everyone was curious about this item while browsing the auction handbook.
Naturally, they had to clear this doubt when the time came.
It was natural that everyone felt it was strange.
One had to understand that, strictly speaking, a technology could be infinitely duplicated.
Especially in such an auction.
Since a copy of technology was being auctioned, the creator would definitely have had created a copy.
Even if there wasn’t a copy, the creator himself was as good as a copy, as he could fine tune it and put it up for sale again anytime.

“Everyone be quiet, quiet!” Su Lei gestured and waited for the crowd to quieten, before solemnly continuing, “Strictly speaking, this technology, exactly as everyone has mentioned, has all the reasons as to why it should not be apt for auction.
However, this unprecedented technology is indeed a highly advanced one.
However, the creator has used up his entire funding and has no choice but to put it up for auction in exchange for funding.
As to how much it can fetch, this is up to you all, no obligations.”
Noticing that the crowd did not have any objection, Su Lei cleared his throat and solemnly continued, “This technology is named Virtual Reality Projection.
Everyone, please watch the demonstration.”
Immediately, an attendant dressed in a blue, tight-fitting outfit with black nodes scattered all over walked up the auction stage.
Subsequently, another two attendants carried a gigantic television screen up as well.
Very quickly, everyone knew what this technology was.
When the television screen was switched on, the attendant in the tight blue outfit started to perform all kinds of movements.
Simultaneously, a simple 3D figure on the screen actually began copying and performing the exact same movements.
After a minute of demonstration, the attendants left the stage, and Su Lei loudly said, “I believe everyone now understands the general idea of this technology.
Then, this Virtual Reality Projection technology, nodal projection outfit, working principle, and manufacturing method will start at 500,000.
The auction starts now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - Sister Blood Consort
paragraphs: “1,000,000.” Hong Dali raised his auction plate right after the auctioneer finished speaking.
Tang Muxin curiously asked, “Dali, why do you even want to buy this? What can it be used for? You don’t even need it.”
Her question aroused the attention of those sitting around them. Everyone kept their ears pricked up and held their breaths, hoping to hear the great prodigal’s answer.

“This seems to be fun to play with!” Hong Dali’s eyes were shining, glaring intensely at the set of technology. “Even though I’m unsure of what it actually is, it seems to be very valuable and powerful. I will just purchase it first!”
The people that heard it had their jaws dropped.
Even when he had no idea what it was, he wanted to buy it to play with it. What a prodigal! He was obviously just trying to purchase it no matter what, not even considering if it was worth it or not.

At this moment, Hong Anbao felt troubled in his heart.Should I try to raise the price higher? If I raise it only by a bit, it would be so embarrassing. However, if I raise it too high, what would happen if this wastrel gave up suddenly? I would then have wasted around five million... My company only brings about an annual income of 40 million. If something were to happen, I would have wasted one and a half months’ worth of income and effort in running the company.Thinking of this, Hong Anbao sighed helplessly.Keep calm, I must keep calm! This brat has his parents spoiling him, giving him however much pocket money he wants. But I’m different. I must hold back! In the end, he decided not to raise the price further.

On the other side, Liu Mingxin quickly raised his plate. “1.2 million.” He then touched his chin and pondered.This set of technology is quite high-end, but my company has no use for it. To be realistic, I too do not know what it can be used for. Well, I will just raise a little before stopping. There’s not much meaning in competing with Hong Dali in terms of squandering. He has parents who spoil him, and it’s said that his parents give him hundreds of thousands or even millions in one go. The main point is to make him spend more money anyway. If he were to give up the bidding halfway, I will lose big.

Liu Mingxin had always been a calm and collected person and was considered a model pragmatist. Unless it was something that he really must get, he would not be setting his determination to purchase it. This was also similar to how he employed people in his company. Everything was considered from a realistic point of view and not just the academic qualifications of the applicants—which explained why his game company kept expanding and achieving stellar results.
“1,500,000!” Hong Dali did not consider much. As long as he felt it was fun, he would buy it. He never considered the value besides purchasing the item.

“1,700,000.” Liu Mingxin once again raised the price, while thinking inside: Let’s stop at this. It’s enough to know what sort of person he is, there is no need to be too overconcerned over this matter. Hong Dali himself is not a bad person. However, it’s a pity that we’re of different stands. If we were to become friends, it would definitely not be a bad thing. Aii, a pity, a pity.
“2,000,000!” Hong Dali raised his plate once again.
“I give up.” Liu Mingxin stopped decisively. This technology was indeed high-end. However, the problem lied in its usefulness. Thus, it could be considered as just playing around.
“2,000,000 going once! 2,000,000 going twice! 2,000,000 going thrice!”
“Sold!”
The auctioneer, Su Lei, knocked the hammer to signify the end of the bid.

Finally, the auction was coming to an end. Hong Anbao used 2,600,000 to purchase a brand new prized sword, while Liu Mingxin did not manage to buy anything. Hong Dali, who was the happiest, walked away with a bright smile on his face while saying, “Haha, it was really a good decision to come today. My house’s Samoyed finally has a toy, and I managed to gift Sister Nianwei a set of earrings. Lastly, the set of technological equipment purchased also seems to be pretty good, haha!” How could he not be happy? After sneaking a peek at the system window, he realized he had squandered over 4,000,000, which could be used to redeem 40 attribute points!

“You’re really hopeless... buying it without even knowing what this thing can do.” Tang Muxin said with a smile. “Go home and play with it, and see if you can find out what it can be used for.” After a successful squander battle, Liu Mingxin’s attention turned to Hong Anbao. From now on, Hong Anbao would not be too concerned about Hong Dali, and Hong Dali could be a happy prodigal. In fact, it was quite good to think about it like this.

“Sister Nianwei, the earrings you’re wearing look beautiful on you.” Hong Dali looked from the left and right, and the more he looked, the more he liked it. After taking two more steps, he took a sniff and became slightly depressed. “It’s a pity, I didn’t find something that suits you, Xinxin. I originally wanted to find you a suitable gift, but I couldn’t find it. The previous ones were too cheap and not interesting enough.”
“Aiya, I have no need for these.” After listening to what Dali said, Tang Muxin felt slightly embarrassed. “There’s no need to sulk over it, there will be plenty of chances in the future.”
“Alright, then. When I see something in the future that suits you, I will definitely buy it for you.”

Li Nianwei, who stood beside them, smiled and said, “Young Madam looks good in whatever she wears. However, her bag seems to be slightly not up to standard. Why not purchase a better bag for her? Bags are essential accessories for girls.”
“Good idea! That’s settled, then!”

The group of people talked and laughed while they walked out. After exiting the elevator, just outside the famous Jin building, Tang Muxin suddenly exclaimed. “Sister Blood Consort, why are you here?! Were you really the person at the auction house?”
Sister Blood Consort?! The student in our class who never turns up for lessons?
Hong Dali curiously peered over and was shocked momentarily at what he saw.

The girl was about the same age as himself, and her blue hair was tied with two ponytails that drooped till below her hips. She had a slim figure and a slightly flat chest. Wearing a bell-sleeved shirt with a short skirt and black stockings, she looked very youthful and pure.

Her pair of eyes were big and clear, and though she was expressionless, it was not able to cover her beautiful face. If she were to be rated, if Tang Muxin scored a full 100 points, this girl whose nickname was “Sister Blood Consort” would have scored 99.5 points at the least.
However, this was not the reason that shocked Hong Dali.

The girls at his side, such as Tang Muxin and Li Nianwei, were both stunning beauties who were flawless in every aspect. Thus, Hong Dali was able to resist the temptation of beauties easily. What caused him to be shocked was the makeup that Sister Blood Consort had on. Hong Dali blurted out a name: “You’re Hatsune? Hatsune Miku?”
The Hatsune Miku who sang the famous Leek Song on Earth? Hong Dali vigorously rubbed his eyes.

“Nice to meet you, I’m Lin Chuyin.” Sister Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin, slowly walked forward and reached out her hand expressionlessly towards Hong Dali. “Where is the Virtual Reality Projection technology?”

“How can you speak to Young Master like this?” After hearing how Lin Chuyin spoke, Hong Dali’s lackeys became agitated. One male lackey rushed up, preparing to take action. “Why do you think Young Master should give it to you just because you want it?”

“Stop it!” To everyone’s surprise, Tang Muxin stood in front of Lin Chuyin and angrily shouted at the male lackey. “Dali has not said anything, stand down!” Her voice was filled with 30% anger, 30% panic, and 40% worry, causing everyone who heard it feel inexplicably weird.
