chapters.title: Chapter 84 - In My Name
paragraphs: “Yes, Young... Young Madam...” Tang Muxin had been with everyone for such a long time, she rarely showed such an expression. The male lackey was scared to the point of shivering and instantly backed down.
Tang Muxin then gave a sigh a relief, turned around, and asked, “Sister Blood Consort, you want that Virtual Reality Projection technology?”
Blood Consort Lin Chuyin nodded and, in her usual emotionless tone, said, “I have a use for it.”
“Ah, take it if you need it,” said Hong Dali.
The Hatsune Miku1! Everyone should know what he feels!
“Yes.” Lin Chuyin reached out her hand. “Where’s the equipment?”
“Give it to her!” Hong Dali chicly tossed his hair. “You can use it for as long as you like. I don’t know what I can do with this thing, anyway.”
Taking over the set of equipment, Lin Chuyin blandly said, “In my name, I will return it three days later.”

Saying so, she directly boarded a black super streamlined sports car without even a word of thanks. The roaring noise of the engine sounded, and the exhaust spat out sparks of fire, disappearing from their sight in the blink of an eye.

Phew...After Lin Chuyin left, Tang Muxin then let out a long breath. As if her whole body was exhausted, she wiped off her cold sweat and said, “Finally, she’s gone. That really frightened me just now.”
“I... I say, Xinxin!” Looking at the direction where Lin Chuyin disappeared, Hong Dali was stunned and asked, “That car of Chuyin’s, isn’t there something strange about it? It was spouting fire?”

Now, the rest of Hong Dali’s group all looked curiously at Tang Muxin. Li Nianwei, who was faintly blocking Hong Dali just now, said, “This Lin Chuyin, she’s not an ordinary person. She’s very dangerous, I can sense it.”

“She’s indeed not an ordinary person.” A low voice sounded off. Liu Mingxin gracefully walked up to them, looked at Hong Dali, smiled and said, “It was a very wise decision that your underling didn’t raise his hands at her just now.”

“Oh? What’s the reason, can you tell me?” Hong Dali didn’t have any regards and asked him directly. Since there was someone that knew the reason, he should just ask. There wasn’t any modesty from him at all.

“Chuyin is the sole daughter of Lin Jiayun, the Director of the World’s Five Hundred Strong Lin Corporation.” Liu Mingxin took in a deep breath and gradually said, “Actually, there’s nothing much in that. In our circle of network, this kind of person isn’t rare to be seen. The crucial point is that she’s a female geek. Yup, the type that stays at home every day and rarely leaves the house.”
Geek... female geek!?
Hong Dali was stunned.Lin Chuyin is a female geek? A female geek who skips her lessons every day?

“Yes. But this female geek is quite different from others.” Speaking to this point, the normally proud Liu Mingxin helplessly shook his head and said, “I also think that I’m not inferior to anyone else, but compared to her, I’m lacking indeed. Lin Chuyin is a member of the ‘Holy Grail’ organization. I’m not sure if you have heard of this organization before.”
Hong Dali decisively shook his head.

“Yup. Simply speaking, in this world, there exists such a group of people whose intelligence level far exceeds that of an ordinary person. This group of people are very mysterious—a normal person will never know who they really are, where they are. Only those at the level of top officials at the governments in this world will obtain information about this group of people. And with no exceptions, all of them will treat this information like treasure.

“In this world with a population of five billion people, those who can reach such a condition, there are only 42 of them. The organization that they’re in is called ‘Holy Grail’—an organization that only a person with an intelligence quotient of 180 and above has the qualification to join.
“And this Lin Chuyin, she’s a member of ‘Holy Grail.’ Furthermore, she’s the most dangerous type of person within the group.
“Female geek, a technological geek.

“A technological geek! A technological geek with an intelligence quotient of 180 and above!!” As Liu Mingxin spoke to this point, Hong Dali was really astonished. Ever since he arrived in this world, those he interacted with were all elites. It could be said that Hong Dali wouldn’t faze no matter what kind of scene he might face.
But now, upon hearing that Lin Chuyin was a technological geek, he was truly frightened.

Maybe a lot of people didn’t understand the concept of what a technological geek meant. Simply speaking, the main character of “Iron Man” from the Hollywood science-fiction movie in his previous life, Tony Stark, was such a technological geek.

No wonder she doesn’t attend class normally, no wonder she borrowed the Virtual Reality Projection technology from me. Could it be possible that this technological geek with an intelligence quotient of 180 or more might really create such an awesome exoskeleton armor like the one from Iron Man?
Now, Hong Dali finally understood why Lin Chuyin spoke in such a manner—a technological geek must have a -10 level in their communications skills level, wasn’t it!?
“Seeing your expression, you should understand how scary a technological geek can be.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said, “Then, that will make it much simpler.”

As he spoke up to this point, amongst those present, other than Hong Dali, Tang Muxin and Liu Mingxin, the rest was unclear of what they meant. Finally, Li Nianwei couldn’t bear it and curiously asked, “En, can you give an example?”

“Let me explain, Sister Nianwei.” Tang Muxin walked to her side and slowly said, “My relationship with Sister Blood Consort can be considered not bad. That day, I went to her house for a visit and was fortunate enough to witness something.”
Everyone was thinking: What thing is so mysterious? Something very awesome?
They then heard Tang Muxin say, “Coincidently, those days she was building a rocket on her own, so she released it for me to see when I went there.”
“Rocket?” Li Nianwei asked the doubt in everyone’s mind. “Fireworks?”

“No, that was a real rocket with a rocket launcher.” Tang Muxin shrugged and said, “Sister Blood Consort installed a micro camera, then... then I watched as the rocket was launched. At that time, the signal connector device sent back a video of it flying up until it broke through the atmosphere.”
As she spoke up to this point, everyone swallowed in their saliva.
Even the usually tranquil and calm Li Nianwei was astonished. After a while, she asked, “You mean to say that, the rocket that she made herself broke through the atmosphere and went into space?”
“Yes. I even kept the video from that time.” Tang Muxin took out her phone. “Sister Blood Consort made a copy of it for me.”
One minute later.
That male lackey perspired profusely and murmured non-stop. “Lucky... luckily I didn’t hit her...”

At this moment, Liu Mingxin didn’t forget to crack down on him. “Actually, there’s something more frightening about Lin Chuyin.” He pointed at his head and said, “God gave her a brain that far exceeds an ordinary person, but he also took away something from her in return—her emotions.

“Simply put, Lin Chuyin practically doesn’t have any emotion genes. Everything she does is out of survival instinct. She won’t be good towards someone, she also won’t be bad towards someone. When she feels danger, regardless of who it is, all those that threaten her safety will be her attack target. That includes even her parents.”

Everyone was thinking: What thing is so mysterious?
Something very awesome?
They then heard Tang Muxin say, “Coincidently, those days she was building a rocket on her own, so she released it for me to see when I went there.”
“Rocket?” Li Nianwei asked the doubt in everyone’s mind.
“Fireworks?”
“No, that was a real rocket with a rocket launcher.” Tang Muxin shrugged and said, “Sister Blood Consort installed a micro camera, then... then I watched as the rocket was launched.
At that time, the signal connector device sent back a video of it flying up until it broke through the atmosphere.”
As she spoke up to this point, everyone swallowed in their saliva.
Even the usually tranquil and calm Li Nianwei was astonished.
After a while, she asked, “You mean to say that, the rocket that she made herself broke through the atmosphere and went into space?”
“Yes.
I even kept the video from that time.” Tang Muxin took out her phone.
“Sister Blood Consort made a copy of it for me.”
One minute later.
That male lackey perspired profusely and murmured non-stop.
“Lucky... luckily I didn’t hit her...”
At this moment, Liu Mingxin didn’t forget to crack down on him.

“Actually, there’s something more frightening about Lin Chuyin.” He pointed at his head and said, “God gave her a brain that far exceeds an ordinary person, but he also took away something from her in return—her emotions.
“Simply put, Lin Chuyin practically doesn’t have any emotion genes.
Everything she does is out of survival instinct.
She won’t be good towards someone, she also won’t be bad towards someone.
When she feels danger, regardless of who it is, all those that threaten her safety will be her attack target.
That includes even her parents.”

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - Hurry up and Find a Wife
paragraphs: After hearing Liu Mingxin’s words, everyone sucked in a deep breath of cold air.
Now, they finally understood why Tang Muxin was so nervous just now. If someone offended that Lin Chuyin...

If the opponent were someone who knew a bit of kungfu, that would be easy to handle; at the most, they could rely on their strength in numbers to win. But facing Lin Chuyin, that technological geek, god knows if she might be wearing an exoskeleton armor inside her shirt, or if she had specially reformed that super cool sports car of hers...
Of course, being a superprodigal, Hong Dali concern wasn’t about that at all.

Now, his eyes were glowing with light so bright that it could cause blindness to those who looked at them. His saliva almost drooled out as he said, “Wow! Then, next time, if I want to squander, can’t I just find her? A technological geek! Technology is number one in burning money, no qualms about that!” When the Great Prodigal System eventually upgraded, the amount of money needed to be squandered would definitely increase! Even now, his mission already required him to squander 15 million yuan in a month. After the upgrade, wouldn’t it require at least tens of millions of money to complete a mission? By then, looking for Lin Chuyin to burn money in playing with technology would definitely be the best option!
“Er...” Liu Mingxin was stunned for a while, before he helplessly nodded and said, “That’s indeed the case.”

“Hahahaha! This is really great, haha!” Hong Dali laughed loudly. “This time, there is really something to play with. Speaking of which, I’m really curious what she will create with this Virtual Reality Projection system! Haha!”
Everyone face-palmed, thinking that the Young Master had found another good method to squander. This time, it was even fiercer. Technology was definitely the optimal choice for burning money!
After Hong Dali finished laughing, Liu Mingxin smiled and said towards him, “Young Master Dali, I wonder if I can have a few private words with you?”
Hearing him say that, everyone instantly got nervous. Tang Muxin unconsciously wanted to object when Hong Dali said, “Sure, where?”
“Just there will do.” Liu Mingxin casually pointed at a place about two meters away from their current location.
“Young Master!” Seeing that Hong Dali was about to leave their area of protection, his lackeys, Tang Muxin, and Li Nianwei all started panicking.
“It’s alright, it’s alright. I see that this guy is quite dependable.” Hong Dali squeezed his eyes. “What’s more, there are so many people here. I will be fine.”

Currently, in the plaza in front of Mingjing Building, there were more than 100 plus guests present. Hong Dali was relaxed. If Liu Mingxin dared to lay his hands on him here, Hong Dali would cut down his own head and use it to play football.

As the two of them went to an empty space at the side, Liu Mingxin actually slightly bowed towards Hong Dali, causing Hong Dali asked with surprise, “Huh, what’s with you, don’t do this. Why are you bowing?”

Liu Mingxin smile and gently said, “In reality, I have to admit, I really planned to lay my hands on you yesterday. Therefore, this bow just now can be considered my apology towards you. I hope that Young Master Dali will not reject.”
Hong Dali pointed at Liu Mingxin, then pointed at himself. “You’re apologizing to me? I don’t think there is a need for that, right?”

“For you, maybe it isn’t necessary. But I feel that it was.” Liu Mingxin was still in that astonishing handsome manner of his. He smiled and said, “Actually, due to the stand of our families, it’s acceptable even if I strike out at you, no one will be able to say much to that. But after our interaction these two days, I feel that you’re quite an interesting person. If it weren’t because we’re on opposing sides, maybe you would be a very suitable friend. Yup, not maybe, it’s definitely.”
“Oh my, that’s not true. Actually, I’m not as great as you said!” Instead, Hong Dali was slightly embarrassed by his speech. He touched his hair and laughed out loud.

“Heh heh, in the future, there will definitely be a battle between our families. This is inevitable. And I believe that Young Master Dali knows of this too.” Liu Mingxin slowly said, “However, although we will definitely be enemies, I don’t dislike you. Therefore, I came here today to show my apologies for my rash behavior from before.”

“At the same time, I want to say that, from today onwards, I will not actively make a move at you again. Your nature is to be a happy prodigal, squandering as you wish, happily living on. Next time when our families battle, if we win, I will leave a retreat route for you, at least making sure that you can live a very carefree lifetime.” Speaking to this point, Liu Mingxin lightly said, “If in the end, your family won, I hope that Young Master Dali will let me preserve my last sense of dignity.”
Hearing what Liu Mingxin said, the always grinning Hong Dali was dazed.
He had never imagined that there would be a person with such breadth of mind and magnanimity.
But now, there was Liu Mingxin.

His confident, graceful, and elegant. It could be said that he possessed all of the good virtues that existed in the world. Actually, if it wasn’t because of their family’s standpoint, Hong Dali truly did not wish to be enemies with such a person. They were supposed to be two parallel lines, Liu Mingxin roaming at will in the business world while he continued to be his careful prodigal.
Unfortunately, this was how things usually were in life. Many a time, they couldn’t be changed by human strength.

Hong Dali sniffled, smiled and said, “No problem. Hehe, you know that I’m a prodigal—other than spending money, I’m not good at anything. Naturally, I know about the things going on between our families. Let us consider that when things come to that point, it gives me a headache to think too much. But let me reassure you. No matter what the ending is, at least the impression you gave me was pretty good.”
“That’s good enough.” Liu Mingxin nodded and said, “I hope that next time when we met, we can still sit down and have a cup of tea together.”
“Of course.” Hong Dali shrugged and said, “If you’re willing to squander with me, I’m happy to bring you with me.”

“Haha, OK!” Liu Mingxin laughed loudly and said, “Then let’s wait for a chance in the future. I will accompany you and let myself go wild for once. That feeling will definitely be quite interesting.” After finishing his words, Liu Mingxin turned around and waved goodbye. “Then, let’s meet again when the chance comes.”
“Bye!” Hong Dali vigorously shouted. “Hurry up and go find a wife, so that you can stop thinking of my Sister Nianwei!”
Upon hearing this, the always cool Liu Mingxin stumbled and almost fell down.
“Dali, what did he say to you, why the bowing and such?” Once Hong Dali returned, Tang Muxin rushed towards him and asked.
This little lady reached out her white, delicate small hand and grabbed his sleeve, her expression quite anxious.
Although she planned to withdraw from their marriage in the future, before she really did so, she was still quite protective of Hong Dali.

“Ah, nothing much actually, he just came here to apologize. He admitted that he really planned to make a move towards me yesterday.” Hong Dali cheerfully said, “Then, he said that he will not make any more moves toward me in the future and asked me to be at ease and squander around as I like. Speaking of which, although this old fellow is on the opposite standpoint as me, I really don’t dislike him. My impression of him is actually quite good.”
“You believed him just because he said so?” Tang Muxin exclaimed in surprise.

“It doesn’t matter if I believe him or not. I can’t be bothered to mind such things anyway. Playing around happily is what I should be concerned with.” Hong Dali shrugged and said, “Let’s go, it’s getting late. Let’s return home first.” From the current looks of things, there would definitely be a battle between them in the future, but... hopefully, that day would come much later in the future. After all, Hong Dali’s foundation had yet to stabilize.

Of course, there was not much use speaking of that now, it was more important to rush home. Now that he had accumulated 40 attribute points, turning the small stick large was the most important thing!

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - The Fantastical Jewelry Set
paragraphs: “OK... fine...” Since Hong Dali already said so, everyone instantly boarded their respective cars and went home. On the way home, Tang Muxin didn’t forget to remind Hong Dali. “Regardless of whether what he said was true or false, you have to be careful in the future. Even if he doesn’t make a move at you, those subsidiaries from your family weren’t friendly towards you as well. You have to be mindful of them, and you must pay special attention to this.”
“Yup, I know.” Comfortably lying on the backrest, Hong Dali stretched his waist. “Ah, I’m so tired.”

Just as he was in a daze and rested upon Li Nianwei’s body, Li Nianwei suddenly leaned close and softly spoke in his ear. “Young Master, there seems to be something wrong with this Dark Gold Earring. When I put it on, my mind seemed to become much clearer than usual, very cooling. I’m not sure if it’s because of the earrings, but my mind felt clearer only after I started wearing it.”
“Are you serious!?” Hong Dali’s spirit immediately lightened up. He looked at the earrings left and right. “Could it be that I really bought back a divine item?”

He only felt that it was fun, but Tang Muxin was carefully touching the earrings. She suddenly exclaimed in surprise. “Dali, these earrings, there really seems to be some problem in them. Do you still remember that Clear Water Ring that you gave to me the other day?”
“I remember. What about it?” Hong Dali asked in puzzlement.

“That Clear Water Ring has the effect of maintaining the smooth flow of the blood circulation in the body. It’s cooling in summer and warm in winter. This pair of earrings has the effect of keeping its wearer’s head clear.” Tang Muxin analyzed. “Clear Water, Dark Gold, their names seem to be quite similar in concept. With regards to the five elements, Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, could it be that these two are a set?”
What the heck, this was definitely a huge discovery!

Hong Dali said in surprise, “Will there be a set effect if worn together? What you meant is that there are five pieces to this set of jewelry? According to the five elements, Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth?”

“Your luck is really invincible.” Tang Muxin pouted and said, “Purposely squandering and earning yourself a divine item. I really think that’s the case. Now that Water and Metal are already in our possession, we’re still lacking Wood, Fire, and Earth. I wonder if it’s possible to collect all of them.”

“Young Master, such a valuable item...” After Li Nianwei heard that, she tried to take off her earrings, but was stopped by Hong Dali. He grinned and said, “Just wear it first, I have already said that it was for you. If I manage to collect the remaining three pieces, then you can give me yours to try the effect. There’s no need to rush now. If I keep it, I might accidentally throw it away at any moment.”
Li Nianwei had never rejected Hong Dali’s words before. She gave a slight smile, showing that she had accepted keeping the earrings.

Knowing about this, Hong Dali was quite happy. His eyes were beaming with light as he laughed loudly and said, “Haha, this is really awesome! Oh my, it was a favorite of mine to play this type of item collecting game. Just that I have no idea if they really are a set, will there be a set effect? Maybe it will suddenly turn me into Superman? I must look out for it in the future, hehe.”
Tang Muxin was still mumbling. “He can get a divine item from squandering, my perspective of the world, sigh...”
Today’s plan of squandering big time was a full success. Everyone was very satisfied.

After sending Tang Muxin and Li Nianwei home to rest, the three Prayer Angels opened the path while Hong Dali sat in the backseat of his own Soaring Angel, excited. “I have spent 4 million and more in these past few days, and the Great Prodigal System has also shown that I have accumulated 43 attribute points. Brouhaha, I shall immediately add them once I arrive back home. Damn it, this long wait is really killing me.”
Actually, previously Hong Dali had already accumulated a few attribute points, just that he didn’t use them.
After all, the sexual capability stats and health stats were different.
For the health stats, every point added would make his body better.

But for sexual capability stats, it was different. This was related to the size of his penis. An average adult’s penis in the normal state was only slightly larger than a thumb—some more talented might have it slightly larger, but there was a limit to it. If he added two or three points at a time, it would be quite hard to tell if there was any difference. Therefore, Hong Dali held them until his attribute points accumulated to a large sum. Now, if all 40 plus points were used together, the difference would be quite obvious.
They reached home shortly after. Hong Dali directly charged towards his bedroom. “Mum, I’m back! I’m going up first!”

“Oh dear, you little rascal, slower, slower! Don’t fall!” Seeing Hong Dali bustling around, Lan Ruoxi’s heart almost jumped out. “It’s not like I’m forcing you to go and study, why are you rushing off so fast? Hold the banister when you’re going up the stairs, aren’t you afraid of misstepping?”
“I know that Mum, hehe.” Hong Dali laughing touched his nose and decisively slowed down his pace.
It wouldn’t be good if he concerned his family again.
Very quickly, he reached his bedroom. Hong Dali threw down his bag, took off his jacket, and started taking in deep breaths...

After doing that for an entire ten times, he finally calmed down. Then... he felt nervous! He carefully locked the door, drew the curtains, then tossed around in bed, worrying about the effectiveness of the stats. In the end, he went online for an hour or so before he finally calmed down and was prepared to start adding the attribute points.

Actually, it wasn’t Hong Dali’s fault for worrying. What the sexual capability stats meant exactly was uncertain. Hong Dali was actually quite clueless about it. Thinking positively, it could cause his penis to grow larger. This was what the System admitted, meaning that it would become the same as an average man’s.

But! Only the ghost would know what was considered to be the size of an average person’s penis in the eyes of the system? After all, this wasn’t Earth’s technology. If it considered the erected size of an average penis to be five to six centimeters or seven to eight centimeters...
Then, Hong Dali would definitely go knock himself against the wall.
This was the real reason as to why he was so hesitant in adding the attribute points. The uncertainty of this thing was too significant, and anyone in his shoes would worry as well.
But whatever reasons there might be, he had already hesitated long enough. Now that the attribute points were available, in the end, he still had to add it.

“It’s all or nothing! If I don’t succeed, then I shall die trying!” Making up his mind, Hong Dali sniffled fiercely and took off all of his clothing very quickly. Then, with an expression that was too horrible to look at, he looked at the small stick that caused him so many worries.
It was bald down there, and at the center was just a small white stick the size of half his pinky. With it were two eggs the size of his thumb, growing there by themselves.
He would let it pass if it were just a little stick, but just the foreskin was 1.5-centimeters long when the whole thing was only 3-centimeters long!
Looking at this small thing that was so small that it looked cute, Hong Dali really had the temptation to draw on it. Then, it would look just like the head of an elephant...

Whoosh...Deeply taking in a deep breath, since no matter how bad the results would be, it definitely would be better than this! Hong Dali fiercely decided. “Add all of the attribute points to my sexual capability!”

Hold the banister when you’re going up the stairs, aren’t you afraid of misstepping?”
“I know that Mum, hehe.” Hong Dali laughing touched his nose and decisively slowed down his pace.
It wouldn’t be good if he concerned his family again.
Very quickly, he reached his bedroom.
Hong Dali threw down his bag, took off his jacket, and started taking in deep breaths...
After doing that for an entire ten times, he finally calmed down.
Then... he felt nervous!
He carefully locked the door, drew the curtains, then tossed around in bed, worrying about the effectiveness of the stats.
In the end, he went online for an hour or so before he finally calmed down and was prepared to start adding the attribute points.
Actually, it wasn’t Hong Dali’s fault for worrying.
What the sexual capability stats meant exactly was uncertain.
Hong Dali was actually quite clueless about it.
Thinking positively, it could cause his penis to grow larger.
This was what the System admitted, meaning that it would become the same as an average man’s.
But!
Only the ghost would know what was considered to be the size of an average person’s penis in the eyes of the system?
After all, this wasn’t Earth’s technology.
If it considered the erected size of an average penis to be five to six centimeters or seven to eight centimeters...
Then, Hong Dali would definitely go knock himself against the wall.
This was the real reason as to why he was so hesitant in adding the attribute points.
The uncertainty of this thing was too significant, and anyone in his shoes would worry as well.
But whatever reasons there might be, he had already hesitated long enough.
Now that the attribute points were available, in the end, he still had to add it.
“It’s all or nothing!
If I don’t succeed, then I shall die trying!” Making up his mind, Hong Dali sniffled fiercely and took off all of his clothing very quickly.
Then, with an expression that was too horrible to look at, he looked at the small stick that caused him so many worries.
It was bald down there, and at the center was just a small white stick the size of half his pinky.
With it were two eggs the size of his thumb, growing there by themselves.
He would let it pass if it were just a little stick, but just the foreskin was 1.5-centimeters long when the whole thing was only 3-centimeters long!
Looking at this small thing that was so small that it looked cute, Hong Dali really had the temptation to draw on it.
Then, it would look just like the head of an elephant...
Whoosh...Deeply taking in a deep breath, since no matter how bad the results would be, it definitely would be better than this!
Hong Dali fiercely decided.
“Add all of the attribute points to my sexual capability!”

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - Dali Is a Real Man!
paragraphs: Following his words, his whole body was immediately covered in a golden light.

At first, the light covered his entire body. Then, it gradually shrank and moved. First, it moved from the head and toe to the chest level, and then the thigh level. Then, it gathered at the area three inches below his underbelly.
Hong Dali eyes opened wide, glaring intently at it.

His whole body was covered with cold sweat, and he felt cold. At such a critical moment like this, there couldn’t possibly be anyone who could be entirely unconcerned—his whole lifetime’s happiness depended on this moment!
Under Hong Dali’s eyes which were filled with nervousness and anticipation, it finally started to change.
Firstly, it expanded horizontally, little by little. Although it was very slow, it was still an obvious growth. First, it expanded at about 0.5 cm, then 1 cm, then 1.5 cm, then 2.5 cm...

Just like that, little by little, like the process of a seed growing, after the width reached 2.5 cm, the length started to grow too. First, the penis started to crawl forward under the foreskin, and he could obviously feel the bulging at the front crawling forward. This time, the growth was much faster. 1 cm, 2 cm, in just a few breaths’ time, that circular bulging crawled all the way to the front. Then, a small... probed its head out.
Hong Dali looked on in astonishment. Speaking of which, his little brother looked quite cute, white and delicate...

By this time, it was already quite obvious its growth, reaching the size of half of his index finger. Then, just as Hong Dali’s heart reached his throat, the golden light glowed even more strongly. It was still glowing!
Hong Dali was dazed. In his heart, he was continuously shouting, “Put in some effort! Put in more effort! Come on! Come on!”
Hong Dali was certain that, at this moment, he had never felt more urgency to work harder now as compared to his whole lifetime.

After all, from half a pink to half an index finger, and clearly it was going to reach to half a middle finger. Seeing such a scene, anyone in his place would definitely not be able to maintain a calm mind—if someone was able to keep a calm mind at such a moment, he was definitely not someone capable of an erection!

It was still growing. Indeed, just moments later, it had already reached the size of half a middle finger—an average man’s normal size was just about his size now, and it was still growing. Furthermore, Hong Dali’s stats were only at 80 points now.
Even when Hong Dali was already very satisfied, it was still growing!
What the heck! What situation is this!?
Hong Dali’s heart almost jumped out. That golden light hadn’t disappeared, it was still growing!

From half a middle finger’s size, it continued growing thicker. The cute little brother had seemingly turned into a small bird that was trying to break out of its shell. It was doing its utmost to struggle as much as it could. After two minutes or so, Hong Dali finally felt as if something had broken free. His white and delicate little brother had entirely broken out from its restraint, its head entirely probing out, being able to wholly face the outside world now.
“Oh... oh...” Hong Dali was at a loss of words to describe his feelings. His whole expression was unable to describe with words—because it was still growing! It was already the size of his thumb!
By now, Hong Dali felt fully at ease. An average man’s normal size was about his size now, maybe slightly larger but limited. The most important thing was that it was still growing!

From the size of a thumb, it started to grow in width again. 1 cm, 2 cm, moments later, the diameter was about that of one and a half thumb’s. Then, it grew in length again, this time slightly slower. But that was only relatively speaking. Very quickly, it had grown to the size of one and a half thumb’s.
“Brouhaha! Finally, finally, I’m a true man now!” Hong Dali laughed loudly.
Now, the sexual capability stat was at 80 points. Once it reached 100, he would become a truly “standing” man! A real man of blood and metal, Dali was a real man now!
Then, just at this moment, the golden light still hadn’t disappeared!
It was still growing!

What the heck! What situation is this! He was first crazily excited, then he felt cold sweat from head to toe—Big Brother, please stop growing. If you continue to grow, how am I supposed to face other people then!
But it was very obvious that his prayer this time didn’t work, it was still growing!

From the size of one and a half thumb, it gradually grew larger and thicker. Hong Dali’s tears rained down his face. “Oh my Heavens and Earth, which celestial sister is playing such a big joke on me...”

After an entire three minutes, under Hong Dali’s glare which was so intense that it almost looked through the walls, it finally stopped growing! It’s size now was two thumbs in both width and length. The original white and delicate little head was now extremely ferocious. He believed that any women who saw it would definitely turn pale.
Then, totally fall in love with Hong Dali...

“Whoosh, it finally stopped growing. I almost died from fright just now, this was really scaring one to one’s death!” Hong Dali let out a long, cold breath. This thing had finally stopped growing. With his current insight, it was now practically one size larger than an average man’s, and this was only when it was at 80 points!

“I have finally understood!” Hong Dali gave a blissful sigh. The average man’s stat that the System was talking about definitely refers to the black men in Africa in terms of capability! Furthermore, it definitely refers to those especially well developed!

It wasn’t a wonder for Hong Dali to say so. He knew from his previous life that those black men do indeed tend to be larger—especially when compared to the men from a certain country. This was still nothing much, there were some unique tribal clans whose black men had it even larger.
From the current look of things, his capability index definitely refers to that level.

Then, just at this moment, the golden light wasn’t finished yet. Hong Dali’s jaw almost dropped out in fright. Then, under his frightened gaze, his hair seemed to sprout after a rain, furiously growing out from under the ground!
Five minutes later.
Hong Dali stood on his bed and roared towards the sky, “My hair, it’s finally fully grown AHHHHHH!”

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - This Isnt Enough!
paragraphs: “Dali, what’s wrong!?” Just as he finished shouting, before he even had the time to put on his clothes, his mother Lan Ruoxi violently kicked open the door to his bedroom. Once she entered, she immediately asked anxiously, “Are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere...”

“AH!” Hong Dali unconsciously turned his body around and ended up making contact with Lan Ruoxi’s caring eyes. He instantly felt his entire body going cold, then violently covered his little stick. “Mum, it’s, it’s nothing...”
“Don’t move!” Lan Ruoxi eyes lit up, stepped forward, and slapped his hands away. “Quickly, let Mum see!”
Five seconds later, Lan Ruoxi teared up. “My house’s little prodigal has finally become a grown man. Good, very good!”

“Mum you, can you let me put on my clothes first...” Hong Dali put on a bitter face. “Even if I don’t put on the shirt, at least let me put on my pants... it’s quite embarrassing to be looked at by you like this...”
“You little rascal!” Lan Ruoxi’s face laughed until it looked like a flower. “I’m your own mother, which children are afraid to be looked at by their mother?”

Saying so, Lan Ruoxi violently rubbed her eyes. “Ah, my house’s little prodigal has become a grown up now. I have to quickly search for a lady for you and get ready to carry my grandchild. En, I will not accept it if that lass Tang Muxin wants to renege on the wedding now! She’s very good looking, my house’s little prodigal isn’t bad looking either. Next time, when she bears a child, the child will definitely be very pretty!”

One wasn’t enough for her, Lan Ruoxi continued mumbling, “That Lady Lan Ruoxi is not bad too. I have done my research. Her background is clear, and her virtues are good too. She also treats my house’s little prodigal very well, and she’s quite gentle. We shall take her in too, she will definitely be protective of you in the future! Being able to cook and also suitable to bring out to meet outsiders, she will be a good daughter-in-law. Now, her net worth is also just able to be comparable to you too!”
Hong Dali: “...”This was definitely my own biological mother, wasn’t it!

Lan Ruoxi still wasn’t satisfied. “Two isn’t enough, our family is still too small. Next time, I shall look out for a few more for you! Ah, carrying a grandchild, no wonder I kept having dreams about Dragons and Phoenixes nowadays. At first, I wondered what it was about, but now, it looks like it was our house’s little prodigal asking me to get ready to carry my grandchildren! Yup, if it’s a boy, he shall be named Hong Juli. If it’s a girl, girl...” Saying so, Lan Ruoxi looked at Hong Dali. “Dali, what do you think we should name the child if it’s a girl?”
Hong Dali: “...”

Lan Ruoxi continued to talk to herself in excitement. “Yup, you’re still studying now. It is unlikely for the school to allow you to be married now... but fear not, if that old principle dares to show any signs of objection, I will break his legs! Dali, rest assured, Mum will pave the path for you! You just need to find a few more ladies for me and bear some more children! By that time, I shall carry one in each of my arms, and your Dad will carry two on his back, only then can it be considered our family population being prosperous!”
Saying so, Lan Ruoxi smiled as if she were a demon from the abyss. “Dali, work hard!”
“...”What am I supposed to work hard for, my god, I am only 18 this year, OK!? Hong Dali hurriedly said, “Mum, I haven’t put on my pants yet...”

“Oh my, what’s my house’s little prodigal blushing for?” Lan Ruoxi laughed loudly. She hummed to herself as she walked out. “Oh dear, I’m really happy today. Dear, Dear! Come here quick, good news, there’s good news for you!”

Hong Weiguo’s head probed out from the study room. “What’s the good news that caused you to be in such a fuss. I haven’t finished writing the prospectus for my project yet. This is a project worth several hundreds of millions, I can’t joke about this.”

“Even if it is worth billions, you must still come up here right now!” Lan Ruoxi stood with her arms akimbo, with the air of an old Empress. “If you don’t get here within one minute, I will tear your prospectus into pieces!”
“OK, OK, OK, I’m coming now!” Hong Weiguo mumbled to himself as he went up the stairs. “What could be so urgent, you ain’t like this usually...”
One minute later.
Hong Weiguo’s eyes almost popped out from its sockets. “Are you serious? You said that Dali has really become an adult? His illness has recovered!?”

“Would I lie to you on this matter!?” Lan Ruoxi’s mood was excellent. While drinking tea, she was also humming to herself. “Oh my, this time, we can finally have a grandchild to hug. I have longed for it every day and night. Dear, if it’s a boy, do you think it’s fine to name him Hong Juli? I think this name is not bad. Dali, Juli1, they’re quite a match.”

“No, no.” Hong Weiguo excitedly walked around in circles. “Hong Juli, this name seems to be snatching the limelight from Dali, this won’t do. Those who don’t know will think that Juli is Dali’s father, that definitely won’t do.”

He thought for half a day and suddenly stopped. He touched his chin and said, “The son of our Dali, he definitely has to be more domineering. Weren’t you dreaming about Dragons and Phoenixes these past two days, then let’s name him Hong Dalong2! This name is domineering and mighty!”
Lan Ruoxi’s eyes immediately lit up. “That’s a good name. What if he has two children?”
“Hong Erlong3!” Hong Weiguo didn’t even pause to think. “If there’s a third one, then he is Hong Sanlong4!”

Lan Ruoxi laughed until she bent over. “You old rogue. Yup, in my opinion, the youngest grandchild shall be named Hong Dachui! This filmUnexpectedly! that our child firmed was quite interesting. The youngest grandchild shall be named Hong Dachui, and his nickname Chuichui, not bad! If it’s a granddaughter, the first one will be named Hong Dafeng! The second Hong Erfeng! As for the youngest... what shall we name the youngest?”
Hong Weiguo excitedly said, “The youngest granddaughter shall be named Hong Xiaofeng5!”

“OK, I shall listen to you!” Lan Ruoxi excitedly said, “Wait, Dear, quickly think and see if there’s any girl who’s comparable with our Dali. She must be pretty. If she’s not pretty, then don’t consider her! Our Dali is so outstanding and so handsome, we can’t let him feel any grievance.” She was indeed Hong Dali’s biological mother, a person who was a prodigal in the mouth of others was “outstanding” coming from her mouth.

“Wait, let me think!” Hong Weiguo started walking in circles again. “That lass from the Wang Family, her age is about the same as Dali, but her looks can’t make it. Rejected! Yup, the one from the Liu Family, she’s only seven now; slightly young. Next time, I shall mention it to him and wait out a few years again, then see. The one from the Meng Family—no, no, her temper is too short, and she likes to hit others. Our Dali can’t be made to stand family violence. The one from the Hu Family? How old is that lass again?”
Lan Ruoxi: “16?”

“16, the age is fine.” Hong Weiguo touched his chin. “But I haven’t seen her for a few years. I’m not sure if she has grown pretty or ugly. I will get a picture of her from her father. As for that lass Muxin and Li Nianwei, I think both of them are not bad, let Dali take in both of them. Although Li Nianwei’s family background is slightly poor, she is pretty and has a good temper. If Dali has such a big sister to care for him, that would be quite good too. I don’t mind, anyway. A female three years older is worth a gold bar6. She’s in the fourth year in university now, that means she’s worth two gold bars, not bad.”

“OK, I also think that both of them are fine too.” Lan Ruoxi thought for a while and suddenly asked, “Oh right, what was the name of that lass from the Lin Family? Chuyin? I heard she’s quite pretty, why not her?”

Once she mentioned Lin Chuyin, Hong Weiguo decisively shook his head. “That lass is out of the question. She’s like a tiger, I fear that Dali will be at the losing end if he faces her. That lass doesn’t have any genes for emotion, she may fall-out with us at any moment. She hasn’t smiled once in her entire life. Old Lin is more worried about her now than I am. Let’s not consider her for now. Oh my, in the end, there’s still only the two of them. This isn’t enough at all!”
Lan Ruoxi laughed till she bent over and said, “OK, OK, we’re just seeking some happiness. If Dali really took in so many ladies, wouldn’t that be **7?”

Hong Weiguo squatted down and smoked, laughing at the same time. “That’s true. Alright then. I shall give all the maids a red packet today, 10,000 yuan each, to add to the happy atmosphere! Oh my, I have waited for this day for 18 years. Now, it has finally arrived, that wasn’t easy at all...” As he spoke, he suddenly said, “Why is this smoke so choking, heh heh...”

Yup, in my opinion, the youngest grandchild shall be named Hong Dachui!
This filmUnexpectedly! that our child firmed was quite interesting.
The youngest grandchild shall be named Hong Dachui, and his nickname Chuichui, not bad!
If it’s a granddaughter, the first one will be named Hong Dafeng!
The second Hong Erfeng!
As for the youngest... what shall we name the youngest?”
Hong Weiguo excitedly said, “The youngest granddaughter shall be named Hong Xiaofeng5!”
“OK, I shall listen to you!” Lan Ruoxi excitedly said, “Wait, Dear, quickly think and see if there’s any girl who’s comparable with our Dali.
She must be pretty.
If she’s not pretty, then don’t consider her!

Our Dali is so outstanding and so handsome, we can’t let him feel any grievance.” She was indeed Hong Dali’s biological mother, a person who was a prodigal in the mouth of others was “outstanding” coming from her mouth.
“Wait, let me think!” Hong Weiguo started walking in circles again.
“That lass from the Wang Family, her age is about the same as Dali, but her looks can’t make it.
Rejected!
Yup, the one from the Liu Family, she’s only seven now; slightly young.
Next time, I shall mention it to him and wait out a few years again, then see.
The one from the Meng Family—no, no, her temper is too short, and she likes to hit others.
Our Dali can’t be made to stand family violence.
The one from the Hu Family?
How old is that lass again?”
Lan Ruoxi: “16?”

“But I haven’t seen her for a few years.
I’m not sure if she has grown pretty or ugly.
I will get a picture of her from her father.
As for that lass Muxin and Li Nianwei, I think both of them are not bad, let Dali take in both of them.
Although Li Nianwei’s family background is slightly poor, she is pretty and has a good temper.
If Dali has such a big sister to care for him, that would be quite good too.
I don’t mind, anyway.
A female three years older is worth a gold bar6.
She’s in the fourth year in university now, that means she’s worth two gold bars, not bad.”

Chuyin?
I heard she’s quite pretty, why not her?”
Once she mentioned Lin Chuyin, Hong Weiguo decisively shook his head.
“That lass is out of the question.
She’s like a tiger, I fear that Dali will be at the losing end if he faces her.
That lass doesn’t have any genes for emotion, she may fall-out with us at any moment.
She hasn’t smiled once in her entire life.
Old Lin is more worried about her now than I am.
Let’s not consider her for now.
Oh my, in the end, there’s still only the two of them.
This isn’t enough at all!”
Lan Ruoxi laughed till she bent over and said, “OK, OK, we’re just seeking some happiness.
If Dali really took in so many ladies, wouldn’t that be **7?”
Hong Weiguo squatted down and smoked, laughing at the same time.
“That’s true.
Alright then.
I shall give all the maids a red packet today, 10,000 yuan each, to add to the happy atmosphere!
Oh my, I have waited for this day for 18 years.
Now, it has finally arrived, that wasn’t easy at all...” As he spoke, he suddenly said, “Why is this smoke so choking, heh heh...”

paragraphs: Inside the classroom of the second year, class nine.

The bored Hong Dali was lying on his desk, playing with his mobile phone. “Ah... it’s so boring. I have read all the novels, and these guys are writing too slowly...” Even though he said it like that, but Hong Dali also knew that writing novels was a relatively slow process. If it were written too fast, it would be substandard. In the novel industry, if the author were to write in large quantities, the quality might not be up to par. And if the novel were of good quality, it would take a longer time before a new chapter came out. Thus, in this industry, the author had to choose between quality or quantity.

“Forget it, I will just find something else to read...” Hong Dali dully browsed through the website. After looking for a while, his eyes suddenly lit up. “Eh? The title of this book looks interesting, let’s take a look at it.” Ten minutes later, Hong Dali was smiling happily. “Although it’s worse than the previous few books, it’s good to pass the time. Catch the reward!” He immediately bought a supreme leader rank for this novel.
After a while... “This book is not bad too. Reward!”
Half an hour later... “Haha, it’s rare to find a few books that are interesting enough. Reward!”
In the class chat group.
Ling Yi: “Looking at the expression of Big Bro Dali, he must have found a good book again.”
Du Xinzhen: “After a little calculation with my fingers by this young master, I know that there must have been new good books out recently. Brothers, let’s do it!”
Ji Zhiruo: “Young Master Dali has started it again, Keke.”
Lang Hao: “A bunch of useless prodigals.”
Ling Yi: “I will beat you if you dare say it again!”
Du Xinzhen: “This young master here will go and hook your wife up!”
Lang Hao: “Please, no! I will stop!”
An hour later.
The readers in the Zhong Dian website started to break out in excitement. Inside the big chat groups of various readers—

Reader One: “Quick! Come and take a look! The few God-level nouveau riches are taking action again! This time, they’re not only spamming donations for the original few books, but they’re also spamming donations for others too!”
Reader Two: “Oh my god, are you kidding me? Brothers, let’s move fast and go watch the commotion!”
Reader Three: “The books that these God-level nouveau riches like fits my appetite too. Let me take a look!”
Reader Four: “Every time these God-level nouveau riches take action, it’s definitely a huge spectacle. Wait for me!”
Two hours later.
Readers from other book stations started to become restless—
Another website Reader One: “The few God-level nouveau riches from the Zhong Dian website have started taking action again. Let’s go and enjoy the spectacle!”
Another website Reader Two: “I have read the previous few books they found, and it was very enjoyable. Faster, let’s go! We will definitely be able to find good books again this time!”
Another website Reader Three: “Everybody, let’s catch up faster. And remember to maintain the formation! I will go and register to be a sockpuppet first.”

Another website Reader Four: “You have yet to register to be a sockpuppet? I have read novels from there for a few days already. The books there are not bad, and I have even donated to some of them. Of course, these donations are not as much as what those God-level nouveau riches give.”
Three hours later.
Authors from various famous book stations—
Author One: “What the heck, those nouveau riches from the Zhong Dian website are making a move again! Dammit, I must go and see which book is it!”

Author Two: “Hahahaha, the account I opened there has been browsed by the God-level nouveau riches! Six purchases of supreme leader rank in one go! Oh my god, one supreme leader rank is equivalent to 500 dollars! I have really made it big this time!”
Author Three: “Let me take a look! It really is true! No way, I must set up an account there too. This is simply intolerable!”
Zhong Dian website, General Manager’s office.
The secretary stood in front of Director Yang’s desk and reported: “Director Yang, Young Master Dali and his friends have started purchasing supreme leader ranks again. Do you think...”
Without even thinking, Director Yang said, “Is there even a need to ask? Fast, go and find the one who knows how to spend money and ask him to hire public writers to follow up!”
Within a short time, in the critique section of various books—
Public Writer One: “Brothers, let’s do it!”
Public Writer Two: “Roger!”
Five hours later...
Secretary: “Director Yang, the site traffic for our website, has... has...”
Director Yang: “How much is it now?”

Secretary: “The IP website traffic has broken past the 300.000 barrier, and it’s continuing to rise. The number of authors coming to our website to post new books has risen by at least 70%. In these three days, the number of new books posted has amounted up to... more than a thousand books.”
Director Yang: “This has really broadened my horizons... Go and ask the one who knows how to spend money for the next step. In terms of spending money, he’s better at it than me.”
Business Service Director’s office.
Secretary: “The one who knows how to spend money... Ah no. I mean, Director Sun, the general manager wants to ask you, what should we do next?”
The one who knew how to spend money, Director Zhang Wenyang: “What is the ‘Saved To Bookshelf’ count for the books that Young Master is viewing right now?”

Secretary: “Chief Editor Tang is currently responsible for overseeing the actions of Young Master and his friends. The current reputation for the books are good, and the ‘Saved To Bookshelf’ count has exceeded 30.000. The number of Likes given is currently close to 50.000.”
Zhang Wenyang: “En, the number of the ‘Share’ icon pressed is not bad too, right?”
Secretary: “Currently, the reputation of the books are spreading. Every day, there’s more than a thousand ‘Saved To Bookshelf’ counts, and the number of Patreons is increasing at a very fast pace.”

“Hu...” Zhang Wenyang sucked in a deep breath. “Let’s roll out the advertisements that we have previously planned. Remember, I want to see advertisements everywhere. Contact as many advertisers as you can and spend at least three million on it!”
“Under... Understood...” The secretary sucked in a breath as he walked out of the room...
Inside the classroom of the second year, class nine.

After the class bell just rang, Hong Dali had a good, long stretch. “Ah, it’s so good to sleep. Such good books are hard to find, aii, but at least I managed to find a few. It should be sufficient enough. Time to go to the toilet to relieve myself and relax for a while!”

After standing up and going out of the classroom, Hong Dali met Liu Mingcheng, who was also in the second grade. Liu Mingcheng raised his hands when he saw Hong Dali, laughed, and said, “Hey, isn’t this Hong Dali. Where are you going?”
His buddies around him also laughed, watching Hong Dali with gloating eyes.
Hong Dali’s nose twitched. “I’m going to the toilet. Such an obvious answer, yet you still need to ask. I severely question your IQ level.”

“Going to the toilet, hahaha!” Liu Mingcheng raised both of his arms up and laughed, causing the scene to look quite funny. “The previous times Young Master Dali went to the toilet, you would have asked your lackeys to clear the way for you. Yet, you are going in alone today? To be honest, I’m really curious, have you finished undergoing puberty?”
Hong Dali asked Liu Mingcheng expressionlessly, “You changed your car?”

“Hey! Hey!” Liu Mingcheng waved his hands vigorously before raising them up. “I didn’t touch you, everyone can help to testify, I didn’t touch you. My hands are even held up!” After saying that, he smiled and said, “Hehe, little tricks. This time, there is no way you can do anything about it, right? Even if you fall, it has nothing to do with me!”
This caused the students surrounding them to burst out in laughter.

Hong Dali did not care and shrugged his shoulders. “Who said I wanted to fall? I’m just curious about what kind of car you have changed to this time.” After saying that, Hong Dali looked at the toilet sign before looking at Liu Mingcheng. “Just say it, do you really want to go to the toilet or just have nothing better to do after eating and came to disgust me? If you want to disgust me, I think your skill is not good enough.”

“Of course, I want to go to the toilet,” Liu Mingcheng laughed cheekily. “Of course, I’m curious too. If the reason why fellow schoolmate Dali calls his lackeys to clear the toilet is that he has not grown his pubic hair. Aiya, for a man, anything else is alright, except that his penis can never be small!”
“Oh,” Hong Dali went straight into the toilet without caring about Liu Mingcheng. “Your hobby is certainly very stupid.”
Liu Mingcheng gave the people around him a glance, with the meaning incomparably clear: Follow in and check how big Young Master Dali’s little brother is!

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - Big Bro Dali’s New Nickname
paragraphs: The group of people entered the bathroom in a mighty fashion, which immediately attracted the attention of the students around them, as they did not know what they were doing. However, with Hong Dali’s mighty background, they were not worried that he would be beaten in the bathroom—having a war with words occasionally was fine; however, whoever dared to touch Hong Dali was the same as trying to seek death. Not even Tianwang Laozi could save that person...

After entering the bathroom, Hong Dali’s face twitched slightly, before sliding his zipper open. Liu Mingcheng deliberately leaned towards him, facing the urinary pod, and sneered in his heart.Aiya, this kid looks so thin, his little stick is definitely not big. I have called my lackeys to prepare the camera. Wait till he takes out his little stick before taking a picture! Wahahahaha! When the picture spreads, the effect will absolutely be excellent!
While he was thinking about it, he took out his own bird which was around the size of a thumb, before waiting for Hong Dali to take out his.
Hong Dali did not even bother glancing at him. He slowly took off his pants, before showing off his arrogant giant bird!

After a short glance at it, Liu Mingcheng was completely frightened till he peed uncontrollably—yes, uncontrollably. The urine in his bladder could not be controlled no matter what and came gushing out. At this moment, Liu Mingcheng’s few lackeys started to take pictures madly.
Liu Mingcheng’s body was filled with cold sweat and decisively turned around, blocking his small little bird from being seen.
However, all this was for naught as it was too late.

Hong Dali had a quick and refreshing pee while humming a song. After casually peering over at Liu Mingcheng’s small bird, he did not say anything but felt a wave of excitement and pride before slowly zipping up his pants and exhaling a breath of refreshment.
It’s ok, it’s ok, this brat did not have any reaction! Liu Mingcheng felt as if he had paid a visit to death’s door, feeling eerily cool all over.

However, it was a pity that he got happy too early—when Hong Dali went out of the toilet, he suddenly smiled awkwardly. “Keke...” Then he walked and mumbled, with his voice not being too big nor too small, but just enough for Liu Mingcheng to hear. “Ai, for a man, anything can be small, just that thing, definitely can’t be small...”
Liu Mingcheng’s face was full of shame, and he couldn’t wait to knock himself to death immediately. This time, he had seriously lost all his face and prestige...
“Ahhhhh!!”
Just a while later, the whole toilet was filled with Liu Mingcheng’s heartrending cries.

The students nearby all looked at each other and were unclear as to what had just happened. If a curious person were present, they would ask: “Hey, do you know what happened? How did Liu Mingcheng’s utter such a heartrending cry?” At this time, a sneaky male student walked out of the bathroom and whispered, “You may not have seen the scene just now, but the great Young Master is a big man!”
“What happened? What happened? Quickly tell us!”
“Yeah, yeah, what in the world happened inside? Liu Mingcheng got beaten?”
“Can you talk faster and clearer, why do you speak so slowly?”

Seeing that he got everyone’s attention, he then explained softly. “When I was in there previously, I heard Liu Mingcheng proclaim that ‘For a man, anything can be small, just that thing, definitely can’t be small.’ I was curious about what he was talking about and glanced over. Guess what did I see?”
“What is it?” The students surrounding had their eyes lit up brighter than lightbulbs, staring at him. “Faster, say it!”

“At that moment, I saw it!” The student that just came out of the washroom said, “Young Master Dali’s plaything, it’s definitely a giant one. I have never seen anyone as big as his since I was born. Though Liu Mingcheng’s plaything can be considered not small; however, if one were to compare it with Young Master Dali’s, it would be just like a tiny little bird!”
“What the fuck! Is it really true? So scary?!” The students nearby exclaimed.

“It definitely can’t be truer than this.” The student that just came out of the washroom continued, “Do you still remember that Young Master Dali always calls his lackeys to clear the toilet before he uses it? In the past, we always thought that it was because it is too small to be shown. But proven just now, the reason is that it’s so big that it scares people!”
“Yes, yes, looks like we have all been wrong initially. Young Master Dali was scared that it would affect our self-confidence, and thus, did it because he wanted the better for us.”
“Haish, it’s my fault that I mistook him in the past. Aiii, for a man to see such a scene, it does indeed hurt one’s pride.”
“This time, Liu Mingcheng must really feel miserable. After seeing such a scene... Aiii, let’s hope he does not dwell too much on the difference in sizes.”

“Yeah,” said the classmates in the bathroom. “Liu Mingcheng has always been blowing his trumpet, saying that his thing is very big. Do you still remember the comic? The big evil BOSS called Dior Brando? Liu Mingcheng likes the villain and, on top of that, he has always said that his bird is relatively large, so he gave himself a nickname called ‘Bird, Not Lazy’ [1. The Chinese pronunciation of ‘not lazy’ sounds like the Chinese pronunciation of the English name ‘Brando’]. But this time, he really screwed up! Young Master Dali’s one, which is bigger than his bird by one whole big circle, is definitely his big brother. If it were me, Young Master Dali would have to change his nickname in the future, to become ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy.’
“Yes, yes, yes, let’s settle on ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy.’”
“This nickname is good, and is definitely suitable!”
“Big Bird, Not Lazy—what an inspiring nickname!”
The group of students laughed merrily together, their joy heard throughout the corridor.
The news spread like wildfire in school.

Soon, overwhelming rumors began to spread and became viral. As the greatest king of the year, Hong Dali’s nickname multiplied in just a few moments. “Big Bird Hong,” “Big Bird, Not Lazy,” “Big Brother Bird,” etc.
When people first met, the first words were mostly the same: “Have you heard about it? Big Bro Dali has a big bird, an absolutely big one!”
“I already knew that long ago. It was peculiar that Big Bro Dali had to have his lackeys clear the toilet before he went in. Now it seems that he was just hoping to take care of our self-esteem.”
“Why must it be ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy”? Aish, so embarrassing. But on the same note, is Big Bro Dali’s plaything really that big?”
“How can it be fake? According to those present at the scene, it’s absolutely gigantic when compared to Liu Mingcheng’s small bird. Such a nickname is certainly apt!”
“Aiya, so big. This... this will cause people to be awkward and embarrassed...”
“Little sister, have you fallen in love, want to give it a try?”
“N... no! Fur... furthermore, Young Master Dali would never find me good enough...”

While Liu Mingcheng walked in the campus with a blue face, students nearby would point out and say: “Look, ‘Small Bird, Not Lazy’ is there. Aiya, so pitiful. The blow he received this time is much heavier than the previous one where he got his car smashed. Aii...”
“Quickly, let’s leave. ‘Small Bird, Not Lazy’ is on his way here, let’s leave in case he becomes mad at us.”
“Yeah, yeah, whoever that receives such a mental blow, would definitely not feel good, aii, so pitiful.”

“W... Why?!” Liu Mingcheng was about to collapse. “How can his plaything be so big! This is impossible, it is impossible! He is so thin and tall; he is just slightly taller than 1.75m. How could that thing be so big? It’s not scientific! It’s not scientific! I must have seen wrongly! Ah, ah, ah!!!”

Hong Dali was sitting in his classroom reading a book since he had nothing much better to do, while students nearby would constantly discuss: “Big Bro Dali has become a legend. Big Bird Hong, aiya, how I hope I had one as big as his. Aiii...”
“Not only do you have this wish. A big bird, that’s certainly every man’s wish!”

Hong Dali: “What are these guys saying? Uncomprehendable. What ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy,’ who is that?” After that, he looked at the time and finally regained his enthusiasm. “Finally, school is about to end. I can then go and shootUnexpectedly! at night, haha!”

While he was thinking about it, he took out his own bird which was around the size of a thumb, before waiting for Hong Dali to take out his.
Hong Dali did not even bother glancing at him.
He slowly took off his pants, before showing off his arrogant giant bird!
After a short glance at it, Liu Mingcheng was completely frightened till he peed uncontrollably—yes, uncontrollably.
The urine in his bladder could not be controlled no matter what and came gushing out.
At this moment, Liu Mingcheng’s few lackeys started to take pictures madly.
Liu Mingcheng’s body was filled with cold sweat and decisively turned around, blocking his small little bird from being seen.
However, all this was for naught as it was too late.
Hong Dali had a quick and refreshing pee while humming a song.
After casually peering over at Liu Mingcheng’s small bird, he did not say anything but felt a wave of excitement and pride before slowly zipping up his pants and exhaling a breath of refreshment.
It’s ok, it’s ok, this brat did not have any reaction!
Liu Mingcheng felt as if he had paid a visit to death’s door, feeling eerily cool all over.
However, it was a pity that he got happy too early—when Hong Dali went out of the toilet, he suddenly smiled awkwardly.
“Keke...” Then he walked and mumbled, with his voice not being too big nor too small, but just enough for Liu Mingcheng to hear.
“Ai, for a man, anything can be small, just that thing, definitely can’t be small...”
Liu Mingcheng’s face was full of shame, and he couldn’t wait to knock himself to death immediately.
This time, he had seriously lost all his face and prestige...
“Ahhhhh!!”
Just a while later, the whole toilet was filled with Liu Mingcheng’s heartrending cries.
The students nearby all looked at each other and were unclear as to what had just happened.
If a curious person were present, they would ask: “Hey, do you know what happened?

How did Liu Mingcheng’s utter such a heartrending cry?” At this time, a sneaky male student walked out of the bathroom and whispered, “You may not have seen the scene just now, but the great Young Master is a big man!”
“What happened?
What happened?
Quickly tell us!”
“Yeah, yeah, what in the world happened inside?
Liu Mingcheng got beaten?”
“Can you talk faster and clearer, why do you speak so slowly?”
Seeing that he got everyone’s attention, he then explained softly.

“When I was in there previously, I heard Liu Mingcheng proclaim that ‘For a man, anything can be small, just that thing, definitely can’t be small.’ I was curious about what he was talking about and glanced over.
Guess what did I see?”
“What is it?” The students surrounding had their eyes lit up brighter than lightbulbs, staring at him.
“Faster, say it!”
“At that moment, I saw it!” The student that just came out of the washroom said, “Young Master Dali’s plaything, it’s definitely a giant one.
I have never seen anyone as big as his since I was born.
Though Liu Mingcheng’s plaything can be considered not small; however, if one were to compare it with Young Master Dali’s, it would be just like a tiny little bird!”
“What the fuck!
Is it really true?
So scary?!” The students nearby exclaimed.

“It definitely can’t be truer than this.” The student that just came out of the washroom continued, “Do you still remember that Young Master Dali always calls his lackeys to clear the toilet before he uses it?
In the past, we always thought that it was because it is too small to be shown.
But proven just now, the reason is that it’s so big that it scares people!”
“Yes, yes, looks like we have all been wrong initially.
Young Master Dali was scared that it would affect our self-confidence, and thus, did it because he wanted the better for us.”
“Haish, it’s my fault that I mistook him in the past.
Aiii, for a man to see such a scene, it does indeed hurt one’s pride.”
“This time, Liu Mingcheng must really feel miserable.
After seeing such a scene...
Aiii, let’s hope he does not dwell too much on the difference in sizes.”
“Yeah,” said the classmates in the bathroom.
“Liu Mingcheng has always been blowing his trumpet, saying that his thing is very big.
Do you still remember the comic?
The big evil BOSS called Dior Brando?
Liu Mingcheng likes the villain and, on top of that, he has always said that his bird is relatively large, so he gave himself a nickname called ‘Bird, Not Lazy’ [1.
The Chinese pronunciation of ‘not lazy’ sounds like the Chinese pronunciation of the English name ‘Brando’].
But this time, he really screwed up!
Young Master Dali’s one, which is bigger than his bird by one whole big circle, is definitely his big brother.
If it were me, Young Master Dali would have to change his nickname in the future, to become ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy.’
“Yes, yes, yes, let’s settle on ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy.’”
“This nickname is good, and is definitely suitable!”
“Big Bird, Not Lazy—what an inspiring nickname!”
The group of students laughed merrily together, their joy heard throughout the corridor.
The news spread like wildfire in school.
Soon, overwhelming rumors began to spread and became viral.
As the greatest king of the year, Hong Dali’s nickname multiplied in just a few moments.
“Big Bird Hong,” “Big Bird, Not Lazy,” “Big Brother Bird,” etc.
When people first met, the first words were mostly the same: “Have you heard about it?
Big Bro Dali has a big bird, an absolutely big one!”
“I already knew that long ago.
It was peculiar that Big Bro Dali had to have his lackeys clear the toilet before he went in.
Now it seems that he was just hoping to take care of our self-esteem.”
“Why must it be ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy”?
Aish, so embarrassing.
But on the same note, is Big Bro Dali’s plaything really that big?”
“How can it be fake?
According to those present at the scene, it’s absolutely gigantic when compared to Liu Mingcheng’s small bird.
Such a nickname is certainly apt!”
“Aiya, so big.
This... this will cause people to be awkward and embarrassed...”
“Little sister, have you fallen in love, want to give it a try?”
Fur... furthermore, Young Master Dali would never find me good enough...”
While Liu Mingcheng walked in the campus with a blue face, students nearby would point out and say: “Look, ‘Small Bird, Not Lazy’ is there.
Aiya, so pitiful.
The blow he received this time is much heavier than the previous one where he got his car smashed.
Aii...”
“Quickly, let’s leave.
‘Small Bird, Not Lazy’ is on his way here, let’s leave in case he becomes mad at us.”
“Yeah, yeah, whoever that receives such a mental blow, would definitely not feel good, aii, so pitiful.”
Why?!” Liu Mingcheng was about to collapse.
“How can his plaything be so big!
This is impossible, it is impossible!
He is so thin and tall; he is just slightly taller than 1.75m.
How could that thing be so big?
It’s not scientific!
It’s not scientific!
I must have seen wrongly!
Ah, ah, ah!!!”
Hong Dali was sitting in his classroom reading a book since he had nothing much better to do, while students nearby would constantly discuss: “Big Bro Dali has become a legend.
Big Bird Hong, aiya, how I hope I had one as big as his.
Aiii...”
“Not only do you have this wish.
A big bird, that’s certainly every man’s wish!”
Hong Dali: “What are these guys saying?
Uncomprehendable.
What ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy,’ who is that?” After that, he looked at the time and finally regained his enthusiasm.
“Finally, school is about to end.
I can then go and shootUnexpectedly! at night, haha!”

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - Thank You For Bestowing Kindness Upon Us, Young Master!
paragraphs: After a long wait, the lunch bell finally rang.

Hong Dali packed up neatly and was ready to go off. When he arrived at the door of the classroom, he saw a blushing Tang Muxin standing in the doorway. When she saw him coming out, she suddenly lowered her head and started to walk out of school first.
What in the world was happening?
Hong Dali hurriedly ran over and curiously asked, “Ai, Xinxin, why are you running away the moment you see me? I have not done anything shameful, have I?”
Tang Muxin couldn’t wait to throw the bag at his head. “You have become Big... Big Bird Hong, stay away from me! Don’t come over, got it?!” She softly spoke.
“Big Bird Hong?” With an innocent face, Hong Dali asked. “It’s alright to call me Hong Dali or Hong Dacui, but what’s with Big Bird Hong?”

“Well, isn’t... isn’t it because...” Tang Muxin’s face was beet red with embarrassment, and even her whole neck started to become red. “Isn’t it because you, who had nothing better to do after eating than to have a competition with Liu Mingcheng, competing whose thing was bigger?! Now the whole school is calling you ‘Big Bird, Not Lazy.’”

“What the f*ck, how can it be blamed on me?!” Hong Dali spat out a mouthful of water. “I just wanted to go to the toilet, and he wanted to follow me no matter what! I can’t just avoid going to the toilet because he wants to follow, right? One can hold in their feces but can’t hold in their pee. You have heard of this, no?”
“What... What do you mean by you can hold in this but not that!” Tang Muxin wanted to pinch Hong Dali to death. “Don’t come near me!”
“Okay, okay, I won’t get close!” Hong grumbled. “We still have to go to catch a movie together later...”
“We will talk when the time comes!” Tang Muxin walked away at a faster pace while huffing. “Get away from me!”
You’re really hard to serve! Hong Dali pouted. “Okay, I will stay away from you. Aiii, a woman’s heart is just like picking a needle from the seabed. So hard to understand!”

It was noisy all the way, but in the end, they still boarded the car. The three Prayer Angels opened the way, with the Soaring Angel following at the back all the way to the Chenhui Building before heading straight to the 9th floor Caiwei Entertainment Company.
“Greetings, Young Master!” At the sight of Hong Dali’s formidable lineup entering the company, Caiwei Entertainment’s employees stood up and greeted him.
“Greetings comrades, you have worked hard!” Hong Dali raised his right hand and waved to them like a Nazi leader, before decisively saying the following lines: “One thousand per person, tip them!”

Caiwei Entertainment’s employees immediately felt a sense of gratitude.It feels so blissful following the Young Master. We can eat whatever we want and receive tips without much effort. It was such a wise decision to come and work here. Sun God, I worship you!
At this time, Li Nianwei smiled and greeted him. She said softly, “Young Master, are you still shootingUnexpectedly!?”
“Shoot, of course, we will shoot it.” Hong Dali said while chuckling. “Get everyone ready, there are some amendments in the opening speech.”
“Okay.” Li Nianwei and Zhang Cai immediately arranged for everyone to prepare.
Ten minutes later, in Caiwei Entertainment’s recording studio.
It was still Ling Xiaoyi who made the opening speech: “This program is brought to you by—”
Following that, a male lackey with a deep voice continued: “Prodigal League,” before it was Hong Dali’s turn: “I want to spend freely, I want to squander!”
Ling Xiaoyi then continued: “And also—”
The same lackey said, “Tang’s Pharmaceutical,” And following it was Tang Muxin’s turn: “Don’t stop taking the medication!”
From here, there are additional lines in the script.
Ling Xiaoyi: “Might Beverages,” This time around, it was still Hong Dali who continued with his deep voice: “A day without Might Beverage, A day of discomfort!”
With the closure done by Ling Xiaoyi: “Sponsored and broadcasted.”

After the introduction, they were all rolling on the floor laughing. Zhang Cai could not even lift her head up, and Li Nianwei covered her mouth as she giggled. Even Tang Muxin, who had known beforehand, could not stop laughing.
Ling Xiaoyi, being the leader of the lackeys, was unable to hold back and burst out laughing. “Young Master’s ideas are always interesting.”
With a loudPa, Hong Dali gave out an order. “Everyone has coordinated well, tip everyone a thousand!”
Everyone around broke out in worship. “Thank You For Bestowing Kindness Upon Us, Young Master!”
After giggling for a short while, Hong Dali asked, “Are the opening animation and opening and ending theme songs finished? How are they?”

Zhang Cai, who followed Hong Dali the longest, reported first: “They have already been finished. These two are not difficult. Our avatars have been artistically edited before putting it in the opening scene. The effect is very good, so people will start laughing at a glance...”

“En, good.” Hong Dali nodded and said with satisfaction. “Then we will set off right now, to the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain! Remember to bring along the light and sound system equipment! Right, Xiaoyi, have you bought the Mountain?”
Xiaoyi answered, “Young Master, it has already been purchased by Master and is currently registered under your name.
“That’s good, haha!” Hong Dali laughed heartily. “Let’s go!”
At this moment, the lighting technician voiced out with much difficulty: “Young Master, if we were to go at this time, the lighting might not be good.”
Hong Dali: “If the light is not good... Oh right, bring along all the strong lights. If there is no sun, we will make one! Let’s go!”
Thus, a large group of people once again rushed downstairs.
Ten minutes later, at the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain.

Hong Dali looked at the surrounding environment, where green trees the lush grassland covered the landscape. Hong Dali was quite satisfied with it. Opening his arms wide, he shouted to the skies: “These hills are all mine, hahaha! This master here wants to occupy the mountain as the king and collect road tax!”
The people around responded instantly: “The Young Master is almighty!”

After being happy for a while, Hong Dali suddenly looked around and expressed dissatisfaction with the garbage hanging on trees buried in the grass. He immediately called upon Xiaoyi. “Xiaoyi, help me find people to come and clear away all these garbage lying around. This is such a good place, yet there is rubbish lying around everywhere, how can this be tolerated? In the future, I’m going to build a large cottage here, and a horse farm nearby. If I have nothing to do, I will just stop by to ride horses. The used plastic bags and iron boxes lying around will affect my mood. Help me calculate how much the cleaning costs.”

After a simple calculation, Ling Xiaoyi quickly replied, “Young Master, if it’s only this area, about 100,000 or so will be enough. However, if you want the mountains to be cleaned up too, then it will cost much more as many plastic bags are lying high up in the mountains. Helicopters may be needed to help clean it up. Adding everything up, it’s estimated that it will take about three million.”

“That’s settled then!” Hong Dali made a decision immediately. “I will fork out three million to improve the environment here. Such a scenic place with mountains and water, if it’s affected by garbage, that would not be pleasing to the eyes. Just use the helicopter to clear all the garbage on the hanging trees. You’re responsible for finding someone. If three million is not enough, come and find me for more.”
“Noted, Young Master.” Ling Xiaoyi hurriedly replied.

At this moment, Tang Muxin, who was beside Hong Dali, pulled his sleeves strongly and asked, “Dali, let’s shoot a movie using just this area. Just spend 100,000 or so to clean it up. There’s no need to make it so big, is there?” With regards to Hong Dali’s performance as a prodigal, Tang Muxin could do nothing to stop it. She could only see what was arranged by the Heavens for him.
“How is that possible?” Hong Dali rebutted. “This is my place. I am the master!”
