chapters.title: Chapter 92 - I Want! I Want To Sleep With You!
paragraphs: “Al... Alright then...” Towards Hong Dali, the professional prodigal, Tang Muxin had completely given up on treating him. In reality, even though she was smart, she was still unable to figure out the true meaning behind Hong Dali’s decision to clean the garbage around the mountain. However, there was one thing she was sure of—the brat Dali must have thought of a new way to squander...

“Okay, okay, everyone please get ready to change your clothes, it’s time to start shooting!” Hong Dali’s instructions rained down like sacred verdicts, causing everyone to act on it immediately. After all, no one wanted to go against money. If Young Master were pleased, he would reward them unhesitatingly.
Ten minutes later.

A slightly plump male lackey dressed in an ancient costume laid on the ground with his emotionally filled eyes gazing at the sunset and softly voiced: “I have lived a life with no regrets. Thinking back to the days when I was running around under the sunset...” At the same time, a second male lackey who was also dressed in an ancient costume started slowly jogging at the side, only leaving behind a lonely view of his back. After that, the slightly plump lackey from before followed: “That was my lost youth, ah~”

The “ah~” following the end of his sentence was filled with overwhelming sorrow. Even though it was only a single sound, it was all-encompassing, filled with many types of different emotions—dissatisfaction, refusal to give in, and many others.

The people nearby who heard the act almost stitched their sides while laughing. Li Nianwei gently covered her rosy little mouth with her hand, smiling sweetly. Tang Muxin, who was younger, held her stomach while laughing till she was unable to straighten her waist. Ling Xiaoyi, who stood behind, was at a loss whether to laugh or cry, said in her heart: This Young Master is so funny every time. I doubt that anyone can even handle him.

“Nicely done! Tip them!” Hong Dali was extremely satisfied with the duo’s performance. “Tip them both 5000 each!” There was a saying that everyone should have an opportunity, and one should not be inferior when treating others. “Tip the rest 3000 each!”
The crowd broke out in worship. “Thank You For Bestowing Kindness Upon Us, Young Master!”

The shoot progressed at a tremendous pace, managing to reach the finale of the episode within just half an hour. The slightly plump male lackey hugged onto Hong Dali’s arm tightly, rubbing his head on Hong Dali’s arm while saying: “You’re my savior. I want, I want to sleep with you tonight! I want! I want! Please let me sleep with you tonight!”
The people around once again laughed till they collapsed on the ground.

At this point in time, even without Hong Dali’s explanation, everyone could already see the prospect of this video. After laughing for a while, Zhang Cai came forward and said while smiling, “Young master, we have finished shooting the segment. What’s left is the post-production. Are we now... going to go back first?”

Everyone felt reluctant to leave the place without touring around and enjoying themselves. However, they knew that it was not a holiday, and there were many parts of the film that needed post-production editing, such as the part where the demon king fell off the cliff...

Hong Dali, on the other hand, was not in a rush at all. In fact, he did not care whether the show would be the broadcasted one day later and waved his hand directly. “Let’s go to Ye Lai Xiang. There’s no need to rush the work tonight, let’s relax and enjoy ourselves!”
Everyone erupted in a cheering round of applause.

Hong Dali rubbed his chin before continuing, “En, we should not leave the others out. Sister Cai, call those from the Zhong Dian website over too. Let’s relax this evening, everything will be on the house! Everyone, let’s go!”
And thus, a large group of people rushed directly into Ye Lai Xiang.

Speaking of it, Hong Dali did not come over for quite some time already. As a result, when he came here after shootingUnexpectedly! today, not only was the other people stunned, but even Hong Dali himself was stunned.

The current Ye Lai Xiang was filled to the brim. The current situation was not a single bit like in the past, where there were only one or two cars seen in the vicinity. Now, not even a parking space could be found, with many cars having to stop dozens of meters away. The whole street was packed with cars, with many even being of luxurious brands. Coupled with a variety of small stalls beside the road, the street which originally was empty now bustled with activity at a level comparable to that of the city center.

“This... what is this situation?” Hong Dali was stunned with eyes wide open. “I don’t remember the services in Ye Lai Xiang being free today. How are there so many cars?” Speaking up to there, Hong Dali’s eyes suddenly turned bright. “Unless there is something fun going on inside tonight?!”
Tang Muxin, who knew the previous situation the place was in when Hong Dali had just bought it, was also shocked. “Dali, this... Is this the original Ye Lai Xiang?”
“It should be...” Hong Dali looked around and tilted his head up to look at the big “Ye Lai Xiang” characters on the signboard. “It should be right. Go, let’s go in and see what is happening inside!”
Everyone entered Ye Lai Xiang in a formidable formation. When the security guard saw them, he immediately went upstairs report.

Hong Dali and the others went all the way in until they reached the main hall. At this time, it was already full of people. Hong Dali glanced around and said, “Heck, is it really free today? I remember I didn’t arrange it, how are there so many people?”
No wonder he was in doubt. In the night hall, there were currently at least 1700 to 1800 people. The hall was just like a crowded bus, with no seats left vacant.

“Young Master!” When Hong Dali was still pondering, the lobby manager rushed over to his side. When he saw Hong Dali, he quickly greeted him. “You’re here, Young Master. Quickly, follow me in. I was unsure of when Young Master would come and visit, so I deliberately arranged one of the biggest private rooms to be kept out of bounds, where no one else is allowed to enter. Seems like it’s finally going to be put to use today.”
“Haha, not bad.” Hong Dali waved his hand. “Tip him 5000!”
After thanking Hong Dali, he hurriedly spoke to Li Nianwei: “Miss Nianwei, please go in quickly too. Currently, your popularity is too high. Once you’re seen by those in the hall...”
Unluckily, before they were even able to move, a few people had already seen Li Nianwei, who let out a scream that could shatter the glass windows. “Ahhhhh!! It’s the goddess! Goddess Li Nianwei!”

The scream almost caused Hong Dali to fall due to fear. Everyone immediately turned around and fled, decisively heading to the door. If they were a little slower and were surrounded by the fanatic fans, they would only become like a zoo monkey—being watched while being surrounded.

After all, no one wanted to go against money.
If Young Master were pleased, he would reward them unhesitatingly.
Ten minutes later.
A slightly plump male lackey dressed in an ancient costume laid on the ground with his emotionally filled eyes gazing at the sunset and softly voiced: “I have lived a life with no regrets.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - Gold-digger
paragraphs: The place where the lobby manager was referring to was actually the plot of land filled with two-story private apartments behind Ye Lai Xiang. There, the environment was relatively quiet, and the yard area was relatively large. All the apartments there were all old buildings of more than ten years old. The lobby manager said while moving, “This area here was purchased by Young Master’s father a while back. At that time, the manager of this plot of land came to find me and instructed me that if Young Master Dali were to meet with trouble when visiting Ye Lai Xiang, you can come and stay here for a while. He has given me the key to the apartments in this area already.”

Speaking of which, the real estate department of Hong Weiguo’s company had already bought nearly all of the apartments there, but some of them had yet to move away—before purchasing the apartments, Hong Weiguo had already instructed that getting the ownership of the house was enough, and the residents could still continue living in the apartments until the land development project had finished. Thus, there was not much difficulty when purchasing this plot of land.

After reaching a large iron gate, the lobby manager took out the key and opened the door. Everyone entered the double-story building, which covered an area of about 200 square meters. When he arrived at the living room, the lobby manager heaved a sigh of relief. “It was lucky this time. I was scared to death just now. If anything happened to the Young Master, using my life to compensate would not even be sufficient.”
Hong Dali had a weak constitution. This was a well-known fact. If those crazy fans were to accidentally knock him down, everything would be finished for him.

Freely sitting down on the center of the sofa, Hong Dali asked while chuckling, “It’s okay, the problem is not that big. Quickly, tell me what’s with Ye Lai Xiang recently. Why are there so many people nearby?”

The lobby manager sorted out his thoughts before explaining. “Speaking of it, it was because of Young Master’s decision to make Ye Lai Xiang free to visit for a period of time previously. Of course, it’s not entirely because of that. There are other reasons too, which I will slowly explain to you, Young Master.”
“En, do say.” Hong Dali nodded his head.

The others were also full of curiosity in their hearts. In their view, for a nightclub that was on the verge of bankruptcy previously to reach its current state, it was a seemingly impossible task. It was the same as a chicken laying a magical golden egg.

“It’s like this.” The lobby manager said slowly. “In the beginning, it’s unnecessary to say that the nightclub was filled to the brim during the period when it was free. However, after the complimentary period, the number of customers did not immediately decrease. I was very surprised at first, but after careful inquiry, I finally understood why the business continued to thrive.

“Making services complimentary for a week was, in fact, not too big a stimulation of consumption in Ye Lai Xiang. The real reason for the huge rise in popularity was actually because of Young Master’s classmates who often come to play.”

“Wait a minute!” When the lobby manager spoke up to there, Tang Muxin became shocked. “You mean, the rise in popularity here was not because this place was where Sister Nianwei held her first performance, but because of Hong Dali’s classmates?!”
As Tang Muxin said so, everyone else nodded along.

In their opinion, the main reason why this place skyrocketed in popularity was that this was where Li Nianwei debuted and held her first performance which shocked the world and made her famous. This could be said to be the birthplace of the superstar Li Nianwei, which could easily explain the reason behind its sudden rise in popularity.
However, the lobby manager actually said that it was not because of this, causing them to find it really hard to understand.

“In the beginning, I too thought it was because of Miss Nianwei.” The lobby manager wiped the cold sweat on his forehead before continuing, “But it was only after I carefully inquired that I realized it wasn’t because of this. I was wrong...”

“As everyone knows, Miss Li Nianwei can now be regarded as the top star in the country, and her popularity is still rising and soaring. The chance of coming to Ye Lai Xiang can be said to be near zero. If one wants to see Miss Li Nianwei, it’s obviously not a good choice to stay here and wait for her to appear.”
After he said this, everyone nodded in agreement.

His explanation was very simple and clear. Li Nianwei had become famous and would be surrounded by fans wherever she went. How would she dare to come to such a place, who could bear the responsibility if something happened to her? After all, there was a lot of people here, and no one could guarantee her safety.

The lobby manager continued, “Thus, after I asked two people, I realized that I had always been thinking in the wrong direction. However, Ye Lai Xiang’s popularity is indeed very high. If it’s not due to Miss Nianwei, then what is it? Only after I investigated it for a week, did I finally figure everything out thoroughly.”
Speaking up to there, the lobby manager smiled bitterly. “After understanding the real reason, I felt that I have really become old...”
“Aiya, can you just tell us what’s is the real reason now?” Tang Muxin spoke the hearts of everyone. “Why do you like to speak so slowly and make us die of anticipation?”

The lobby manager’s body shook a bit before he looked around and surrendered. “The reason for the good business is because of Young Master’s classmates—everyone knows Young Master’s classmates, they are local tycoons!”
“En, that’s true.” Hong Dali said with a grin. “Those local tycoons do not lack money at all.”

The lobby manager continued, “There are so many local tycoons, and all of them have top-level membership cards, which mean everything is free for them. They usually like to go out and play. Not only do they have a strong background, but they’re also the sole heirs of their families and are filthy rich. So, in the beginning, some smart ones would here to try and build a connection with these local tycoons—if one managed to build a connection with these local tyrants, especially with their family, doing things would be much simpler for them.

“So, in the beginning, successful businessmen started to come here often. Young Master’s classmates who could receive gifts if they came were also willing to come to take a look. This caused the business to start getting better and more popular.” However, speaking up to here, the lobby manager dropped another bait. “However, this was not the main thing!”
He paused for a while, and after he felt deathly stares from everyone around, he quickly decided to say: “The main reason is because of women.”
“Because of women?!” Tang Muxin exclaimed. “How is it related to women? Which woman is so attractive?”

“Not which. It is, in fact, because of a group of women.” The lobby manager smiled bitterly. “In this current day and age, there are a lot of gold-diggers, and I have to admit that this bunch of gold-diggers does look attractive.”
Everyone nodded their heads.

The lobby manager continued, “In Ye Lai Xiang, there is often successful businessman who come here to talk about cooperation, which attracts a large number of gold-diggers. These women have a very strong interest in money, so they easily became close to those people. It’s an undeniable fact that when beautiful women appear, it will also bring along popularity for the business. With their appearance, young people looking for excitement with women were also attracted. And among them were all kinds of nouveau riches.”

“When the nouveau riches started to come, the number of gold-diggers also started to increase. Just like a snowball rolling off a hill, the popularity began to rise without a hitch, which finally resulted in today’s situation. In particular,” the lobby manager said helplessly. “We have dining centers and bathrooms upstairs and... and suites...”
Everyone listening became stunned with their eyes wide open. Even Li Nianwei also opened her mouth, her face depicting her shock.
No one expected it. The original Ye Lai Xiang, which almost went bankrupt and was bought with 8,000,000 would, because of such a reason, in just a few days, experience a complete overturn.

After having finished explaining, the lobby manager wiped the cold sweat off his forehead and finally reported the turnover. “Now, the net profit of Ye Lai Xiang is about... 45,000 yuan, Young Master.”

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - You Will Not Understand Even If I Explained
paragraphs: “4... 45,000 yuan!” After hearing this number, everyone was completely stunned. Tang Muxin exclaimed loudly: “If the revenue of one day amounts up to 45,000, that would mean a total of 1,350,000 in a single month. One year would total 16.2 million! My God, the initial investment can be recovered in half a year, and the total revenue could even double in merely one year!”

A nightclub that was about to close down, bought at the low cost of 8,000,000, reached a sky-high net profit of 45,000 yuan in less than a month. Anyone who heard this would have thought of it as a dream. However, everyone knew that it was definitely not one as it had happened right in front of their eyes.

“It seems that’s correct.” After calculating with the help of the calculator on his mobile phone, Hong Dali was full of shock and looked at Tang Muxin. “Xinxin, you’re so quick at doing accounts. Does Uncle Tang know that?”
“Of course, he does!” Tang Muxin gave Hong Dali a jab on the back of his head. “Only you are unable to do such an easy thing!”
“I’m an idiot when it comes to math.” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders indifferently. “The one that causes the most headache is mathematics. I have never understood it since I was young.”

“Dali~~” When Tang Muxin turned around this time, she used both her hands to pinch Hong Dali’s cheek and kept shaking his head around, before asking coquettishly, “Did you buy Ye Lai Xiang expecting this to happen since the beginning? Faster, tell me please...”

After being pinched by Tang Muxin, Hong Dali’s original handsome face suddenly turned into a variety of shapes, filled with emotions of joy. He spoke evasively, “Pain! It hurts! I didn’t think so much at that point. I just wanted to squander. Since I had money, and there was nowhere to spend it on, I just bought it casually!”

Talking about it, when Hong Dali first bought Ye Lai Xiang, he just wanted to squander really badly—it was a mission by the system, and he had to spend 100,000 yuan in four hours. If the task were not finished, his attributes points would have been deducted. With his pathetic attribute points then, he couldn’t let any be deducted. Where could he then, have had the time and option to consider whether the deal was worth it or not?

However, in the eyes of the others, it was completely different. There was already Li Nianwei’s example previously. Now, with the additional classic case of Ye Lai Xiang, everyone looked at Hong Dali with eyes full of worship.

In this world which had a history of around 5000 years and contained a total of 50 billion people, perhaps only he could squander at such a level. There was and would be definitely no one like him, be it in the past, present, or future.

“You only know to fool me all day!” Tang Muxin’s pouted her little mouth and muttered. “Why do you always get such good returns every time you squander? You are able to have such huge returns every time you spend money. First, you gave two million to Sister Nianwei to hold a concert, which caused her worth to exceed 20 million. Then, you went to that restaurant of yours and called more than 160 dishes and even changed the fish pond. The result is that it brought in revenue exceeding 10,000 every day. And now, there is the case of Ye Lai Xiang, where you made access and everything complimentary for one whole week, but managed to turn it into a nightclub that can now make 40 to 50 thousand a day!”

Having said that, Tang Muxin summed up fiercely. “I don’t believe that your luck is so good!” In fact, there was also the case of the mysterious dark gold earrings artifact that was deliberately purchased to squander, but its usage was still unclear. As not everyone in the room was close and trustable, Tang Muxin did not tap on the issue.
However, despite this, after listening to Tang Muxin’s words, the people around all vigorously nodded their heads in agreement!
To squander at such a level, was akin to being a god.
“I have long said that squandering is a form of art,” Hong said with a straight face. “You will not understand even if I explained.”

“You always say this every time.” Tang Muxin screamed and ignored him. “So why don’t you teach me?” Immediately after saying that, she decisively denied. “Wait, no! I don’t want to become a prodigal!”

Hong Dali held a frowning face, not knowing what to say. However, Li Nianwei, who was like a big sister, was understanding and thoughtful. She pulled Tang Muxin into her arms and said, “Muxin, everyone has their own destiny. Young Master is destined to be a lucky star. If you think about it carefully, Young Master has always been surrounded by luck ever since we met him. At Ye Lai Xiang, he met Xiaoyi, one of the best housekeepers As for the other few, they’re also very loyal to Young Master. On top of that, there is also me.”

Li Nianwei softly comforted. “It was luck that allowed me to meet Young Master. The Young Master gave me a concert which allowed me to became very popular, and my reputation to become great. Are these not due to the Young Master’s luck? If it were others, and they were not as casual as Young Master, it may not have had such an effect.”

In the end, with big sister Li Nianwei’s skill in comforting people, Tang Muxin twitched her cute little nose and said, “Hmph, let’s attribute it to his good luck then.” After saying that, she opened her mouth again. “Why do I feel like my sense of logic is broken!”

At this time, the lobby manager who had been standing on the side finally had the opportunity to interject and said, “Un, Young Madam, when I went to see the person in charge who was responsible for the purchase of the property, he too said the same.”
“What did he say?” As Tang Muxin was young at heart and was easily distracted. Thus, her attention was shifted away easily.

The lobby manager wiped his cold sweat and said, “I asked the person in charge, ‘Is it alright to buy so many land and properties?’ Then the person in charge helplessly answered, ‘Any kind of problems and difficulties would falter when faced with Young Master’s invincible luck.’ Then he went away with a depressed face. I didn’t know what he meant before, but now...” He then continued with a depressed face, “Now I really understand...”
Not only did he understand, but the others did as well.

To put it bluntly, Young Master Dali was lucky to the point that when he walked, he could even be hit by money falling from the sky. Occasionally, if he were to step on a dog’s shit, there would even be a precious golden ring hidden inside the pile of dung! His luck couldn’t be compared. It would only make one more depressed if one were to do so.
Hong Dali also nodded his head continuously while listening. He then touched his chin and said, “En, that’s true. if I’m not lucky, who can even be considered lucky?!”
Everyone else was stumped for words.
When a super prodigal possessed invincible luck, the sense of oppression was really a headache for people to think about.

As they were thinking about it, a voice came in from the door. Li Nianwei smiled and said, “Lobby Manager, please help to open the door. It should be Sister Cai and the others.” Her voice was very gentle, which made those who heard it feel soothed and create a good impression of her.

“En, okay.” Even the super idol had spoken. The lobby manager had no choice but to be the lapdog. He was the highest figure in Ye Lai Xiang, but here, he could only run errands. It was estimated that even Hong Dali’s nine lackeys had a higher status than him in everyone’s eyes.

Soon, Zhang Cai came in with a large group of people from the Zhong Dian website, and the entire first-floor living room suddenly became crowded. When this group of people arrived, Zhang Wenyang, the director who only knew to spend money, did not care about anything else except for finding Hong Dali. When he saw Hong Dali, he quickly ran up and shouted: “Young Master, there’s not enough money!”

sentences.text: 45,000 yuan!” After hearing this number, everyone was completely stunned.
Tang Muxin exclaimed loudly: “If the revenue of one day amounts up to 45,000, that would mean a total of 1,350,000 in a single month.
One year would total 16.2 million!
My God, the initial investment can be recovered in half a year, and the total revenue could even double in merely one year!”
A nightclub that was about to close down, bought at the low cost of 8,000,000, reached a sky-high net profit of 45,000 yuan in less than a month.
Anyone who heard this would have thought of it as a dream.
However, everyone knew that it was definitely not one as it had happened right in front of their eyes.
“It seems that’s correct.” After calculating with the help of the calculator on his mobile phone, Hong Dali was full of shock and looked at Tang Muxin.
“Xinxin, you’re so quick at doing accounts.
Does Uncle Tang know that?”
“Of course, he does!” Tang Muxin gave Hong Dali a jab on the back of his head.
“Only you are unable to do such an easy thing!”
“I’m an idiot when it comes to math.” Hong Dali shrugged his shoulders indifferently.
“The one that causes the most headache is mathematics.
I have never understood it since I was young.”

“Dali~~” When Tang Muxin turned around this time, she used both her hands to pinch Hong Dali’s cheek and kept shaking his head around, before asking coquettishly, “Did you buy Ye Lai Xiang expecting this to happen since the beginning?
Faster, tell me please...”
After being pinched by Tang Muxin, Hong Dali’s original handsome face suddenly turned into a variety of shapes, filled with emotions of joy.
He spoke evasively, “Pain!
It hurts!
I didn’t think so much at that point.
I just wanted to squander.
Since I had money, and there was nowhere to spend it on, I just bought it casually!”
Talking about it, when Hong Dali first bought Ye Lai Xiang, he just wanted to squander really badly—it was a mission by the system, and he had to spend 100,000 yuan in four hours.
If the task were not finished, his attributes points would have been deducted.
With his pathetic attribute points then, he couldn’t let any be deducted.
Where could he then, have had the time and option to consider whether the deal was worth it or not?
However, in the eyes of the others, it was completely different.
There was already Li Nianwei’s example previously.
Now, with the additional classic case of Ye Lai Xiang, everyone looked at Hong Dali with eyes full of worship.
In this world which had a history of around 5000 years and contained a total of 50 billion people, perhaps only he could squander at such a level.
There was and would be definitely no one like him, be it in the past, present, or future.
“You only know to fool me all day!” Tang Muxin’s pouted her little mouth and muttered.
“Why do you always get such good returns every time you squander?
You are able to have such huge returns every time you spend money.
First, you gave two million to Sister Nianwei to hold a concert, which caused her worth to exceed 20 million.
Then, you went to that restaurant of yours and called more than 160 dishes and even changed the fish pond.
The result is that it brought in revenue exceeding 10,000 every day.
And now, there is the case of Ye Lai Xiang, where you made access and everything complimentary for one whole week, but managed to turn it into a nightclub that can now make 40 to 50 thousand a day!”
Having said that, Tang Muxin summed up fiercely.

“I don’t believe that your luck is so good!” In fact, there was also the case of the mysterious dark gold earrings artifact that was deliberately purchased to squander, but its usage was still unclear.
As not everyone in the room was close and trustable, Tang Muxin did not tap on the issue.
However, despite this, after listening to Tang Muxin’s words, the people around all vigorously nodded their heads in agreement!
To squander at such a level, was akin to being a god.
“I have long said that squandering is a form of art,” Hong said with a straight face.
“You will not understand even if I explained.”
“You always say this every time.” Tang Muxin screamed and ignored him.
“So why don’t you teach me?” Immediately after saying that, she decisively denied.
“Wait, no!
I don’t want to become a prodigal!”
Hong Dali held a frowning face, not knowing what to say.
However, Li Nianwei, who was like a big sister, was understanding and thoughtful.
She pulled Tang Muxin into her arms and said, “Muxin, everyone has their own destiny.
Young Master is destined to be a lucky star.
If you think about it carefully, Young Master has always been surrounded by luck ever since we met him.
At Ye Lai Xiang, he met Xiaoyi, one of the best housekeepers As for the other few, they’re also very loyal to Young Master.
On top of that, there is also me.”
Li Nianwei softly comforted.
“It was luck that allowed me to meet Young Master.
The Young Master gave me a concert which allowed me to became very popular, and my reputation to become great.
Are these not due to the Young Master’s luck?
If it were others, and they were not as casual as Young Master, it may not have had such an effect.”

In the end, with big sister Li Nianwei’s skill in comforting people, Tang Muxin twitched her cute little nose and said, “Hmph, let’s attribute it to his good luck then.” After saying that, she opened her mouth again.
“Why do I feel like my sense of logic is broken!”

At this time, the lobby manager who had been standing on the side finally had the opportunity to interject and said, “Un, Young Madam, when I went to see the person in charge who was responsible for the purchase of the property, he too said the same.”
“What did he say?” As Tang Muxin was young at heart and was easily distracted.
Thus, her attention was shifted away easily.

The lobby manager wiped his cold sweat and said, “I asked the person in charge, ‘Is it alright to buy so many land and properties?’ Then the person in charge helplessly answered, ‘Any kind of problems and difficulties would falter when faced with Young Master’s invincible luck.’ Then he went away with a depressed face.
I didn’t know what he meant before, but now...” He then continued with a depressed face, “Now I really understand...”
Not only did he understand, but the others did as well.

Occasionally, if he were to step on a dog’s shit, there would even be a precious golden ring hidden inside the pile of dung!
His luck couldn’t be compared.
It would only make one more depressed if one were to do so.
Hong Dali also nodded his head continuously while listening.
He then touched his chin and said, “En, that’s true. if I’m not lucky, who can even be considered lucky?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - Will This Burn Money?
paragraphs: Once those words left Zhang Wenyang’s mouth, eyeballs popped out onto the floor, and the sounds of jaws cracking filled the room.
Hong Dali violently slapped his thigh. “Good job!” Then, eyes glittering, he asked, “How much did you spend?”
Zhang Wenyang reported truthfully: “200,000 yuan to hire the Internet Water Army and 1.5 million yuan on advertisements. I haven’t started spending on other things yet.”

Hong Dali secretly called out the system. Indeed, the value shown was 2 million or so. Looks like this guy was indeed good at spending money! Also, he didn’t treat Hong Dali like a fool and take any money for himself. Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said, “Well done, tip him!”
Instantly, a lackey walked forth with a Payment Terminal. “Young Master, how much?”

“Everyone, two thousand!” Hong Dali grinned and said. He definitely must make good use of such a talent who knew how to spend money. “Take it as a red packet for everyone. En, how is the website doing now? I didn’t pay attention to it these past two days, I was focusing on giving credit rewards for authors.”

This time, it was CEO Hong’s turn to make his report. After all, the website’s results were getting better and better. Thus, his face was red with pride as he bowed towards Hong Dali and said in an official manner, “Firstly, I would like to thank Young Master for your support. I also thank all the staff for their hard work and effort. Also, I have to thank Director Zhang Wenyang for his sharp insight and Chief Editor Tang for his ability to seek out talents...”
Hong Dali kicked him aside and pointed at Zhang Wenyang. “You do the report instead. I want a simple one!”

Indeed, being someone who graduated from a third-class university, he wouldn’t act in such an official manner. Zhang Wenyang decisively said, “Currently speaking, the IP volume of Zhong Dian website has exceeded 300,000. Furthermore, the number of authors also rose these few days.”
Hong Dali nodded his head in satisfaction. He winked and said, “OK, not bad. But I’m not very concerned about that. You know what I mean.”

“Spending money is my forte!” Zhang Wenyang waved his hand. “Young Master, you can use the novels to adapt them into movies, dramas, or web-games! My personal suggestion is to adapt those novels that Young Master liked to watch because their contract has already been bought over by us—their copyright is easy to handle.”
Hong Dali stretched his neck. “Will this burn money?”
Zhang Wenyang fiercely nodded and said, “Burn!”
“I approve!” Hong Dali slapped his thigh. “Then, that’s what we shall do!”
Everyone around them sighed.

Adapting online novels into movies or dramas wasn’t something new, but those were all adapted from famous literary works. No one knew what effects there would be in adapting online novels that were updated on a daily basis into movies or dramas.

Tang Muxin violently shook Hong Dali’s elbow. “Dali, can we not do this? We’re talking about movies and dramas—even if Sister Nianwei helps out, the resources and people needed are too great. If this fails, you will lose tens of millions. If you want to adapt it into web-games, no one is familiar in this. If the game isn’t fun, you will lose even more money.”
“It’s fine to take some losses.” Hong Dali looked at Tang Muxin weirdly. “You don’t want to film a movie?”

“I don’t...” The little lass immediately wanted to reject, but she didn’t manage to tolerate it in the end and fiercely nodded her head. “I want to!” Then, she started shaking his elbow again. “But even if we want to film a movie, we can’t spend money in such a manner. One movie requires at least 5 million yuan of capital, right? Adding that to the cost of inviting celebrities and whatnot, it’s a challenging project. Also, where would I have the time to do that?”

Now, everyone was waiting for Hong Dali to make the final decision. Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “Yup, speaking of which, this is quite interesting. Just that we indeed don’t have so much time. After all, we can’t skip school. In this case, let’s start with a small project. After school, Xinxin can go and be a guest actress to satisfy your craving. Let’s base it on the scale of a 5 million yuan movie project. We shall just have a feel of what it’s like first.” His mission of spending 15 million yuan in a month hadn’t been completed yet, he couldn’t afford to be careless. He had already spent almost 7 million yuan and was lacking 8 million or so. He only had half a month left; therefore, he had to make the most of his time.
Tang Muxin still wanted to reject, but she knew that what Hong Dali had already decided couldn’t be changed even if eight horses pulled him back. Thus, she could only give up on trying.
Hong Dali looked at Zhang Wenyang again. “Is there anything else regarding the website? How much more money do you need to expand it?”

Zhang Wenyang thought for quite some time before drawing out a calculator from his pocket and started counting. Finally, he was done and said, “Currently, there’s still one million left over from the three million that you previously gave. We still need about 2 million for advertisements, and that’s about it.”
“Is two million enough?” Hong Dali asked.

“It’s enough in the short term.” Zhang Wenyang answered. “Currently, there are quite a number of advertisers wanting to put their advertisements on our website. Their price offers are not bad too. Basically, it will be able to sustain the website for another two months.”

“Reject all the advertisements!” Hong Dali got angry when he mentioned the advertisements. “No wonder it was so slow when I was opening the webpage in school. It was all because of the advertisements. Take down all of the advertisements, not a single one is to be left!”

Director Yang, who was standing by the side, broke out in cold sweat. He anxiously said, “Young Master, the advertisements are the main source of income for our website at the moment. After all, 70% of the profits from readers are given to the authors. We only keep 30%, and we still have to pay the authors when they update chapters constantly. The profit and loss for that part are only just leveled out. If we take down the advertisements, we would be making a loss...”
Hearing him say so, all of the employees nodded—after all, a human must still eat, they must still have their pay.
“Remove all of them!” Hong Dali decided. “I will give you another three million yuan. I want all of the advertisements to be taken down within three days!”

“Three million yuan!” Tang Muxin slapped her forehead. “Dali, you are really a prodigal! In the past, you never made any losses because of your luck. Instead, you even earned a little. But cutting off the main source of income of your website, you will not have any income! How can that be?”

You don’t say. If they can provide for themselves, how am I supposed to complete the mission the system gave me? Hong Dali said in a matter-of-fact tone, “No worries, I don’t lack this little money. Just do as I said!”
“I will be sure complete the mission!” Zhang Wenyang saluted Hong Dali. “Young Master is still better at spending money than me!”

Hearing this, everyone shivered.The two of you are not only good at spending money, but you two are also really prodigals! It’s not that we don’t understand, it’s just that the world is changing too fast!
Tang Muxin pouted and said, “I want to see if your luck this time is still as good! Everything will bow before your luck, I don’t believe this saying! Humph, I’m going to ignore you!”
Li Nianwei silently hugged Tang Muxin and softly said, “Muxin, as long as Young Master likes it, let him do it. All we have to do is just to support him, there’s no need to think so much.”
“Fine.” Tang Muxin learned from Hong Dali and sniffled her cute little nose. “Sister Nianwei, you’re spoiling him too much!”
“Aren’t you the same.” Li Nianwei softly laughed and said, “On the surface, you’re going against him in everything. But in reality, your heart cares about him, right?”
“Heehee, you even noticed that. Sister Nianwei, you’re really amazing!”

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - The Tang Familys Crisis
paragraphs: Now that all of the important matters had been settled, Hong Dali decisively gave the employees a break. “OK, everyone go have fun today. Except for the money used on seeking out women, I will pay for all of your other expenses! Also, help me look out for game developers. I will purchase them directly!”

“Play as they like, Young Master would be paying the expenses”—that was definitely the happiest news they heard today. Everyone exclaimed: “Thank you, Young Master, for the generosity!” Then, they flowed out of the building in waves. Those wanting to drink, drank. Those wanting to flirt, flirted. They had their Young Master backing them up anyway, they would not be afraid even if the sky collapsed!

Very soon, the building was almost empty. The originally packed living hall was now empty, only leaving Hong Dali and his group. Hong Dali leaned against the sofa, supporting his head with his hands. He let out a comfortable sigh and said, “We can’t play there today, it’s too packed. I hate crowded places.”
When there were a lot of people, it was noisy and messy. It was like thousands of flies flying around his ear. Hong Dali disliked that.
Li Nianwei was very understanding and comforted him. “Young Master, why don’t we go walk the dogs. Today’s weather is quite warm and comfortable, it will be very beneficial for our bodies.”
“Yup, this is a good idea.” Tang Muxin agreed too, but she felt a little unhappy in the end. “A pity that I didn’t bring Xiao Xiaobai.”
“Didn’t I also not bring Xiao Xiao? The caretaker is taking care of her.” Hong Dali stood up suddenly and said, “Just find any random dogs and let’s walk them! Lackeys, let’s go!”
“Yes, Young Master!” Ever since this phrase existed, only Hong Dali’s lackeys exercised it to the limit...
At the same time, Tang Muxin’s home.
This was near Tianjin’s west third loop, nearing the fourth loop, and only a few rivers’ apart. Tang Muxin’s house was in the district of the rich Shangjing Grand Garden.

Normally speaking, having a smart daughter and a beautiful wife, Tang Ruisi’s life should have been blissful. However, a gloomy atmosphere filled his house now. Tang Ruisi sat on a real leather sofa, frowning his eyebrows and smoking non-stop.
“Old Tang, don’t worry. If you worry yourself out and damage your body, that will only put us in an even more difficult position. Forest Medical Enterprise will start celebrating.”

Yuan Jieya was only slightly above 40 years old this year, an age where a woman was most charming. Especially because she was also very pretty, and her character was smooth like water. However, she was unlike most women whose looks and intelligence quotient were exact opposites. The reason that Tang Muxin was so pretty was mainly because of the outstanding genes she inherited from her mother.

Tang Ruisi sucked in a deep breath, extinguished the cigarette butt, smiled and said, “Sigh, that side is following very tightly. I can’t afford to be relaxed in the slightest. Now, which of our two companies can complete the research project first will emerge victoriously. The losing side might lose all of the capital used in the research project. After all, in the field of medical research, the one who succeeds and announce it on the news first will cause the result to be fixed. The possibility of turnover will be very small then.” Speaking to this point, he gradually shook his head and said, “Now that the money that I borrowed from the Hong family is mostly used, if we fail, I won’t be able to face Hong Weiguo and his wife anymore, sigh.”

“You’re right, there isn’t anything we can do now.” Yuan Jieya softly sighed and said, “I understand that. But Old Tang, how did our research plan got leaked out in the first place? Not only did our research plan got leaked out, but even the files were also stolen. If we don’t find the spy, even if we finish the research first, if it gets stolen before we finish with the experiments, our positions will be even more difficult.”

“A spy, hehe.” Tang Ruisi gave a bitter smile and said, “This person is too well hidden, I don’t have any ideas at all. I don’t have any clue as to who the culprit is. If our plan wasn’t leaked, why would we need to lower our face and borrow money from the Hong Family by almost selling our daughter to speed up the research process? Hong Weiguo might not blame me, but this matter was my wrongdoing. I feel bad in my heart, sigh. If Xinxin liked Hong Dali, it wouldn’t be much of a problem, but the fact is that she doesn’t like him. Such a father as I...”

“I know that you’re anxious, but don’t be like this. If you fall sick, it will only make matters worse.” Yuan Jieya sighed and said, “All we can do now is to be more careful. We can’t afford to make any more mistakes, at least before we can be sure that we won’t lose. Although that child Dali likes to squander, his virtues are not bad. If not, Xinxin would not have gone out and frequently played with him. Don’t be anxious anymore, let’s take things one step at a time. If they can really get together, that might not be a bad thing. After all, money isn’t everything—it’s the virtues that are more important. The only thing I’m worried about now is that Dali’s body seems to be too weak. I fear that he will... sigh...”

“Yes, that’s what I’m worried about too. I fear that Xinxin will become a widow in the future. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have objected to them being together. Who can bear to watch their own daughter face such a fate? But from the current looks of things, we can only let things be.” Tang Ruisi slowly breathed in. “Oh right, don’t tell Xinxin about the things in the family, I don’t want her to worry.”
“Yes, I know. Don’t worry.”

Hong Dali naturally didn’t know of the matters happening in the Tang Family. He was carrying two Samoyeds, Tang Muxin was carrying two Chow Chows, while the Driver had a special liking to Labradors. The nine lackeys each held two Tibetan Mastiffs, while Li Nianwei and Zhang Cai both wore sunglasses and scarfs, each carrying two Huskies.

Of course, the rate of people looking back at them was 100% for sure.

“No! Definitely no!” Tang Muxin furiously shook her head. “Walking the dogs now is already not bad. I think this is good enough. Look at these two Chow Chows, aren’t they fun?”

“Ah... I have finished reading the novels, and there aren’t any interesting shows on the television now as well.” Hong Dali felt that he was going to break down. Hong Dali looked at the top of the hill. “The mountain stronghold hasn’t started building yet, I can’t even go there and experience being a bandit lord...”

“Exactly.” Hong Dali pouted. “At least shoot some interesting drama, or even create some talent show... eh? Talent show? Wait, let me think, this thing really hasn’t been done before. This is worth investigating.”

“Talent show!?” Tang Muxin shouted. “Aren’t Sister Nianwei and me not enough for you to look at? You still want to make a talent show!?”

Li Nianwei who was at the side pursed her lips, smiled and said, “The talent show that Young Master is talking about isn’t a beauty contest, right? Young Master doesn’t seem to be that kind of pervert.”

“Heh heh. Sister Nianwei knows me well!” Finally, he had something to do. Hong Dali felt very happy. “The talent show I’m talking about is actually something like a singing contest! A few singers will be singing on stage, and the audience will be giving them points. The last in place will be kicked out! The name of the competition shall be called ‘I Am a Singer’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - Preparation for “I Am a Singer”
paragraphs: “I Am a Singer”! This name was quite awesome, and Hong Dali was referencing it from the show from his previous life, also called “I Am a Singer.” It could be said that the show created quite a viewing miracle in his previous life!

Hong Dali explained it very simply, but Zhang Cai was a profession in this field, after all. She doubtfully asked, “Young Master, creating such a show, others aside, the first season of this show would not have any reputation to it. Without enough audience, how are we supposed to make it famous? If the viewership rating is too low, the TV station will cut it off. If Nianwei joined the show, the reputation would be enough, but such a competition where the result is obvious, it wouldn’t be interesting.”
She wasn’t boosting for Li Nianwei, but with Li Nianwei’s current fame and capability, getting first every time wasn’t a difficult task.
For this kind of talent show, its reputation was a big part in whether it succeeded or not.

“How could I possibly ask Sister Nianwei to do such tiring work.” Hong Dali laughed and said, “We can spend money to hire celebrities! Hire those second class and third class singers from the music world, or those celebrities who just debuted and are eager to prove themselves! There are still quite a number of capable singers from the second and third class singers, just that they lack the opportunity to prove themselves. Those who just debuted and are eager to prove themselves will be willing to join too. Plus, I will give them some benefit. It should be of no issue!”
“Yup, I think that will work!” This time, it was Tang Muxin who decided. “Then, it’s settled!”
Hong Dali asked in surprise, “Why did you agree so straightforwardly this time!?”
Tang Muxin grinned and answered, “Hiring second and third class singers and those small celebrities who just debuted won’t cost too much, right.”
“You only know how to prevent me from squandering.” Hong Dali mumbled. “You’re still so young, yet you already have the air of a housewife...”
Tang Muxin decisively ignored Hong Dali’s words. She directly pulled the rest and turned back. “Let’s go back and plan in detail.”
Very quickly, everyone returned to Chenhui Building and headed to the office in Caiwei Entertainment which was at level nine.

After entering the meeting room, Zhang Cai took out a large whiteboard and wrote “I Am a Singer” on it. Then, she smiled and said, “Occasionally, there will also be a few talent shows. However, most of them don’t have anything special. Just that the singers will go up the stage and sing, then the judges will give them marks and split them into different levels. If there isn’t anything new or special, the talent show won’t succeed. Looking through all the other talent shows so far, most of them depend on the singer’s background story to affect the audience’s mood—their singing voice is instead not as important. I think that Young Master’s ‘I Am a Singer’ have what it takes to make it.”

She paused before continuing, “Since following the trend will be hard to emerge from the other talent shows, we might as well go against the flow. We shall not play with background stories and their emotions, we shall just state that we will be judging them just on their voice and music. I think that coupled with some good advertising, Young Master’s ‘I Am a Singer’ which is very rare in our country will be able to successfully attract the attention of viewers. That shouldn’t be a difficult thing.”

“Yup.” As the female celebrity with the fastest growth in net worth, Li Nianwei’s perceptivity of the entertainment industry was quite accurate. She agreed and said, “Arrange it properly, there shouldn’t be any problem.”

Hong Dali lay on the table, sniffled and said, “Anyway, this is the case. I’m only interested in spending money, my aim is just to have fun, squandering is my hobby. Help me think of who to seek, and roughly how much money is needed.”

Zhang Cai walked back and forth in the meeting room. While walking, she said, “The problem now is that other talent shows can easily seek for normal people for candidates, but it isn’t an easy thing to find professional singers to compete on stage. Famed singers will consider about winning and losing. They might not gain anything if they win, but their worth will drop drastically if they lose. As for second and third class singers, the audience is not familiar with them—they will not be helpful for pulling up the viewership rating, gaining sponsors... or even attracting audiences.” She wanted to say gaining sponsorships, but considering Hong Dali’s ways, she decisively stopped on that part.
Then, Li Nianwei nodded and said, “It would be best to invite those who are long famous but are not very active in the music world nowadays. Sister Cai, do you have any good suggestions?”

“Such a candidate, let me think...” Under everyone’s eyes, Zhang Cai walked another two rounds. Suddenly, her eyes lit up. “I thought of someone! We can invite Chu Zhongqin, he shouldn’t be too difficult to invite!”
“Chu Zhongqin?” Hong Dali used his elbows to support his head. Puzzled, he asked, “Who is that?”

Zhang Cai knew that Hong Dali was usually very carefree, it was normal that he was not familiar with such a person. Thus, she immediately introduced: “Chu Zhongqin is one of the most famous singers during the nineties in our country. He’s a big brotherly figure, has become more low-profile these past few years, and rarely appearing on TV anymore. However, he’s definitely an expert in the music world. If he can come, with such a big signboard, we just have to find a few others, and it will do!”

“This is good, this is good!” Hong Dali excitedly slapped the table. “Use 500,000 yuan to invite him! Yup, that’s right. For our show, that should be some reward. Otherwise, there won’t be much point in the competition—if there isn’t any reward, how am I supposed to spend money? This is how it shall be: the first place will obtain one million yuan, the one kicked out will get 200,000 yuan as comfort! Then, aren’t we lacking celebrities? Those who joined the show, as long as they’re willing, they can sign a contract with our company. They will definitely not lack benefits in the future.”

Tang Muxin pouted and mumbled, “He really has too much money and nowhere to spend. Just a few words and that’s 2 million yuan throw in. Sigh, such is the ways of the world. I thought that this time we wouldn’t have to spend so much.”
Unfortunately, under Hong Dali’s money halo that was so bright that it would blind others, Tang Muxin’s small discontent could only become small.
Under Hong Dali’s say, this matter was basically decided.

Zhang Cai smiled and said, “If Chu Zhongqin came, other famed singers like Shen Rui, Li Xiao, and Panda should be willing to participate as well.” Speaking up to this point, she suddenly frowned and said, “However, if Chu Zhongqin really came, he would be doing us a great favor. Young Master, do you think that for the first round...” She didn’t say it directly, but all those present knew what she meant.

Hong Dali wasn’t silly. He naturally knew what she was trying to say. “I understand. For the first round, take it as a token of our appreciation for him helping us to attract the audience. Yup, for the first round, all of the audience shall be given a luxurious phone. You know what I mean!”

Zhang Cai nodded and said, “Yup, as long as Young Master agrees, for the first round, we will have to make sure that Chu Zhongqin gets first in place. If not, with his fame and bringing so many other celebrities with him, and helping to pull up the viewership rating, if he ended in the last few positions, it wouldn’t look nice. Now, there aren’t any more problems.”

“OK, then it’s settled.” Hong Dali stood up. “Ah, I’m tired, time to go home!” As he said so, he called out to Zhang Cai. “Oh right, Sister Cai, afterUnexpectedly! has completed with the producing, don’t send it out yet. Give me a copy of it first. Heh heh, this is my first movie, I have to let my parents view it first. Only then can others view it!”
“OK, I got it.”
“OK, time to head home and sleep!”

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - Sir Mu
paragraphs: “Dad, Mom, I’m back!” Tang Muxin greeted as she arrived at her doorstep after taking a ride on Hong Dali’s Soaring Angel. She then removed her little leather boots and bolted into the house. She hugged her Dad Tang Ruisi’s neck from behind and asked grinningly, “Dad, was your work today tiring? Want me to help you massage your shoulders?”

At home, Tang Ruisi was the pillar of support and had great ability. He was the idol of Tang Muxin ever since she was young. As she reached home, the first thing she thought of was to help her Dad relief some of his fatigue.

“Hehe, I’m not tired, go get some rest, Xinxin.” Tang Ruisi was still wearing that greenish-gray vest and holding a copper tobacco pipe. He took a puff, smiled and asked, “Xinxin, how was your day? Are you happy?”

“It’s fine. That prodigal, Dali, sure knows how to spend.” Tang Muxin held up the Terrier, Xiao Xiaobai, which walked up to her. She was about to stroke its short white fur when she suddenly frowned and scrutinized Tang Ruisi. She then asked, “Dad, you don’t seem to be in a good mental state today. Why are your eyes bloodshot? Is there something wrong with the company?”

“Ah, no, no.” Tang Ruisi paused for a while and hurriedly said, “What can go wrong in the company? Don’t worry. Ah, your mom asked. How have you been for the past couple of days in school? Did Liu Mingcheng go and harass you again?”

“As a matter of fact, no. He was totally defeated by Dali.” Seemingly distracted, Tang Muxin replied and then held Xiao Xiaobai and ran into her room. She continued, “Dad, I’m going to bed. I’ve school tomorrow morning.”
“Go get some rest, little girl, hehe.” Tang Ruisi smiled and replied before continuing to smoke.

Tang Muxin held Xiao Xiaobai and lay on her bed feeling upset. “Seeing Dad’s bloodshot eyes, something must have gone wrong with his business. If he doesn’t tell me, that definitely means he is afraid I will worry. But am I not worried already?” Having thought so, Tang Muxin gave a deep sigh and continued thinking, “But what could go wrong with Dad’s company? I don’t know for sure. Even if I know, I won’t be of any help. What should I do? This is so worrisome.”

She lay on her bed, too restless to fall asleep. Finally, she thought of Hong Dali and blushed. She thought to herself, “Strange, why did I even think of this prodigal, Dali. But... but...” She thought for a while and continued, “But Dali’s luck has always been great. Maybe he could have a solution?” She shook her head and continued, “He doesn’t even know what issue my Dad’s company is facing, how would he even know what to do? ButUnexpectedly! does have the slogan from my Dad’s company, maybe that might be of some use?”

At last, Tang Muxin clasped her hands together while laying in her bed and prayed. “Goddess, please blessUnexpectedly! so that it’ll be a big hit. Maybe this will boost my Dad’s company’s pharmaceuticals sales. Please bless him...”

South, Shanghai Tianhai City.
Inside a private clubhouse along Kelan Road.

This private clubhouse did not seem luxurious on the surface, but it was a typical Hui-style architecture with a huge area of glass at its rooftop, and in the center was an atrium with a deep blue pool. There was even a huge clump of bamboo plants beside the pool. In the pool, there were tens of red carps leisurely swimming.

Among the four walls, one was filled with various types of top-grade Longjing tea—one was filled with a superb collection of antiques, one was filled with books, and the remaining one was a wall painting of Dunhuang City’s Fairy Scattering Flower Mural.
And at this time, within this atrium, which did not exude a single bit of tackiness, two people were sitting and having tea face to face with each other.

One was a middle-aged man of about 40 years old, big-bellied and partially balding. Sitting opposite him was a young man of about 25 or 26 years old, wearing a fitting suit. Although the brand wasn’t noticeable, it was definitely not something cheap. He had dashing brows, thin lips, red phoenix eyes, and the most impressionable feature was his forehead. He had a red birthmark right at the center of his forehead, like the legendary Erlang Shen’s1third eye.
Although both men were having tea, their statuses were not the same.

The big-bellied middle-aged man was in cold sweat sitting there, and he did not dare to move an inch. Conversely, the young man was sitting at will and even grabbed a handful of peanuts to toss into his mouth every now and then.

“Director Zhao, this appointment isn’t just for me to look at you tremble, is it?” Both men sat for a while more, and the young man grabbed a handful of peanuts and tossed them into his mouth yet again. He casually munched on them, took a sip of tea, and continued, “What do you have for me? My patience is limited.”

“Yes... yes...” The big-bellied Director Zhao retrieved a white handkerchief from his shirt pocket to wipe the cold sweat off his forehead and continued, “Sir Mu, I’m here to speak with you regarding Li Nianwei...”
“Oh?” Sir Mu exclaimed and suddenly started laughing. “Are you talking about the female singer who rose to fame in the entertainment business in the past few days? The goddess Li Nianwei?”

“Yes... yes.” Director Zhao clenched his teeth and continued, “She was in our company previously. But she got scouted and poached by Young Master Hong Dali of the Hong Family from the capital city. Regarding this issue, I cannot take this lying down, so I would like to request for your assistance. Even if our company cannot have her, neither can other companies!”

“Ptui!” Sir Mu sneered and continued, “Trying to use me? I’m not afraid of the Hong Family, but did you really think I would agree to create such a great enemy for such a thing? I do love women, but not as crazily as you do!” He sneered again and continued, “Trying to sound pitiful? Isn’t it just because you’d always wanted to get your oily body on top of Li Nianwei’s but did not manage to, and so, in the end, you just decided to let her go? Do you think I am dumb? Given Miss Nianwei’s talent, if you hadn’t had such a selfish desire, she would have made it big long ago. Regretting it only now, you pig?”

“Yes... I’m dumb.” Director Zhao viciously gave himself two big slaps and continued, “I just cannot take this lying down. Every time I see her being so successful, my heart feels like it’s bleeding! Tens of millions of worth, just gone!”

“Don’t blame others for your stupidity,” Sir Mu eerily said. “Had you not treated my Dad to a meal when you were young, I would have ordered for someone to beat you up till all the oil in your stomach is out of you! Fear not the enemy but the stupid ally. This saying is made for you.”

“Sir Mu, I... I...” Director Zhao was about to say something when Sir Mu sneered and interrupted. “Fine, the favor my dad owed you, I will repay it for him. Piss off, as far away from my sight as you can. After a few days, if I’m free, I’ll head down to the capital to have a look.”
“Yes, yes, then... I’ll take my leave, I’ll leave now!”
After leaving the clubhouse, Director Zhao’s lips formed a faint, cruel smile as he said, “No one gets what I can’t have!”

Meanwhile, Sir Mu, who was still inside the clubhouse, with a huge slap, actually broke a small wooden stool into two, as he smiled and said, “Hong Dali, for the sake of squandering, you actually helped such a star rise to fame, interesting indeed. Fine, since I’m quite free, I shall see how capable you really are!”

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - Real Man!
paragraphs: “Ah, this is really troublesome...” Hong Dali sat with his legs crossed on his bed. He was looking down at his small penis. Oh wait, that’s wrong, it couldn’t be called a small penis now. It should be called—big bird, about to be not lazy!

“Damn it!” Thinking of this, Hong Dali felt a pain in his balls and scolded. Then, he furiously rubbed his face. “Now I have another 20 attribute points again, should I add them, add them, or add them?”

If he added them, he was afraid that his bird would become too big—this thing was better if it were slightly larger, but if it were too large... having something bulging down there even when he was walking around was quite a pain in the balls.
But if he didn’t add them, Hong Dali felt that he couldn’t bear the temptation. After all, all men wish for their bird to be larger.
Thus, Hong Dali had sat in this position on his bed for an entire hour.

In the end, he still couldn’t resist the temptation. He fiercely bit his teeth. “All goes nothing. I don’t believe that just this 20 attribute points can cause my small penis to become one time larger!” Thinking of this, he pulled out the system interface and used his attribute points.
The usual golden light, firstly starting from his whole body, then gathering on top of his small penis.
This time, the process was much faster than last time. After all, the points were half of last time. Therefore, after a short while, the golden light totally disappeared.
And Hong Dali finally had the courage to open his eyes and looked at his small penis.
Luckily, the last 20 points didn’t cause his small penis to enlarge by a lot. From what he saw, it only got larger by a small scale. As for other changes, he couldn’t tell if there was any.
“What kind of situation is this?” Hong Dali felt quite curious. “It didn’t get much larger? Then where did those 20 points went to?”
After thinking for a while, Hong Dali finally realized. “Oh my, don’t tell me it was added to the endurance for sexual capability...”
This is good, this is good, a real man must be able to last!

“Humph, humph. Speaking of which, this system is indeed awesome...” After proudly thinking for a while, Hong Dali pulled out the system interface from inside his mind again. On it was written: “Health attribute: 100, Sexual capability: 100. Current Mission: Third Time Squandering, Mission Requirement: Squander 15,000,000 yuan in a month’s time, Current Value Squandered: 7,546,415, Current Time Spent: 12 days 17 hours. Mission Reward: Additional 15 attribute points.”
Yup, still okay. Already halfway done, not bad.

Currently, he still had 18 days left. Counting carefully, Zhong Dian website still needed to continue on advertising, “The Gale Flash” was also still filming, “I Am a Singer” was starting in its preparation, and there was also the outer area of Tianjing Mountain which was going to hire people to clear the trash. Counting all of that in, he should be able to complete his mission within this 17 plus days.

Actually, it would not matter even if he couldn’t complete the mission. After all, there wasn’t any punishment. What Hong Dali was really concerned with was to maximize all his stats to see what the system would be like after it upgraded. But thinking about it, he was sure that there would be interesting things appearing after the upgrade. As for what it actually was, who knew. Whatever the case, the system was already awesome. It couldn’t get any worse, could it!
The next morning, Hong Dali was boringly reading a novel in class.
At the same time, at the school’s entrance.
A black mass of students was assembled there, obviously split into two different groups. There was a total of a hundred plus people, and it could be seen that a storm seemed to be developing!

“Liu Mingcheng, our first-year students and you second-year students have always gone our separate ways. Did you think because of that we are afraid of you? You asshole, what are you trying to do bringing so many people to block the school gate?” One person stood in front of Liu Mingcheng as his eyebrows dashed upwards and his hands holding a broomstick, furiously staring at the group of 50 plus people blocking the school gate, led by Liu Mingcheng.

He was about 17 years old, wore an expensive set of uniform, and had his hair combed into a spike. He was quite handsome, and his height was about 1.75 meters. His most striking feature was a dragon head tattooed at the side of his left neck, seemingly wriggling towards his chest.
In this high school, the only person who dared to oppose Liu Mingcheng, other than Hong Dali, was this new upstart from the first year, the Big Young Master of the Bu Family, Bu Lixue.
Bu Lixue’s family was slightly weaker than the Hong Family and the Liu Family, but not by much.

Different from Hong Dali’s nitwitted squandering and Liu Mingcheng’s arrogant and despotic behavior, although Bu Lixue was doleful in nature, he was very particular about loyalty to his friends. He was the recognized leader of all first-year students, and his place in their hearts was akin to that of Hong Dali and Liu Mingcheng.
The air reeked of fireworks, and a single spark could have turned it into a group fight.

Liu Mingcheng crossed his arms and said in a cold tone, “Bu Lixue, these few days you guys spread rumors in the school. Very fun, isn’t it? At first, I wondered why this news spread so fast. But then, I found out it was you, first-years, who were behind this. Bu Lixue, it isn’t time for class yet, shouldn’t we settle our grudges now?”
“You’re asking me for an answer? That’s fine.” Bu Lixue fiercely said, “Dayao is my classmate, I shall bear the responsibility of this matter for him.”
“Fine, you have quite the machismo. I shall grant you your wish.” Liu Mingcheng flared and clenched his fist. “You have quite the air of a triad leader. Unfortunately, it all ends here!”
Liu Mingcheng raised his hand as he said so, about to shout out the signal to start fighting. But just at this moment, something happened.
First, a series of the roaring sounds of an engine sounded from far away and appeared behind them in the blink of an eye.

Normally, in this high school, it wasn’t something rare for a student to drive a luxurious car or sports car to school. However, one with such a loud engine was still rare. It wasn’t that of a normal noise disturbance, but a deep metal sound, the type that could be heard only when the engine reached a certain level of horsepower.
Boom boom boom...
The air and the earth shook as a super streamlined black sports car stopped behind everyone, facing the school gate!

That sports car was almost double the size of a typical sports car, entirely black in color. Under the Sun’s rays, brilliant lights and vibrant colors could be seen. It was more beautiful than even the Lamborghini from Hong Dali’s previous life. Now, the entire car was slightly vibrating, and fire sparks were continuously being spurted out from the exhaust pipe!

At first, the students didn’t notice it because they were about to start the fight. But very quickly, someone noticed something was wrong. After turning around in curiosity and taking a glance, he immediately began to tremble. Endless fear could be heard from his voice. “It’s... it’s Blood Consort! Blood Consort is here!”

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - If You Dont Seek Death, You Wont Die
paragraphs: “Sister... Sister Blood Consort!” Liu Mingcheng, who was like a strong general from the battlefield a moment ago, became stupefied instantly. After a short daze, Liu Mingcheng shouted desperately, “Why did she come today?! Everyone, run!”
In fact, it was not only Liu Mingcheng who was scared. Even Bu Lixue, who was standing opposite him, became frightened and shouted, “Run!”
However, it was all too late.

A wave of metal-filled machine sounds could be heard while Sister Blood Consort’s car had its headlamps retracted. Then, under the sunlight, four Gatlin machine guns appeared on the original position of headlamps.
At this time, the students who were blocking the school gate were just starting to escape!
Zi Zi Zi—!!

A wave of rapid “Zizi” sounded. In a blink of an eye, the four Gatlin machine guns began to spin wildly, and each machine gun shot a dozen white BB bullets the size of the fingernail of the little finger!
Yes, it was the most common kind of BB bullet in toy guns meant for children.

However, if the BB bomb was shot out by a toy gun meant for children, the power of impact would be negligible. However, it was completely different if it were used in the four Gatlin machine guns of Sister Blood Consort.

In the blink of an eye, the students who were near the vehicle she was on were knocked down. The lucky ones only had their shirts pierced with bullet holes. However, for those not as fortunate, they suffered from bruises all over their body.

In the twinkling of an eye, the students blocking the school gate were swept down, and the school gate was finally clear of people. Then, the super sports car slowly kept its four Gatling guns and, after a roar from the engine, it sped into campus with the speed of lightning, leaving behind a trail caused by friction between the tires of the car and the ground.
Only a bunch of students lying on the ground were left, together with the BB bullets littered all around.

Liu Mingcheng, who didn’t manage to run fast enough before, suffered around ten or so shots. He laid on the ground while sucking in a breath of cold air. He had personally witnessed the power of those BB bullets before. The BB bullets could penetrate three-millimeter cardboard from 20 meters away. Although getting shot was not fatal, it would cause the victim to hurt for several days. It could definitely be considered a giant killing machine.
“Why the heck am I so unlucky?” Liu Mingcheng sighed. “Why did Sister Blood Consort come to school today?”

“If it wasn’t because you blocked Sister Blood Consort’s path, why would she have bothered to take action against us?” Bu Lixue was in no better state than Liu Mingcheng. “What the f*ck! I freaking got shot even while lying down today. This matter is not over, wait for me to come back at you!”

The two of them began to swear while lying on the ground, but no one dared to mention Sister Blood Consort’s name. If Sister Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin, were to hear anything regarding her, with her irrational mind, she would definitely kill her way to them.
Inside the school campus.

“Sister Blood Consort is coming to school. Start running, everybody!” Countless students rushed away while shouting. This time, the speed of transmission of the message was many times faster than that of Liu Mingcheng’s nickname “Small Bird, Not Lazy.” In just one minute, almost no figure could be seen on the entire campus.
With her blue hair tied into two ponytails, Sister Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin, walked down from her car and slowly went in the direction of the classroom of 2nd year, 14th class.
Just after reaching the entrance of the classroom building, she was blocked by four male students.

“Sister Blood Consort, I heard that you’re very fierce. All the people in the school might be afraid of you, but we aren’t.” A long-haired male student sneered. “I don’t know how small their courage is, causing them to hide when they hear your name. Aiya, after getting rid of you today, we will become the bosses of this school. Speaking of which, I have to thank you for it.” After finishing his speech, the other three around him started to laugh and arrogantly raised the mop handles in their hands at the same time.

These four people had just transferred to this school. After hearing about the legend of Sister Blood Consort, they immediately decided to challenge her when she came to school. As long as they could beat Sister Blood Consort, they would be the well-deserved bosses on the campus, the best choice to become one that is able to act high and mighty in the school.
However, it was a pity that their opponent was Sister Blood Consort.

“My name is Lin Chuyin.” Sister Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin, maintained an expressionless face. Her eyes swept across the four before faintly saying, “In my name, target confirmed, start the attack.” Her voice was very soft, but it also carried infinite indifference, with little human emotion. Along with her “start the attack,” a pair of steel gloves appeared on her hands. In the middle of the gloves, there was a round golden metal.
Then, she moved.

Her soles seemed to be loaded with a pair of rocket boosters, causing a gust of air to flow out. In just a blink of an eye, her palms had already been pressed against the chest of the boy. Her voice remained indifferent and ruthless as she said, “30,000 volts.”
Zi la la—!!!

The sound of a wave of current sounded, and then the boy’s original long hair was all erected, causing him to look like a porcupine with hairy hair. Then, he twitched and fell to the ground, shaking non-stop.

Although the 30,000 voltage current was high, the current flowing through the human body was very small, and the time only lasted a few microseconds. Therefore, the wave of current would not cause death. The effect was about the same as a strong electric baton and lasted for a very short time, and thus, could only cause partial paralysis. However, if one were to launch a sudden attack on the key parts of the body, it would cause syncope to occur.
Obviously, the long-haired male student was no longer able to stand up.
The whole fight was very fast, lasting merely six seconds.

Sister Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin, looked as if she were perfectly fine and did not seem to have undergone the previous fight. She walked by the four on the ground expressionlessly before heading towards the direction of the classroom.
In the classroom of 2nd year, 14th class.

Ling Yi, who was supporting his chin with his right hand, smiled cheekily. “Those retards from 8th class even thought of finding trouble with Sister Blood Consort. As the saying goes, if one does not seek death, one will not die.”

Du Xinzhen, who was laughing at the side, said, “I knew at the tip of my fingers that they would definitely be beaten. The set of exoskeleton armor was almost finished by Sister Blood Consort six months ago. Provoking a technology geek, hehe, so ballsy!”
This time, Lang Hao did not rebut, but said, “Speaking of which, why did Sister Blood Consort come to school today? She doesn’t come to school unless there’s a need to. Unless something is going on?”

Ling Yi shook his head and said, “How would I know? No one can figure out what Sister Blood Consort is thinking. It will be alright as long as we do not go bother her. Speaking of which, do you think we should find an opportunity to ask if we can visit her experimental lab? I really want to see the robot and hear the piano piece ‘First World’ played by ‘Tesla Coil’ in her lab again.”
“Yeah, yeah.” Du Xinzhen nodded and said, “The standard current sound plays the piano music. The robot plays drums on the side. It must be given, oh, it’s so nice!”

“Ok, stop talking, she’s reaching the classroom in a few moments!” While they were still discussing, the student who acted as the sentry rushed back in and reported his newest findings. “Sister Blood Consort seems to have invented a new machine today!”

A wave of metal-filled machine sounds could be heard while Sister Blood Consort’s car had its headlamps retracted.
Then, under the sunlight, four Gatlin machine guns appeared on the original position of headlamps.
At this time, the students who were blocking the school gate were just starting to escape!
Zi Zi Zi—!!
A wave of rapid “Zizi” sounded.
In a blink of an eye, the four Gatlin machine guns began to spin wildly, and each machine gun shot a dozen white BB bullets the size of the fingernail of the little finger!
Yes, it was the most common kind of BB bullet in toy guns meant for children.
However, if the BB bomb was shot out by a toy gun meant for children, the power of impact would be negligible.
However, it was completely different if it were used in the four Gatlin machine guns of Sister Blood Consort.
In the blink of an eye, the students who were near the vehicle she was on were knocked down.
The lucky ones only had their shirts pierced with bullet holes.
However, for those not as fortunate, they suffered from bruises all over their body.
In the twinkling of an eye, the students blocking the school gate were swept down, and the school gate was finally clear of people.

Liu Mingcheng, who didn’t manage to run fast enough before, suffered around ten or so shots.
He laid on the ground while sucking in a breath of cold air.
He had personally witnessed the power of those BB bullets before.
The BB bullets could penetrate three-millimeter cardboard from 20 meters away.
Although getting shot was not fatal, it would cause the victim to hurt for several days.
It could definitely be considered a giant killing machine.
